title: Manager - Data Operations
description:
ISS STOXX is hiring for
**Manager - Data Operations**
for Mumbai location.
  
  
**Overview**
ISS STOXX is the world’s leading provider of corporate governance and responsible investment (RI) solutions for asset owners, asset managers, hedge funds, and asset service providers. ISS’ solutions include objective governance research and recommendations; RI data, analytics, and research; end-to end proxy voting and distribution solutions; turnkey securities class-action claims management; and reliable global governance data and modeling tools.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* People Management
* Recruitment, coach, mentor, and develop a team of analysts to profile data for a given content pillar and market
* Undertake performance reviews to ensure that each team member works towards clearly defined team goals.
* Operational Management
* Plan manpower capacity and scheduling to ensure SLA and goals are met / exceeded
* Manage workflow queues to ensure timely delivery of data profiles in accordance with established production schedules
* Enforce quality assurance and controls to ensure accuracy levels meet / exceed targets.
* Process/Methodology Custodianship
* Collaborate with Data colleagues across locations to
* Develop and maintain methodology and procedures manuals for data collection.
* Enforce compliance of staff with established data collection and quality procedures.
* Analyze performance metrics (timeliness, efficiency, quality, controls) and implement opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Research, recommend, and implement technology and content opportunities to improve product quality and operational efficiencies.
* Product Support
* Collaborate with other teams across functions (i.e., Research, ICS, Product, Development, QBIT) in support of planned product enhancements and extensions
* Respond to queries from internal and external clients.

**Qualifications**

* At least a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Geology, or similar field of study. A post-graduate degree is a plus.
* A minimum of 5-8 years relevant working experience in a high-quality and hard deadline-driven environment, with at least 3 year leading a team.
* Knowledge of corporate governance and/or financial markets is an advantage.
* Good judgment in assessing available information and understanding the downstream effects of data decisions on final product outputs.
* Effectiveness in working with cross-functional teams.
* Takes pride in developing people.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear attention to detail.
* Highly motivated, independent, results-oriented, and possesses a strong sense of ownership.
* Must be willing to work on a flexible shift schedule.

#MIDSENIOR
  
  
#ESG
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Us**
Our people are the moving force behind our work. We are committed to building a culture that values diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences. If you have the skills, passion, and drive to help us bring clarity and transparency to capital markets, we want to work with you.
  
  
Together, we can grow your career in an environment that fuels creativity, drives innovation, and has real impact.
  
  
**About ISS STOXX**
ISS STOXX delivers world-class research, data, and technology solutions that empower capital market participants to pursue their visions with confidence. Our expertise spans indices, corporate governance, sustainability, cyber risk, and fund intelligence, giving clients the tools they need to uncover opportunities, manage risks, and navigate evolving regulations. We are made up of 4,000 professionals operating across 20 countries and serving approximately 5,000 clients, including many of the world’s leading institutional investors. Our scale and reach give us deep market knowledge, while our innovative methodologies allow us to offer our clients tailored insights that drive impact and success.
  
  
**ISS STOXX Governance**
delivers comprehensive corporate governance research, analytics, and investor voting solutions supported by a global, high‑quality data set spanning diverse markets and topics. Our offerings equip investors with the depth and scale needed to meet evolving stewardship priorities. We provide flexible voting policy options, including fully customizable reports, backed by experienced research teams located worldwide, ensuring clients benefit from both global insight and local market expertise.

View additional open roles: https://www.iss-stoxx.com/about/careers/

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADSIPL - Maharashtra

title: MANAGER – LEASE OPERATIONS
description:
**WE’RE HIRING | MANAGER – LEASE OPERATIONS**
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience:**
3–9 Years (Relevant Experience)
  
  
**About The Role**
Growthally Advisors is looking for a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to join its team as
**Manager – Lease Operations**
.
  
  
The role involves managing and coordinating the end-to-end lease operations lifecycle, including client onboarding, transaction execution, documentation, financial monitoring, lease administration, asset tracking, and closure.
  
  
The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong financial and analytical capabilities, commercial awareness, stakeholder management skills, and a high degree of ownership. The position requires the ability to manage multiple leasing transactions, maintain robust operational controls, and ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution across the lease lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lease Operations and Transaction Management
* Manage end-to-end lease operations, from client onboarding and transaction setup through execution, monitoring, and closure.
* Coordinate leasing transactions in accordance with approved commercial terms, contractual obligations, and internal processes.
* Monitor transaction timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and outstanding actions to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure seamless coordination across leasing, finance, accounts, legal, operations, and other relevant functions.
* Proactively identify execution bottlenecks and drive timely resolution of operational issues.
* Client Onboarding and Documentation Management
* Manage client onboarding, including KYC, financial information, due diligence, and transaction-related documentation.
* Coordinate the preparation, review, verification, execution, and maintenance of lease agreements and supporting documents.
* Review documentation for completeness, accuracy, commercial consistency, and alignment with approved terms.
* Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Accounts, Company Secretarial, Insurance, Operations, lenders, and external stakeholders.
* Ensure proper documentation controls, record maintenance, and compliance with applicable internal policies and requirements.
* Financial Monitoring and Controls
* Monitor rental schedules, receivables, collections, disbursements, security deposits, advances, and other financial obligations.
* Oversee invoice processing, payment follow-ups, financial settlements, and resolution of outstanding items.
* Maintain financial trackers, MIS reports, reconciliation statements, and transaction-level dashboards.
* Conduct periodic reconciliations and investigate discrepancies in payments, invoices, balances, and transaction records.
* Track financial milestones and ensure timely coordination for payments, collections, and settlements.
* Support financial reporting, audit requirements, and management reviews through accurate and timely data.
* Lease Administration and Asset Management
* Oversee lease administration, asset documentation, asset tracking, renewals, and end-of-lease processes.
* Maintain accurate records of leased assets, contractual commitments, payment schedules, and transaction history.
* Monitor lease expiry dates, renewal timelines, financial commitments, and other contractual milestones.
* Coordinate asset-related documentation, insurance requirements, compliance records, and contractual deliverables.
* Ensure appropriate tracking and closure of lease-related obligations throughout the asset lifecycle.
* Stakeholder and Relationship Management
* Serve as a key coordination point for clients, internal business teams, finance, legal, operations, lenders, and external partners.
* Drive timely follow-ups and ensure accountability for pending actions across stakeholders.
* Facilitate the resolution of documentation gaps, financial discrepancies, contractual issues, and operational dependencies.
* Maintain professional communication and strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure effective coordination between commercial commitments and operational execution.
* MIS, Reporting and Process Improvement
* Prepare and maintain management information systems, operational dashboards, financial trackers, and periodic reports.
* Monitor key operational parameters, including transaction status, receivables, collections, documentation completion, and lease expiries.
* Establish and maintain robust processes for documentation management, transaction tracking, reconciliations, and reporting.
* Identify process gaps, operational risks, and control weaknesses, and recommend corrective measures.
* Maintain audit-ready records, transaction trails, supporting documentation, and compliance registers.
* Drive improvements in operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, turnaround times, and overall lease management processes.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–9 years of relevant experience in lease operations, financial services, NBFCs, lending operations, asset financing, finance operations, transaction management, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of lease administration, financial documentation, transaction processing, and reconciliations.
* Experience in managing invoices, collections, disbursements, payment schedules, security deposits, and financial obligations.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, financial trackers, and transaction-level analysis.
* Ability to review commercial terms, agreements, financial schedules, and supporting documentation with a high degree of accuracy.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve operational issues.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and follow-up capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple transactions and competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and execution discipline.
* Familiarity with CRM, ERP, accounting, and workflow management systems is desirable.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, compliance, accountability, and professional conduct.

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Take ownership of lease operations from onboarding through execution, monitoring, and closure.
* Have a strong understanding of financial controls, documentation standards, and transaction timelines.
* Are comfortable working with financial data, contracts, assets, and multiple stakeholders.
* Can identify risks, anticipate bottlenecks, and drive timely resolution of pending matters.
* Demonstrate a structured and process-oriented approach to operational management.
* Balance attention to detail with the ability to manage the broader lease lifecycle.
* Enjoy working in a dynamic financial advisory environment where accountability, accuracy, and execution excellence are essential.

**Join Growthally Advisors**
At Growthally Advisors, you will have the opportunity to play a key role in strengthening lease operations, improving transaction efficiency, and ensuring effective financial and operational management throughout the lease lifecycle.
  
  
Be part of a dynamic financial advisory environment where your analytical capabilities, operational expertise, and ownership mindset will contribute directly to business performance and operational excellence.

title: Investment Operations Manager - Mid Office
description:
We, at Bharti Axa Life Insurance are seeking ambitious talent ready to make an immediate impact within our fast-paced and innovative workplace. We are hiring for our Investment Department.

The company primarily focuses on ensuring regulatory compliance, managing operational risks, and acting as the crucial link between the front office (investment team) and the back office (settlements and accounting) & other stake holders (actuarial, finance, etc).

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Investment Compliance & Reporting**
  : Ensure all investment activities comply with internal limits and regulations set by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), the Insurance Act, RBI, and SEBI. This includes performing daily (BOD, EOD) compliance checks. Preparation of IRDA returns on monthly and quarterly basis. Ensure end to end management of derivatives instruments, overseeing and controlling BAU activities and monitoring mid office activities.

* **Risk Management & Controls**
  : Implement and monitor robust risk management frameworks, including market and credit risk, and maintain an effective Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA). This role is vital for identifying potential operational risks and implementing mitigation plans.

* **Trade Lifecycle Management**
  : Oversee day-to-day middle office functions across the entire trade lifecycle, including trade capture, P&L (Profit & Loss) calculation, security master maintenance, settlements, reconciliations, and exception management.

* **Stakeholder Coordination**
  : Act as the operational bridge between the Front Office, Risk, Compliance, Fund Accounting, Custodians, and Brokers to resolve operational issues and ensure smooth processes.

* **Audit and Governance**
  : Serve as the lead for all internal, statutory, and regulatory audits, preparing data, leading walkthroughs, and ensuring all findings are closed in a timely manner. This involves maintaining and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

* **Process Enhancement & Automation**
  : Identify opportunities for process automation, digitization, and Straight-Through Processing (STP), collaborating with IT/technology teams to implement new tools and workflows.

* **MIS & Reporting**
  : Prepare and present Management Information Systems (MIS) reports, performance insights, and other critical reports for senior leadership and stakeholders.

**Experience:**
2-3+ years of relevant experience in investment operations, Mid Office, or Back Office, with proven experience in managing teams and handling risk and control frameworks. Experience within the life insurance sector is preferred.

'
**Technical Skills**
: In-depth understanding of financial markets, instruments, trade lifecycle operations, and investment regulations. Familiarity with financial software such as Bloomberg Terminal, Aladdin, Power BI, Tableau, and Excel/VBA is beneficial.

**Soft Skills**
: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are essential for managing diverse stakeholders and presenting to senior management. Strong leadership and people management capabilities are also crucial.

title: INM057: Manager, Supply Chain Operations
description:
* Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and results-oriented Manager – Supply Chain Operations to lead and manage end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations across warehousing, transportation, distribution, inventory management, 3PL operations, and customer service.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have 12–15 years of strong experience in supply chain operations, with significant exposure to 3PL and third-party contract logistics environments. The candidate will be responsible for managing large-scale operations, multiple warehouses/DCs, logistics partners, manpower, transportation networks, service providers, Region P&L , and customer relationships.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on operational leadership, with the ability to drive operational excellence, cost optimization, process improvement, service-level adherence, technology adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The candidate will be expected to build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, customers, transporters, 3PL partners, vendors, and other external service providers.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* End-to-End Supply Chain Operations
* Manage and oversee end-to-end supply chain operations covering warehousing & Transportation .
* Develop and implement operational strategies aligned with business requirements, customer expectations, and company objectives.
* Monitor operational performance across warehouses, distribution centers, transport operations.
* Ensure achievement of agreed SLA, KPI, OTIF, productivity, quality, cost, and customer service targets.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish standardized operating processes across locations and ensure adherence to SOPs.
* Ensure optimum utilization of warehouse space, manpower, material handling equipment, and infrastructure.
* Drive warehouse productivity through appropriate manpower planning, process design, layout optimization, slotting, and workflow improvements.
* Establish and monitor warehouse productivity metrics.
* Ensure accurate inventory records and minimize inventory discrepancies.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, security, and operational standards.
* Support warehouse expansion, relocation, consolidation, and new facility implementation projects.
* Ensure effective management of warehouse assets and material handling equipment.
* Own and monitor operational logistics costs across warehousing, transportation, manpower, packaging, handling, and other logistics activities.
* Prepare and manage annual operating budgets for supply chain operations.
* Analyze actual versus budgeted costs and identify deviations.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives without compromising service levels.
* Identify opportunities for:

+ Freight optimization
+ Warehouse productivity improvement
+ Manpower optimization
+ Space optimization
+ Packaging optimization
+ Route optimization
+ Vendor consolidation
+ Process automation
+ Asset utilization

* Conduct regular P&L reviews with warehouse in charges .
* Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to improve supply chain efficiency, productivity, quality, and cost.
* Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Apply methodologies such as:

+ Lean
+ Kaizen
+ 5S
+ Six Sigma
+ Root Cause Analysis
+ PDCA
+ Process Mapping
+ Standard Work

* Conduct process audits and identify gaps against defined SOPs.
* Drive automation and digitization initiatives.
* Eliminate non-value-added activities and process bottlenecks.
* Standardize best practices across locations.
* Lead productivity improvement projects with measurable financial benefits.
* Technology & Digital Supply Chain
* Identify opportunities for automation and technology-led process improvements.
* Ensure data accuracy and system discipline across supply chain operations.
* Work with IT teams to implement enhancements, integrations, dashboards, and automation.
* Leverage analytics and operational data to improve decision-making.
* Promote real-time visibility of inventory, orders, shipments, and logistics performance.
* Support implementation of digital supply chain solutions.

**5 . Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through consistent service delivery.
* Handle critical customer escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Conduct regular operational reviews with key customers.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable operational processes.
* Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders including:
* Ensure effective communication and cross-functional collaboration.

**6 . Vendor & Commercial Management**

* Manage commercial relationships with logistics vendors and service providers.
* Negotiate rates, contracts, SLAs, and commercial terms.
* Validate vendor invoices against agreed rates and actual service delivery.
* Ensure proper governance over additional charges, claims, penalties, and recoveries.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance and commercial reviews.
* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation and strategic sourcing.
* Support procurement/commercial teams during logistics tenders and contract negotiations.

**7 . Compliance, Safety & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with company policies, statutory requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable logistics regulations.
* Implement robust operational controls across warehouses and transportation.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, security, and environmental standards.
* Conduct periodic operational and safety audits.
* Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Establish business continuity and contingency plans for critical logistics operations.
* Ensure proper incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action.
* Team Leadership & People Management
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of supply chain, warehouse, logistics, and operations professionals.
* Manage both direct employees and outsourced/contract manpower.
* Define roles, responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Build a strong performance-oriented culture.
* Improve employee productivity, engagement, and retention.
* Develop succession plans for critical operational positions.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning based on business volumes and operational requirements.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

The Company
  
  
FedEx Logistics provides e-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.
  
  
The Philosophy
  
  
People–Service–Profit (P-S-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well-being and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
The Culture
  
  
We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.
  
  
The Mission
  
  
We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.
  
  
We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Supply Chain Lead
description:
**Location: Goregaon (Mumbai)**

**Experience: 5+ years of experience in a managerial/team-handling role**

**Function: Supply Chain & Operations**

**Reporting To: Senior Management**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Lead to lead the end-to-end Supply Chain and Operations function. The role will be responsible for managing the Operations team, overseeing inventory and fulfilment, managing E-commerce and Quick Commerce operations, driving operational efficiency, managing stakeholders, and owning the Supply Chain and Operations P&L.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in FMCG, D2C, Retail, E-commerce, or Quick Commerce, with proven experience in managing teams and leading supply chain and operations functions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Lead and manage the Supply Chain & Operations team**

* Guide the team in day-to-day supply chain and operational activities.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
* Support the team in resolving operational challenges.

**2. Oversee inventory planning, availability, fulfilment and logistics**

* Monitor inventory levels, stock availability and replenishment requirements.
* Ensure smooth order fulfilment and timely movement of products.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics partners for efficient operations.

**3. Manage operations across E-commerce & Quick Commerce platforms**

* Oversee day-to-day operations across E-commerce and Quick Commerce channels.

title: Manager – Production Planning & Control
description:
**Role Overview**

Lead central production planning, material planning and plant inventory management across the company’s FMCG portfolio. Ensure timely product availability, optimum inventory levels and efficient coordination across manufacturing locations, while leading the Production Planning and Plant Inventory & Stores teams.

**1. Production Planning & Scheduling**

* Lead production planning from based on sales forecasts, confirmed orders, inventory levels and business priorities across brands, categories and SKUs.
* Prepare and monitor monthly, weekly and daily production plans in coordination with manufacturing plants and third-party manufacturers, wherever applicable.
* Incorporate seasonal demand, festive requirements, promotional activities and new product launches into production plans.
* Monitor plan adherence and revise schedules to address demand changes, material availability and manufacturing constraints.

**2. Material & Inventory Planning**

* Plan raw materials (RM), packaging materials (PM) and consumables to ensure uninterrupted production.
* Translate production plans and bills of materials (BOMs) into material requirements, considering procurement lead times, minimum order quantities and safety stock.
* Coordinate with Procurement to ensure timely material availability and proactively address shortages.
* Maintain optimum RM, PM and finished goods inventory while minimising excess, slow-moving, obsolete and near-expiry stock.
* Plan packaging transitions and product discontinuations to minimise residual material and write-offs.

**3. Plant Inventory & Stores Management**

* Lead the Plant Inventory & Stores teams across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure timely and accurate receipt, storage, issuance, returns and reconciliation of materials.
* Maintain appropriate storage conditions, identification and segregation based on category requirements, including food ingredients, fragrances, chemicals and packaging materials.
* Ensure adherence to approved SOPs, batch traceability and FIFO/FEFO practices, as applicable.
* Coordinate with Quality for the segregation, release and disposition of materials under inspection, rejected stock and expired inventory.

**4. Production & Supply Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Manufacturing, Procurement, Sales, Demand Planning, Quality and Logistics teams to align production with business requirements.
* Proactively resolve material shortages, production delays, quality holds and supply gaps.
* Align finished goods availability with dispatch plans, customer commitments and distribution requirements.
* Support new product launches through material readiness, packaging availability and production scheduling.

**5. Inventory Accuracy & Control**

* Ensure accurate and timely recording of inventory transactions in ERP systems.
* Drive regular cycle counts, physical stock verification and reconciliation of system and physical inventory.
* Investigate inventory variances and implement corrective actions with relevant teams.
* Monitor material consumption against BOMs and approved norms to identify abnormal usage, wastage and process losses.
* Strengthen controls to reduce damages, expiry, pilferage and inventory write-offs.

**6. Capacity & Resource Planning**

* Assess production capacity, manpower, machine availability and material constraints across plants and production lines.
* Balance production requirements with available capacity, considering batch sizes, changeovers, cleaning requirements and maintenance schedules.
* Identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to support delivery commitments.
* Recommend capacity adjustments, alternate production arrangements or outsourcing requirements based on business needs.

**7. Process & Cost Optimisation**

* Improve inventory turns, stock availability, storage utilisation and production planning efficiency.
* Optimise production batch sizes and schedules to reduce unnecessary changeovers, material wastage and carrying costs.
* Drive standardisation of planning and stores processes across manufacturing locations.
* Strengthen ERP usage, master data accuracy and reporting to improve planning visibility and control.

**8. Team Leadership & Governance**

* Lead, develop and review the performance of the Production Planning and Plant Inventory & Stores teams.
* Establish clear responsibilities, operating processes and performance measures across both functions.
* Conduct regular reviews of production adherence, material availability, inventory ageing and stock accuracy.
* Provide timely MIS, highlight risks and track corrective actions to closure.
* Support internal audits and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable quality, hygiene and safety requirements in coordination with relevant teams.

title: Voyage Manager
description:
**About Our Client**

Navora, under the aegis of
**MaritimeSolutionsLtd**
, is hiring a
**Voyage Manager (Dry Bulk)**
for its client, a service-driven organization specialising in integrated commercial management solutions for the maritime industry.

**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced
**Voyage Manager (Dry Bulk)**
to oversee the commercial operations of dry bulk vessels, covering the entire voyage lifecycle from pre-fixture support to post-fixture execution and financial analysis.

This role sits at the intersection of
**commercial shipping, voyage optimization, stakeholder management, and financial performance**
. You will work closely with Chartering, vessel owners, charterers, brokers, port agents, and internal teams to ensure seamless voyage execution, optimize cargo intake and bunker consumption, manage claims, and maximize voyage profitability.

**What Will You Do?**

**Pre-Fixture Planning & Commercial Support**

* Support the Chartering Department during pre-fixture negotiations by providing accurate vessel specifications, cargo-carrying capabilities, and vessel performance history.
* Assess vessel suitability for proposed trades, considering vessel schedules, cargo requirements, port restrictions, and operational feasibility.
* Evaluate cargo hold readiness and provide relevant port-specific information to support fixture decisions.
* Assist in estimating voyage costs and assessing commercial feasibility to support informed chartering decisions.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate information is available throughout the pre-fixture process.

**Voyage Execution & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end execution of dry bulk voyages, ensuring compliance with charter-party terms and agreed voyage instructions.
* Prepare detailed voyage plans and voyage orders for Masters, optimizing cargo intake, bunker requirements, vessel scheduling, and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with brokers, charterers, vessel owners, port agents, and internal departments to facilitate smooth voyage execution on a 24/7 basis.
* Monitor vessel performance at sea, identifying deviations, delays, and operational issues, and implement timely corrective actions.
* Liaise with the accounting team to monitor outstanding receivables and support timely collections to improve cash flow.
* Handle, contest, defend, and negotiate commercial claims in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor voyage profitability and develop a thorough understanding of voyage Profit & Loss (P&L), including cost control and revenue optimization.

**Bunkering & Voyage Optimization**

* Optimize vessel cargo intake while ensuring compliance with vessel limitations, port restrictions, and operational requirements.
* Plan bunker requirements to ensure adequate fuel availability throughout the voyage, considering consumption, fuel grades, trading areas, and cost efficiency.
* Coordinate with weather-routing service providers to support optimal route selection, fuel efficiency, and vessel performance.
* Monitor voyage progress and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce avoidable costs.

**Commercial Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Negotiate and appoint port agents, ensuring reliable service delivery and cost-effective port operations.
* Plan bunker stems in accordance with vessel requirements, fuel specifications, and trading-area restrictions.
* Coordinate freight invoicing, other charterer-related billings, and post-fixture activities with the relevant teams.
* Provide accurate and timely voyage information to Claims Coordinators to support the resolution of commercial disputes.
* Review and approve Port Disbursement Accounts (PDAs), ensuring accuracy and appropriate cost control.
* Work closely with Finance, Chartering, Operations, and Post-Fixture teams to maintain seamless information flow across the voyage lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate voyage records, operational data, and documentation within company systems, ensuring data integrity and traceability.

**The Must-Haves**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum
  **5–6 years of experience in commercial shipping operations**
  , preferably in dry bulk vessel operations.
* Previous seagoing experience in a
  **management-level position aboard dry bulk vessel**
  .
* Strong understanding of pre-fixture operations, voyage execution, and post-fixture processes.
* Demonstrated experience in voyage planning, vessel performance monitoring, bunker planning, and voyage cost management.
* Experience with commercial claims, charter-party matters, freight collection, and voyage P&L analysis.
* Hands-on experience with
  **IMOS or a comparable integrated maritime operations system**
  .

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong commercial understanding of the dry bulk shipping industry and voyage management practices.
* Sound knowledge of charter-party terms, cargo operations, port procedures, and vessel trading requirements.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret voyage performance data, assess costs, and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Proactive, solution-oriented approach, with the ability to anticipate challenges and take timely corrective action.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively in a dynamic, 24/7 operational environment.

**Ready to Chart Your Course?**

If you have a strong background in dry bulk commercial operations and are passionate about optimizing voyage performance and profitability, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Manager - NPI
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
Own the end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) process, from design transfer to stable commercial production. Lead cross-functional stage-gate reviews, ensuring products progress only when readiness criteria for cost, quality, supply, and operational execution are met, delivering successful launches on time and in full.
  
  
This role provides leadership and governance for the NPI portfolio, owning launch outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and stage-gate decisions. While the NPI Planner manages operational execution across materials, capacity, builds, and inventory, this role is accountable for overall NPI success and commercialization readiness.
  
  
**Key Tasks**
NPI process ownership
  
  

* Define, run and continuously improve the stage-gate NPI process (concept, design, prototype, pilot, ramp, release to mass production), including gate criteria, templates and governance.
* Run the NPI portfolio: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across concurrent projects.
* Own the handover from Technology to Operations and the transition to steady-state manufacturing.

Cross-functional evaluation and gate decisions
  
  

* Chair NPI gate reviews with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing Engineering, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Finance and Commercial.
* Assess each product for manufacturability, test and quality readiness, supplier readiness, compliance, cost and launch risk.
* Make or escalate go / no-go / conditional-go recommendations with documented risks and mitigations.

NPI delivery
  
  

* Own schedule, budget, scope and risk for each project; maintain the master NPI plan and critical path.
* Drive risk management and resolve cross-functional conflicts quickly.
* Manage contract manufacturers and key suppliers for pilot builds and ramp, where applicable.

Cost, quality and supply readiness
  
  

* Agree target cost, yield and first-pass quality with Finance, Quality and Manufacturing; track the gap to target at every gate.
* Ensure the NPI Planner’s material, capacity and build plans support each gate date and launch volume.
* Ensure change control, BOM and documentation are complete and released before production.

Lead NPI Portfolio & Performance Management
  
  

* Maintain the consolidated NPI roadmap and publish dashboards covering project health, milestone adherence, launch readiness, action closure, and post-launch performance.

Lead Export Readiness for NPI PLanning
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment and close coordination with Export teams to establish inventory strategies, distribution networks, capacity plans, and market-specific supply requirements for successful export launches.
* Govern the transition of NPI projects into business-as-usual export operations, ensuring seamless handover, supply continuity, and service reliability across all destination markets.

Leadership and stakeholder management
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the NPI team; set objectives and manage performance.
* Report on project status, risks and decisions to senior leadership and the executive team.
* Capture lessons learned after each launch and feed them back into the process.

**Experience Required**

* Graduate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Post Graduate Degree or MBA in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or Business Management will be an added advantage
* 10-12 years of Supply Chain experience with strong exposure to NPI, Planning, Product Lifecycle Management, Project Management, or Supply Chain Transformation.
* Proven experience in leading cross-functional NPI, commercialization, innovation, or product-transition programs.
* Strong understanding of Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Capacity Planning, S&OP, and phase-in/phase-out processes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across Marketing, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Strong project management, risk management, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent launches.

title: Plant Manager - Plastic Pyrolysis
description:
**1. Role Overview**

The Plant Manager is the single-point owner of the entire plastic pyrolysis plant — accountable for safe, continuous, cost-efficient conversion of mixed plastic waste into pyrolysis oil, carbon black and non-condensable gas. The role combines hands-on process engineering with full P&L, EHS and team-management responsibility. The incumbent will drive uptime, yield, quality and compliance while building the operational culture of a growing circular-economy enterprise.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Plant Operations & Production**

• Own the end-to-end pyrolysis process: feedstock preparation, shredding, reactor charging, controlled heating cycle, condensation train, oil collection, char discharge and gas handling / flare / power generation.

• Drive key operating KPIs — reactor availability (target ≥ 85%), oil yield (target ≥ 55% on dry feed basis for mixed PE/PP/PS, ≥ 40% for mixed MSW plastic), carbon black and non-condensable gas yields, batch cycle time, specific energy consumption (kWh/MT feed).

• Monitor and optimise reactor temperature profile (typical 350–450 °C), residence time, catalyst loading (if used), condenser temperatures and vacuum/pressure control.

• Oversee daily, weekly and monthly production planning, feedstock scheduling and batch sheet closure.

**B. Safety, Health & Environment (SHE)**

• Enforce zero-tolerance safety culture — pyrolysis is a high-hazard operation (flammable vapours, high temperature, hydrocarbon gas inventory). Target: zero LTI.

• Implement and audit HAZOP, Permit-to-Work (PTW), LOTO, hot-work, confined-space and emergency response procedures.

• Ensure full compliance with CPCB / SPCB norms (air emissions, water discharge, hazardous waste handling under HWM Rules 2016), Factory Act 1948, PESO (if LPG/diesel storage > threshold), and Fire NOC.

• Lead monthly mock drills, SHE committee meetings, incident investigation and CAPA closure.

**C. Quality & Product**

• Ensure pyrolysis oil meets agreed buyer specifications — density, calorific value (typical 38–42 MJ/kg target), flash point, water content, sulphur, viscosity, solids content.

• Oversee in-house QC lab or external testing arrangements; sign off every tanker COA before dispatch.

• Drive upgrading initiatives — distillation, de-chlorination, de-sulphurisation if required by customer specs or regulatory norms.

**D. Feedstock, Supply Chain & Costs**

• Secure daily feedstock requirement in coordination with Procurement; vet aggregators and MRFs on quality, moisture, chlorine (PVC) content and heavy metals.

• Own the plant P&L — monthly budget vs. actual on feedstock cost, utilities, consumables, labour, maintenance, logistics.

• Drive cost-per-MT-feed and cost-per-litre-oil improvement; identify yield and energy recovery projects.

**E. Maintenance & Reliability**

• Lead preventive maintenance program for reactor shell, agitator seals, condensers, pumps, blowers, scrubbers, DG sets and material-handling equipment.

• Plan annual turnaround / shutdown — reactor coke removal, refractory inspection, pipe-flange integrity, PRV testing.

• Maintain MRO inventory within budgeted norms and critical-spares list.

**F. Team Leadership & Culture**

• Lead a team of 10-20 people across operations, maintenance, QC, logistics and admin (depending on plant size and shift pattern).

• Build shift supervisor capability, drive on-the-job training and SOP adherence, run daily shift handover meetings.

**G. Regulatory, Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

• Interface with CPCB/SPCB, Factory Inspector, Pollution Control Board auditors, EPR authorities and local administration.

• Submit timely monthly/quarterly compliance returns, EPR reporting under Plastic Waste Management Rules. & ISCC data

• Report weekly operations dashboard to Director/CEO (production, safety, quality, costs, HR, deviations).

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

• B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering or Polymer Engineering from a recognised institute. M.Tech or MBA (Operations) a plus.

• 3–10 years' total experience in process plant operations, with minimum 2 years in a Plant Manager / Deputy Plant Manager role.

• Direct hands-on experience in pyrolysis, waste-to-energy, refinery/distillation, bitumen, carbon black, rubber recycling, biomass gasification, or similar thermal process plant preferred.

• Demonstrated P&L accountability for a plant of ≥ 20 MT/day throughput or equivalent.

• Thorough working knowledge of HAZOP, PSSR, MOC, and IS/OSHA safety frameworks.

• Working knowledge of CPCB, PCB, PWM Rules 2016 (and amendments), EPR regulations, and ISO 9001/14001/45001 & ISCC implementation.

• Experience managing unionised or semi-skilled workforce in a plant environment.

• Computer-literate —ERP (production module), MS Excel modelling, basic DCS/SCADA familiarity.

**4. Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

• Prior exposure to continuous or semi-continuous pyrolysis reactor designs (rotary kiln, auger, fluidised bed).

• Experience in product quality upgradation (fractional distillation, hydrotreatment, catalytic cracking) for pyrolysis-derived oil.

• Experience selling or qualifying pyrolysis oil to industrial end-users (cement kilns, steel re-rolling mills, boilers, co-processing).

• Exposure to Carbon Credit / Plastic Credit / EPR trading mechanisms.

• Published or filed patents / papers in plastic pyrolysis or waste-to-energy space.

**5. Core Competencies**

• Hands-on, floor-walking leadership style — minimum 60% time on the shop floor expected.

• First-principles process engineering thinking — ability to diagnose yield drops, deviations and reactor upsets without external support.

• Strong commercial instinct — understands that every rupee saved per MT feedstock or per litre of oil flows to the P&L.

• Cool-headed in crisis — can run an emergency shutdown or incident response without escalation.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication; confident with regulators and buyers alike.

• Builder's mentality — comfortable working in an entrepreneurial, resource-constrained early-growth environment.

**6. Success Metrics (First 12 Months)**

• Reactor availability raised to ≥ 85% from baseline.

• Pyrolysis oil yield improved by at least 3 percentage points vs. baseline.

• Zero reportable safety incidents (LTI = 0, fire incidents = 0).

• 100% CPCB/SPCB compliance — no show-cause notices, no closure notices.

• Plant conversion cost (₹ per MT feed) reduced by ≥ 8% vs. baseline.

• Shift-supervisor team upskilled: 100% certified on SOPs; one supervisor identified as successor-track.

• Reporting location: VASAI , Mumbai

• Working pattern: general shift with on-call responsibility; plant runs 24×7 on 3-shift pattern.

**7. How to Apply**

Interested candidates may share their updated CV, current CTC and notice period with Bioplastica Energy Pvt. Ltd.( Group company of Emco Dyestuff Pvt Ltd ) via the  contact point

title: Tournament Director
description:
**Kabuni Premier League (KPL)**

**About Kabuni**

Kabuni is a sports technology company combining AI, biomechanics and sports science to make high-quality coaching more accessible. Starting with cricket, we’re building tools and pathways to help players develop their skills and reach their potential.

Through the Kabuni Premier League (KPL), we’re creating opportunities for young cricketers to progress through auditions, training camps and franchise teams, connecting grassroots talent with structured player development.

**About Role**

You’ll lead the planning and delivery of a safe, well-run and engaging KPL tournament, bringing together cricket competition, participant logistics, venues, staffing and event operations.

Your responsibility starts well before tournament week: building the team, securing resources, managing the budget and ensuring everything is ready before participants arrive. You’ll lead live delivery through to safe departures and post-event review.

The tournament is being planned for up to 12 franchises, each with 15 selected players—180 players at full scale—alongside coaches, support staff and other attendees.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Plan and prepare the tournament:**
  Develop the timetable, budget, staffing model and operating plan. Appoint delivery partners, agree responsibilities and lead readiness reviews and rehearsals.
* **Ensure child safety and welfare:**
  Work with safeguarding specialists to establish qualified safeguarding, welfare and medical provision, appropriate staffing checks, supervision, consent and emergency procedures across all tournament activities.
* **Coordinate participant logistics:**
  Manage agreed travel arrangements, transfers, accommodation where required, meals, hydration and equipment movements. Ensure clear communication and safe participant handovers.
* **Deliver the cricket competition:**
  Work with cricket leadership to coordinate fixtures, venues, pitches, practice facilities, officials, scoring, equipment and coach availability.
* **Manage event operations:**
  Coordinate accreditation, security, spectators, accessibility, facilities, ceremonies and agreed guest and sponsor commitments. Work with specialists on permissions, insurance and supplier requirements.
* **Plan promotion and production:**
  Develop costed proposals for photography, filming, streaming or broadcasting. Deliver the approved scope with Marketing and production partners, ensuring appropriate permissions, child-image consent and content handling.
* **Lead live delivery:**
  Run daily briefings, event communications and operational decisions. Maintain contingency plans for weather, transport disruption, medical incidents and other delivery issues.
* **Control budgets and suppliers:**
  Track costs with Finance, manage changes and hold partners accountable for agreed deliverables.
* **Complete the handover and close-out:**
  Agree squad-information and readiness requirements with franchise teams, oversee safe departures, reconcile supplier costs and complete incident follow-up and the post-event review.

**What you'll bring**

* Proven experience leading complex, multi-day sporting events or tournaments.
* Experience building and managing multidisciplinary teams, agencies and suppliers.
* Strong operational planning skills across venues, transport, accommodation and participant logistics.
* Practical experience implementing safeguarding and welfare arrangements for children and young people.
* Confidence managing budgets, supplier commitments and changes to scope.
* Calm judgement under pressure, with the ability to resolve issues and escalate decisions appropriately.
* Clear communication with delivery teams, franchise representatives, families and senior stakeholders.

Experience in cricket tournaments and coordinating event filming, streaming or broadcast production would be an advantage.

**What success looks like**

* Teams, venues, suppliers and safety arrangements ready before participants arrive.
* Children safely supervised and supported throughout their tournament experience.
* Reliable transport, logistics and daily operations.
* Fixtures and agreed event activities delivered successfully.
* Positive feedback from players, families and franchise teams.
* Delivery within the approved budget, with complete records and actions followed through.

Through close commercial partnership with the front office, global trading teams and external logistics providers, you will drive efficient, reliable and cost-effective execution across trucking, warehousing, inventory and delivery operations.

The role will focus on building and strengthening back office processes, leveraging data and digital tools, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement to enhance operational performance, visibility and control. You will also lead and develop a high-performing operations team that plays an integral role in supporting the seamless, compliant and commercially effective movement of cotton.

**Position Title:**
Head of Execution India - Cotton

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Position Type:**
Full-time

**Schedule:**
Office based

**Business Overview**

**ED&F Man Cotton**
driven by an ambition to become a leading trader of raw cotton, serving customers around the world. The breadth of ED&F Man Commodities existing operations provides ED&F Man Cotton with offices in major cotton producing regions and expertise in operating sustainable containerised supply chains, underpinned by robust risk management procedures.

ED&F Man is owned by
**Hartree Partners, LP**
a leading global merchant commodities firm facilitating the flow of energy, metals, agriculture, and environmental products across the full commodity supply chain, connecting producers and consumers. Hartree was founded in 1997, is jointly owned by senior management and funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, LP, and employs around 5,000 individuals worldwide.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end domestic execution of cotton trades, including trucking, warehousing, inventory movements, delivery scheduling and documentation.
* With support from the Head of Cotton India, build middle and back office resources to enable execution of significant volumes of Indian raw cotton.
* Coordinate with trading, contracts, finance and commercial teams to ensure efficient and timely contract fulfilment.
* Manage trucking, warehousing and third-party logistics providers, ensuring agreed service, cost and performance standards are met.
* Monitor operational performance, resolve delivery and inventory issues, and proactively identify and mitigate operational risks.
* Maintain appropriate operational controls, governance and auditable records across domestic logistics activities.
* Develop strong relationships with key service providers and drive accountability against agreed KPIs and service levels.
* Collaborate with global and regional operations teams to share best practice and leverage existing capabilities.
* Ensure the operations team, processes and capabilities remain fit-for-purpose as the business develops.
* Optimise existing systems and digital workflows across trucking, warehousing, inventory and trade execution, reducing manual intervention and operational errors.
* Develop and enhance data-driven dashboards and KPIs covering transport performance, warehouse utilisation, inventory, costs, service levels and exceptions.
* Use data, root-cause analysis and benchmarking to identify and deliver measurable improvements, ensuring benefits are sustained.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging simplification of processes, better use of technology and stronger cross-functional collaboration.

**Skills and Experience:**

* 7-12 years’ operations management experience within agricultural commodities, with strong preference for experience in the cotton trading industry.
* Proven experience managing domestic logistics operations, including trucking, warehousing, inventory movements, delivery execution and third-party service providers.
* Strong understanding of commodity trade operations, contract fulfilment, operational controls and risk management.
* Demonstrated track record of continuous improvement, with the ability to identify inefficiencies, analyse root causes and deliver measurable improvements to processes, cost and service.
* Experience using data, systems and digital tools to improve operational visibility, automate workflows and enhance performance management.
* Strategic and commercially minded, combined with a hands-on, pragmatic and problem-solving approach in a fast-paced trading environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across trading, finance, operations and external logistics providers.
* Strong analytical skills, commercial acumen and attention to detail, with confidence working with operational KPIs and performance data.
* Proficiency in Excel and supply chain/commodity management systems; experience with ITAS or similar trade execution systems is highly desirable.
* Cotton industry experience and knowledge of the specific operational challenges of cotton trading, storage and domestic distribution would be highly advantageous.

*We recognise that talent comes in many forms, and we value potential just as much as experience. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.*

**Our Offer**

We provide a fast-paced, stimulating and truly global environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the global leaders in soft commodity trading.

**Our Values**

**Respect, Integrity, Meritocracy, Client Focus, Entrepreneurship**

Our values define who we are. They are the fundamental beliefs that determine our actions and guide our behaviour. They influence the way we communicate and collaborate, and define the way we engage with our clients, partners, and communities. **Data Center Site Portfolio Management:**

**Performance Monitoring and Analysis:**

title: Job Delivery Lead
description:
The Job Delivery Lead is responsible for directing the field employee in safe, reliable, and efficient product and service delivery. The Job Delivery Lead is also responsible for driving customer satisfaction and service quality while ensuring an efficient cost structure, and drives field employee progression through competency development and performance evaluation. This person collaborates with the OU PSD or PSD Manager for job life cycle support including technical and incident management, and ensures systematic usage of standard work and risk management throughout the service delivery process. The Job Delivery Lead provides visibility regarding crew and associated functions’ SQ performance and improvement opportunities, and is responsible for the COSD (i.e.resource consumption.)
  
  

* Identify service category and sign off on staffing model (multiskilling, remote operations, crew size).
* Verify projected resource plan (assets, products, and workforce).
* Manage PSD risk life cycle for low- and medium-risk and short-term high-risk jobs.
* Review and approve technical job program.
* Perform, consolidate, and analyze JRAs and generate exemptions and MOCs as needed.
* Approve JRA based on job risk level and CA score.
* Conduct pre- and postjob briefs for every job. Discuss and communicate risks and controls to field personnel.
* Manage incident life cycle for medium- and low-severity incidents, escalating as needed, and conduct incident response and recovery.
* Assist PSD Manager in incident investigation, validation of results, and reviews.
* Manage service delivery process to exceed customer expectations.
* Manage all job incidents and job changes, in the form of exemptions and MOCs.
* Manage quality control of all field deliverables.
* Ensure customer acceptance of service delivery.
* Ensure support to other functional processes with proper handoffs at key interfaces.
* Performs field operations as required.

10-12 years
