title: AVP Operations
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking helps deliver HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing customers with borderless banking and wealth management through mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enables us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs across key markets and corridors.
  
  
**Role purpose**
The Assistant Vice President – Fund Operations will manage end-to-end fund and broking operations, including client pay-in and payout, exchange clearing and settlement, treasury, banking, reconciliations, operational accounting, regulatory reporting, audit support and process improvement.
  
  
The role will ensure accurate and timely processing of client and firm funds, exchange obligations and settlement activities while maintaining strong controls, appropriate segregation of duties and compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, clearing corporation, depository and internal requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Fund settlement and client operations
* Manage daily client fund pay-in and payout activities across applicable products and segments.
* Process client transfers through NEFT, RTGS, CMS and other approved channels within prescribed cut-off times.
* Validate payment instructions, approvals, beneficiary details and supporting documentation.
* Post transactions accurately to client ledgers and operational systems.
* Monitor and resolve rejected, returned, delayed or failed payments.
* Process monthly and quarterly settlement payouts from preparation through approval and release.
* Support client transactions including dividend payments, buy-back, OFS, margin movements and NRI client pay-in and payout.
* Ensure appropriate segregation and utilisation of client funds.
* Maintain maker-checker evidence, payment records and audit trails.
* Resolve operational queries relating to fund transfers, payouts, demat charges, account opening, penalties and settlement status.
* Exchange clearing and settlement
* Prepare daily exchange obligations and arrange funds for timely pay-in and settlement.
* Manage exchange pay-in, payout and settlement activities across relevant segments.
* Post exchange obligation entries in the appropriate segment and accounting systems.
* Monitor exchange calendars, settlement timelines and payment cut-offs.
* Coordinate with Treasury, Finance, banks, exchanges and clearing corporations to meet obligations.
* Investigate shortages, unmatched items, failed payments and delayed confirmations.
* Maintain settlement trackers, exception logs and escalation reports.
* Support margin and exchange requirements, including appropriate use of available funds and fixed deposits.
* Prepare or review weekly bank-balance submissions and weekly/monthly SEBI and exchange reports.
* Treasury and banking operations
* Support treasury activities covering funding, disbursements, investments, concentration and inter-account transfers.
* Review daily cash and bank positions across client, settlement, operational and firm accounts.
* Arrange funding based on exchange obligations, client payouts and business requirements.
* Coordinate with bank relationship managers on payment issues, confirmations and account matters.
* Support investment of surplus funds in approved instruments, including mutual funds and fixed deposits where permitted.
* Maintain accurate records of investments, redemptions, transfers and funding transactions.
* Process vendor, exchange, clearing corporation, depository and service-provider payments through approved channels.
* Monitor unusual, unauthorised or delayed fund movements and escalate promptly.
* Reconciliations and financial controls
* Oversee daily reconciliations for client and settlement bank accounts, firm accounts, client ledgers, exchanges, depositories, mutual funds and dividends.
* Investigate reconciliation breaks, identify root causes and complete corrective action within agreed timelines.
* Escalate aged or recurring breaks through the appropriate governance channels.
* Validate bank entries, charges, interest, reversals, unidentified receipts and payment confirmations.
* Post correction entries in accordance with approved procedures.
* Perform AMC-wise mutual fund accounting and reconciliation where applicable.
* Reconcile dividend records, payments and client ledger postings.
* Maintain accurate daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation summaries.
* Ensure effective maker-checker, access and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Accounting, tax and management reporting
* Ensure accurate posting of client receipts, payouts, exchange obligations, bank transactions and settlement entries.
* Reconcile operational records to general ledger and accounting systems.
* Support month-end closing, accruals, provisions, trial balances, income statements and balance-sheet schedules.
* Prepare or review expense reconciliations, prepaid expenses, vendor payment schedules, debit notes, credit notes, fixed-asset records and group-company workings.
* Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, employee reimbursements, payroll-related payments and petty cash.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS covering settlement, liquidity, reconciliations, payouts and exceptions.
* Support preparation of GST, TDS and stamp-duty data.
* Arrange TDS payments and support quarterly TDS return filing.
* Coordinate TDS refund claims with exchanges and maintain follow-up records.
* Validate vendor invoices and investigate higher-than-expected charges.
* Regulatory reporting and audit
* Prepare daily client-fund segregation reports accurately and within prescribed timelines.
* Validate balances between bank accounts, client ledgers, settlement records and reporting outputs.
* Support compliance with SEBI, exchange, clearing corporation, depository, banking and internal requirements.
* Provide data for exchange enhancement, bank-balance, margin and other operational reports.
* Coordinate responses to internal, statutory and exchange audits and regulatory inspections.
* Prepare audit evidence including bank statements, reconciliations, client-fund reports, exchange reports, payment records, approvals, SOPs and exception logs.
* Track audit observations, action owners, remediation plans and closure dates.
* Ensure SOPs and process notes reflect current regulatory and operational requirements.
* Systems and process improvement
* Support implementation and stabilisation of fund-settlement processes in live environments.
* Participate in UAT for new products, system changes, settlement processes and regulatory updates.
* Prepare test scenarios, validate results and coordinate resolution of defects.
* Work with Technology and Product teams on back-office, settlement, accounting and production issues.
* Identify opportunities to automate reconciliations, payouts, reporting and settlement tracking.
* Monitor operational SLAs, recurring issues and incidents.
* Drive improvements while preserving control effectiveness, segregation of duties and auditability.

**Governance, risk and stakeholder management**

* Operate within HSBC’s risk-management framework, internal policies and approved procedures.
* Identify, assess and escalate operational risks, incidents, control weaknesses and potential segregation issues.
* Maintain incident logs, root-cause analyses, corrective-action plans and audit trails.
* Protect confidential client, financial and business information.
* Support business continuity and operational resilience activities.
* Maintain effective relationships with Finance, Treasury, Compliance, Risk, Technology, Product, Client Service and Front Office teams.
* Coordinate with exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories, banks, asset-management companies, auditors and vendors.
* Ensure issues are assigned clearly, followed through and closed with supporting evidence.

**Team leadership**

* Lead day-to-day fund-operations activities and allocate work according to volumes, deadlines, skills and risk.
* Review team outputs and ensure that critical controls are completed consistently.
* Coach team members on settlement, reconciliation, payment and regulatory processes.
* Maintain cross-training and back-up coverage for critical activities.
* Set objectives and monitor performance against agreed service levels.
* Promote ownership, collaboration, inclusion and continuous improvement.
* Support team development and succession planning.

**Qualifications And Experience**
**Education**

* Graduate degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting or a related discipline.
* MBA in Finance or an equivalent qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum 7 years’ relevant experience in fund operations, stock broking operations, clearing and settlement, treasury, depository operations or back-office accounting.
* Experience supervising client-money, exchange-settlement or fund-operation activities.
* Strong experience in:

+ Client pay-in and payout
+ Exchange obligations and settlement
+ Treasury and liquidity management
+ Bank, client-ledger and exchange reconciliations
+ Operational accounting and month-end closing
+ Dividend, buy-back and OFS processing
+ NRI client transactions
+ GST, TDS and stamp-duty support
+ Audit and inspection responses
+ System implementation, UAT or process improvement

* Experience working with banks, exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories and auditors.

**Certifications**

* Mandatory: NISM Series VII – Securities Operations and Risk Management.
* Preferred: NISM Series VI – Depository Operations; NISM Series VIII – Equity Derivatives; NISM Series XXIV – AML and CFT Provisions.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of broking back-office, fund settlement and exchange operations.
* Understanding of client-fund segregation, clearing, settlement and banking controls.
* Strong reconciliation, exception-management and analytical skills.
* Knowledge of operational accounting, GST, TDS and statutory processes.
* Experience with systems such as Class, LD, TWS, Sun Systems, Tally or equivalent platforms.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

**Behavioural competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work under strict deadlines and settlement cut-offs.
* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis capability.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Effective stakeholder and vendor management.
* Sound judgement when handling confidential information.
* Collaborative, accountable and control-conscious approach.
* Commitment to ethical conduct, operational resilience and customer outcomes.

**Key performance indicators**

* Client and exchange pay-in and payout completed within agreed timelines.
* Settlement obligations met within prescribed cut-offs.
* Accurate client-ledger, exchange and accounting postings.
* Daily completion of bank, client and exchange reconciliations.
* Reduction in aged and recurring reconciliation breaks.
* Timely submission of client-fund segregation and regulatory reports.
* Accurate and timely MIS and management reporting.
* Audit and inspection queries closed within agreed timelines.
* Effective management of payment exceptions and incidents.
* Successful completion of UAT and process improvements.
* Compliance with maker-checker, access and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Positive stakeholder and client-service outcomes.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  

* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by HSBC relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by HSBC InvestDirect Securities (India) Private Limited

title: Lead - Security Automation & Loss Prevention
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Lead - Security Automation & Loss Prevention is responsible for leading and managing the day-to-day operations of the security automation and loss prevention team. This involves maintaining of security equipment with highest availability and adherence to maintenance strategy. The role requires design evaluation, implementing and maintaining security system and technologies, optimizing processes to prevent revenue leakage, and ensuring compliance with established security protocols. The Lead also drives team performance, supports investigation and risk management efforts, and works closely with the Security Head to meet regulatory, financial and operational objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operational Support and Technology Evaluation:**
Oversee the deployment and evaluation of design parameters of security systems like surveillance, , radio communication, screening system (CTiX, XBis, FBS, DFMD, ETD, EVD, LED etc.) access controls and attendance system, video management, radio active detection equipment's, QRT equipments, BDDS equipment and intrusion detection.
  
  
Ensure highest availability of Airport security control room like SOCC (Security Control Centre), AHCR (Anti Hijack Control Room) for smooth operation and optimum vigilance of the Airport.
  
  
Ensure maintenance (preventive, corrective and predictive) and up gradation of the installed security automations systems, applications, equipment and other technology assets, ensuring the highest availability and maintenance standards for security technologies and systems.
  
  
Regularly evaluate the effectiveness of implemented technologies and suggest improvements to meet operational needs.
  
  
Ensure implementation of regulatory orders, audit points for enhancing the deployed security system in Airport.
  
  
Ensure implementation of visitor access card management system, CACS system and the Airport Entry Permit System (AEP) in coordination with pass section teams.
  
  
**Team Leadership And Development**
Lead the security automation and loss prevention team, ensuring the successful implementation of security technologies and processes.
  
  
Develop and update operational policies, procedures, and protocols to improve team performance and security standards.
  
  
**Loss Prevention And Technology Integration**
Collaborate with business operations and IT teams to deploy security solutions aimed at preventing revenue leakage / loss prevention and improving operational efficiency.
  
  
Ensure seamless integration of technology-driven solutions, such as data analytics and intelligent video management to monitor and reduce incidents.
  
  
Lead/ assist in security automation Project implementation at airports in coordination with respective stakeholders.
  
  
**Incident And Risk Management**
Monitor security risk assessments and ensure that mitigation strategies are effectively implemented to address emerging threats and risks.
  
  
Lead investigations into security breaches, fraud, and theft, ensuring timely action and reporting to senior management.
  
  
**Budget And Resource Management**
Assist in the preparation and monitoring of the security automation and loss prevention budget, ensuring financial resources are optimally allocated.
  
  
Work with the Head of Security Automation to address any budgetary discrepancies and ensure adherence to financial goals.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring And Reporting**
Track and report on the performance of security systems and loss prevention initiatives to ensure KPIs and objectives are met.
  
  
Conduct regular reviews with the team to assess progress, resolve issues, and implement necessary corrective actions.
  
  
Employ a analytics driven approach to identify incidence trends and implement security technology measures for mitigation.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
CSO- Asset/ CSO BU
  
  
Lead - Security Automation- HO
  
  
Security Operations Team
  
  
IT Department
  
  
Asset Security Teams
  
  
Business Operations Team
  
  
Loss Prevention Team
  
  
Finance and Budgeting Teams
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Security Technology Providers
  
  
Contractors and Implementation Partners
  
  
External Auditors
  
  
Regulatory Bodies
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor of Technology/Engineering in Electronics or related field
  
  
Preferable to have Certifications including Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP/CCNA), CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional), Project Management Professional and other related certifications.
  
  
**Experiences**
10 - 20 years ( Depending on Site Complexity and Requirement) of work experience in in managing security automation, technology systems and loss prevention initiatives. Preferably to have experience of deployment and managing multiple security systems (such as CCTV/ACS/ PIDS/ Screening & Surveillance systems etc) Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage site-level security operations.

title: Operations Governance Manager
description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?
  
  
AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
  
  
Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
  
  
Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
  
  
**A Snapshot**
As Operations Governance Manager, you will report to the Director of Operations Governance and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:
  
  

* You will work closely with key business teams to drive, structure, and deliver key data centre operational excellence, governance and compliance initiatives across the APJ region.
* You will advise on and shape data centre operational excellence and assurance throughout AirTrunk, including the initiation and delivery of new build sites, ensuring compliance from a risk management perspective to enable the rapid expansion of AirTrunk data centre developments across APJ.
* You will be able to hone new skills and expertise in related workstreams as required, including risk management, business continuity, and emergency response, developing an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s operations and providing strategic operational initiatives.

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Management of data centre operational excellence, governance and controls.
* Support the development and implementation of consistent operational practices across regions and sites.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, procedures, controls and supporting tools.
* Monitor recurring findings and trends to determine whether broader organisational improvements are required.
* Assist and support assurance activities for all operating sites including; external, internal, client, certification and insurer assurance.
* Management of DC sites’ assurance, measuring and monitoring adherence to operational process and procedures.  Give feedback to sites on common shortcomings and risk consequence.
* Coordinate and undertake Severity 1 drills for DC sites, following up on identified lessons learnt and improvements.
* Lead or support improvement initiatives arising from assurance findings, incidents, drills, controlled self-assessments and lessons learned.
* Monitor and support site teams in the delivery of their Business Continuity, Emergency response and any other required resiliency planning.
* Monitor nominated document owners and managers, in timely review and update of their business unit relevant documentation and keep the Governance owned frameworks and policies up to date for review in consultation with stakeholders.
* Support Operations teams in identifying and understanding relevant regulatory, statutory, certification and internal compliance obligations.
* Work with relevant subject matter experts to assess changes in regulatory or compliance requirements that may impact Data Centre Operations.
* Assessment and tracking of DC sites operational risk, working with site teams to effectively manage, control and/or mitigate these risks.

**Requirements**

* Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent professional experience in operations, engineering, risk, compliance, governance, quality or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in operational governance, assurance, compliance, risk management or operational excellence.
* Experience working within a critical infrastructure, data centre, engineering, utilities, facilities management or similarly high-reliability operational environment.
* Strong understanding of operational risk and control principles.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse complex operational issues and identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to travel regularly across operational sites within the APAC region.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to create and direct cross-functional group forums for managing risks.

**The AirTrunk Culture**
Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.
  
  
The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.
  
  
Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.
  
  
Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.
  
  

* To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.\*\*

title: Service Request Manager
description:
Job description:
  
  
Service Request Manager

**Location:**
India, Mumbai

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business-to-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.

About the Role

Agfa is seeking a service-oriented and process-driven
**Service Request Manager**
to join its Global ICS (Information & Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management and continuous improvement of the Service Request Management process, ensuring that users receive standard IT services efficiently, consistently, and within agreed service levels.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders, managed service providers, and technical teams to optimize request fulfillment, enhance user experience, and improve operational efficiency through governance, automation, and process excellence. As part of the global IT Service Management organization, you will help ensure that service requests are delivered in a scalable, compliant, and customer-focused manner.

About You (Skills Required)

You are highly organized, customer-focused, and passionate about delivering efficient IT services. You enjoy improving processes, collaborating across teams, and leveraging data to enhance service performance and user satisfaction.

You possess:

* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* A customer-centric mindset with a focus on service quality and user experience.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and supplier management skills.
* Strong process governance and organizational capabilities.
* A continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation and service optimization.

 What You'll Do (Duties & Responsibilities)

* Own and continuously improve the global Service Request Management process.
* Ensure efficient and timely fulfillment of service requests in accordance with agreed service levels.
* Manage and maintain the IT Service Catalogue, ensuring services remain accurate, relevant, and easy to consume.
* Coordinate the resolution and fulfillment of complex service requests involving multiple teams and service providers.
* Monitor service request performance, identify trends, and drive service improvements through reporting and analytics.
* Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to optimize service delivery and request fulfillment processes.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience.
* Establish and maintain governance controls to ensure compliance with IT Service Management standards and policies.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, service request workflows, and operational procedures.

* Monitor and manage the spa budget, including tracking expenses, managing inventory, and maximizing revenue.

* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and execute promotional strategies, special offers, and events that drive spa traffic and enhance guest engagement.
* Assist in creating engaging content for social media and other marketing channels to promote spa services and wellness programs.

* Ensure that all spa treatments and services are delivered in accordance with Fairmont’s quality standards and regulatory requirements.
* Implement and monitor procedures to ensure compliance with health, safety, and hygiene regulations.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented
**Operations Manager**
to oversee the day-to-day operations of 4–5 HSquare student hostel properties across Mumbai. The role involves managing property teams, ensuring smooth functioning across locations, maintaining service standards, resolving student concerns, and driving operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibility:**

* **Multi-Property Management:**
  Oversee daily operations across 4–5 properties, ensuring smooth functioning and consistent service standards.
* **Team Management:**
  Supervise Property Managers and on-ground teams across housekeeping, front office, security, food & beverage, and maintenance.
* **Student Experience:**
  Ensure timely resolution of student complaints, manage feedback, and maintain high levels of student satisfaction.
* **Property Standards:**
  Conduct regular inspections to ensure cleanliness, hygiene, safety, maintenance, and adherence to HSquare standards.
* **Maintenance & Repairs:**
  Monitor repair and maintenance activities, track pending work, and ensure timely closure of issues.
* **Operational Audits:**
  Conduct routine property audits and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* **Occupancy & Room Readiness:**
  Coordinate room readiness, student move-ins and move-outs, and vacant bed management.
* **Cost & Resource Control:**
  Monitor property expenses, control operational costs, and ensure efficient utilisation of manpower and resources.
* **Process Compliance:**
  Ensure adherence to company SOPs, reporting systems, checklists, and operational policies.
* **Performance Monitoring:**
  Track property-level KPIs, team productivity, service quality, and issue-resolution timelines.
* **Coordination:**
  Work closely with central teams, vendors, and property managers to ensure seamless execution of business requirements.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* 4–7 years of experience in operations, preferably in hospitality, hotels, student housing, or property management.
* Experience managing multiple properties or locations will be an advantage.
* Strong team management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle student concerns and operational challenges effectively.
* Good understanding of housekeeping, maintenance, front office, and facility management.
* Strong follow-up, planning, reporting, and execution skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly between properties across Mumbai.

**KPI:**

* Smooth day-to-day functioning of all assigned properties.
* Student satisfaction and complaint-resolution turnaround time.
* Property cleanliness, hygiene, and audit scores.
* Timely closure of maintenance issues.
* Manpower productivity and attendance compliance.
* Operational cost control and SOP adherence.
* Property readiness and service quality.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A hands-on leader who can manage multiple properties, develop strong teams, solve problems proactively, and ensure consistent service excellence across the HSquare portfolio.

title: Club Manager
description:
1. Facility Management

* Oversee the maintenance, cleanliness, and functionality of all club areas (gym floor, locker rooms, pool, spa, studios, etc.).
* Coordinate with vendors, technicians, and contractors for repairs, servicing, and facility upgrades.
* Ensure all equipment is in working order and regularly serviced.
* Maintain compliance with health and safety regulations, including fire safety, sanitation, and emergency protocols.

2. Club Operations

* Manage day-to-day club operations, including front desk, member services, and fitness staff.
* Implement and monitor standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure high operational efficiency.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement strategies to achieve revenue and retention goals.
* Manage inventory and procurement for club supplies and consumables.

3. Staff Supervision & Development

* Recruit, train, and manage club staff including trainers, customer service, maintenance, and support staff.
* Schedule and supervise shifts to ensure proper staff coverage and performance.
* Foster a positive team environment and provide ongoing coaching and development opportunities.

4. Member Engagement & Customer Service

* Ensure a high standard of customer service and satisfaction across all touchpoints.
* Handle member complaints and concerns with professionalism and prompt resolution.
* Organize events, challenges, or member engagement initiatives to promote retention and community.

5. Budgeting & Financial Oversight

* Assist in preparing and managing club budgets and expenses.
* Monitor revenue streams (memberships, personal training, classes) and control operational costs.
* Generate and review operational reports and financial performance data.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Sahil Enterprises India Pvt Ltd is a growing organization operating within the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, focused on delivering high-quality products and services to its clients. The company places strong emphasis on efficient production processes, consistent output, and meeting customer expectations. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that improve operational performance and product quality. Sahil Enterprises India Pvt Ltd values integrity, accountability, and collaboration, creating a professional environment for long-term career growth.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Production Manager role based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The Production Manager will oversee daily production operations, ensuring that manufacturing schedules are met while maintaining quality, safety, and cost efficiency. Responsibilities include planning and allocating resources, coordinating with procurement and logistics, monitoring equipment performance, and resolving production issues in real time. The role involves leading and mentoring production staff, implementing standard operating procedures, tracking key performance indicators, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. The Production Manager will also collaborate with management to forecast demand, optimize capacity, and support strategic projects related to process enhancement and product delivery.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in production or manufacturing management, including oversight of daily operations and team leadership.
* Strong skills in planning, scheduling, and resource allocation to meet production targets and deadlines.
* Knowledge of quality control standards, safety regulations, and process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) is highly beneficial.
* Ability to analyze data, monitor KPIs, and use production metrics to drive performance and cost optimization.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage a diverse workforce.
* Proficiency with basic computer applications and production-related software or ERP systems.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, Production Management, Operations, or a related field; relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Proven ability to work on-site in a fast-paced environment, handle multiple priorities, and make sound decisions under time constraints.

title: INP066: Sr. Specialist, Supply Chain Operations
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supervisor – Supply Chain Operations (Pharma Vertical in 3PL logistics ) with 10–15 years of experience in supply chain and logistics operations in India, with strong expertise in 3PL, contract logistics and customer-centric supply chain operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing complex supply chain operations for Pharma and/or MedTech customers, with a strong understanding of the specific quality, compliance, service and operational requirements associated with these industries.
  
  
The role will be responsible for managing end-to-end supply chain operations, driving operational excellence, improving productivity and service levels, ensuring compliance, managing customer relationships, and delivering sustainable cost and profitability improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Supply Chain Operations
* Lead and manage day-to-day 3PL / contract logistics operations across assigned customer accounts or locations.
* Ensure smooth and efficient execution of warehousing, inventory, order fulfillment, distribution and transportation activities.
* Translate customer requirements and contractual commitments into effective operational plans.
* Ensure achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, service levels and operational targets.
* Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective actions for gaps and deviations.
* Manage operational capacity in line with business volumes, seasonality and customer growth.
* Ensure business continuity and effective contingency planning.
* Pharma & MedTech Supply Chain Operations
* Manage supply chain operations for Pharma and MedTech customers, ensuring adherence to customer-specific requirements and applicable quality standards.
* Develop a strong understanding of Pharma/MedTech supply chain requirements related to product handling, storage, inventory management, order fulfillment, distribution and traceability.
* Ensure compliance with relevant customer quality systems, SOPs and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Quality, Compliance and customer teams to manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and operational quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate handling and control of sensitive, high-value or regulated products as applicable.
* Maintain strong focus on product integrity, inventory accuracy, order accuracy and traceability.
* Customer & Stakeholder Management
* Act as a key operational point of contact for assigned customers and stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Pharma and MedTech customers.
* Conduct regular operational performance reviews and business reviews with customers.
* Understand customer priorities and proactively address service and operational concerns.
* Manage escalations effectively and ensure timely closure of customer issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and strengthen long-term partnerships.
* Work closely with Sales, Solution Design, Finance, Procurement, IT, Quality and other internal teams.
* Operational Excellence & Productivity
* Drive continuous improvement across warehouse, transportation and supply chain processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, resource utilization, process efficiency and service quality.
* Establish and monitor productivity standards for key operational activities.
* Optimize manpower, equipment, warehouse capacity and other operational resources.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive automation, digitization and technology adoption wherever commercially and operationally viable.
* Inventory & Order Management
* Ensure high levels of inventory accuracy and order fulfillment accuracy.
* Monitor inventory movements, cycle counts, stock reconciliation and inventory controls.
* Ensure timely and accurate order processing, picking, packing and dispatch.
* Monitor inventory variances, damages, losses, expiry and other inventory-related risks.
* Establish effective controls to minimize errors, rework and operational losses.
* Ensure proper documentation and system transactions across the supply chain process.
* Performance Management & Analytics
* Define, monitor and improve operational KPIs across customer accounts.
* Track metrics such as:

+ On-Time In-Full (OTIF)
+ Order Fulfillment Accuracy
+ Inventory Accuracy
+ Warehouse Productivity
+ Picking/Packing Accuracy
+ Dispatch Accuracy
+ Order Cycle Time
+ Dock-to-Stock Time
+ Cost per Order / Unit
+ Space Utilization
+ Manpower Productivity
+ Customer SLA Compliance

* Cost & Profitability Management
* Manage operating costs for assigned supply chain operations.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction, productivity improvement and margin enhancement.
* Monitor manpower, warehouse, transportation, equipment and other operating costs.
* Ensure operations perform in line with agreed financial and commercial objectives.
* Partner with Finance to monitor budget, actual costs, accruals and profitability.
* Develop and execute action plans to improve account profitability.
* Identify and implement value-creation opportunities for customers and the business.
* 3PL & Contract Logistics Management
* Manage and operate complex third-party logistics and contract logistics environments.
* Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, SLAs, SOPs and commercial commitments.
* Review operational performance against contract requirements.
* Identify contractual gaps, scope changes and opportunities for operational/commercial improvement.
* Support contract renewals, business expansions, transition projects and new customer implementations.
* Ensure effective governance mechanisms are established with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Quality, Compliance & Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer SOPs and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support internal, customer and regulatory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Establish effective operational controls to minimize risks related to inventory, quality, safety and service.
* Promote a strong culture of quality, compliance and operational discipline.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, training and SOP adherence across operations.
* Team Leadership & People Development
* Lead, develop and mentor operations teams across assigned locations/accounts.
* Establish clear performance objectives and productivity expectations.
* Build a culture of accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and develop training and development plans.
* Manage workforce planning and resource requirements in line with business volumes.
* Develop high-performing teams and succession pipelines.
* Transformation & New Business Implementation
* Support new customer onboarding, transition and implementation projects.
* Work with Solution Design and Business Development teams to translate proposed solutions into operational reality.
* Validate operational assumptions, capacity requirements, manpower plans and productivity targets.
* Lead operational readiness activities for new sites, customers, products and services.
* Ensure successful stabilization and handover of new operations to the BAU team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* MBA in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics or operations in India.
* Strong experience in 3PL / third-party contract logistics.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end supply chain or logistics operations.
* Relevant experience working with Pharma and/or MedTech customers within supply chain/logistics operations is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, transportation and distribution.
* Experience managing customer accounts and senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of operational KPIs, SLAs and contract logistics commercial models.
* Experience in productivity improvement, cost optimization and operational excellence.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP/SAP or other supply chain technology platforms is preferred.

**Preferred Industry Experience**
Candidates from organizations providing
**3PL / contract logistics services to Pharma, Healthcare, Medical Devices or Life Sciences customers**
would be strongly preferred.
  
  
**Experience With The Following Would Be An Advantage**

* Pharma distribution and logistics
* Medical device logistics
* Healthcare supply chains
* Temperature-controlled / controlled-condition logistics
* High-value product handling
* Batch / lot / serial number traceability
* Expiry management
* FEFO / FIFO inventory management
* Regulatory and customer audits
* Reverse logistics
* Product recall / quarantine processes
* Customer-specific quality and compliance requirements

The Company
  
  
FedEx Logistics provides e-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.
  
  
The Philosophy
  
  
People–Service–Profit (P-S-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well-being and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
The Culture
  
  
We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.
  
  
The Mission
  
  
We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.
  
  
We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Open Secret - Senior Manager Supply Chain
description:
**About Us:**

Open Secret is a fast-growing, innovation-driven food & beverage brand making snacks for new India. We are on a mission to transform the way India snacks by creating a range of "unjunked" food options that are delicious, healthier, and guilt-free. We blend food science, great taste, and transparency to create better-for-you products families love.

Our Founder and CEO, Ahana Gautam, is a graduate from IIT Bombay and Harvard Business School, and has a strong FMCG background - Procter & Gamble and General Mills.

We are backed by a stellar group of investors - including Matrix, Sixth Sense, Ananta Capital, Vijay Shekhar Sharma, and other prominent leaders.

Join us in the Unjunked Revolution.

**Location:**
Bhandup - Mumbai (in office)

**Experience Level:**
6-7 years

**About the Role:**

As a Manager (Supply Chain) at Open Secret, you will be at the heart of our logistics and distribution strategy. We currently fulfil all orders from our Mumbai warehouse, and this role will own two critical mandates: (1) build and scale a multi-city warehouse and last mile network across India, and (2) improve the current supply chain performance. You will be the link between demand signals, inventory planning, and on-ground logistics execution.

You will report to the Head of Operations and also work closely with founder and senior leadership from day one, owning metrics that directly drive revenue on India's top e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms - Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, FK, Amazon, etc.

This is not just another desk job! If you enjoy getting your hands dirty with data, vendors, and real operational challenges - this will be fun.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Own end-to-end PO lifecycle: Supply planning, PO creation, GRN tracking, and fill-rate analysis across channels.

- Drive warehouse network expansion: Analyse city-level sales and inventory data to identify and stand up new fulfilment nodes beyond Mumbai.

- Build and manage a last-mile vendor ecosystem: Onboard 3PL partners, define delivery SLAs, and track TAT performance rigorously.

- Monitor On-Shelf Availability (OSA) daily across all SKUs and cities; diagnose availability drops and trigger replenishment actions proactively.

- Build inventory health dashboards tracking Days of Inventory (DOI), frontend/backend stock levels, Daily Run Rate (DRR) trends, and expiry risk.

- Collaborate with sales and demand planning teams to align PO scheduling with platform promotional calendars.

- Root-cause fulfilment gaps: Analyse deficit quantities, diagnose PO state failures, and drive on-time delivery improvements with vendors.

- Set up SOPs for new warehouse nodes covering inbound, storage, and dispatch protocols.

- Take ownership of evolving supply chain priorities, demonstrating agility and adaptability in addressing new or ambiguous challenges with speed and impact.

**Key Metrics You Will Own:**

- OSA (On-Shelf Availability): Weighted % of SKUs in-stock across dark stores; directly drives offtake and platform ranking.

- PO Fill Rate: Units delivered (GRN) vs. units ordered; reflects fulfilment accuracy and reliability.

- Lead Time: Days from PO creation to GRN; impacts replenishment cadence and stock-out risk.

- DOI (Days of Inventory): Determines reorder frequency and working capital.

- Fulfilment Gap: Delta between ordered and received quantity, by city and SKU.

- Inventory Value: Working capital tied up in front-end and back-end inventory across the warehouse network.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's in engineering or related field from a tier-1 institution - IIT or BITS.

- 6 - 7 years of total work experience.

- Prior stints at companies such as Delhivery, Ecom Express, Dunzo, Shadowfax, Loadshare, Porter, or similar q-commerce / last-mile / logistics-tech startups.

- High proficiency in MS Office/Google Suite (especially Excel).

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare concise documents.

- Fast learner, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a high-growth, dynamic startup.

- Positive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to go beyond the job description as needed.

**What's in It for You?:**

- Greenfield mandate - you design and build the supply chain network from scratch, not maintain someone else's legacy system.

- Direct exposure to q-commerce operations at scale across India's top platforms.

- Exposure to business strategy and decision-making at top leadership level.

- Chance to work across diverse functions and fast-track your learning.

- Direct mentorship from founders and senior leaders.

- Accelerated growth opportunities in a growing F&B startup.

title: Crewing Officer
description:
**About the Company**

Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited (KMEW) is a fast-growing, dynamic player in the marine industry. Managing human resources at KMEW requires a distinct approach that balances corporate HR metrics with the logistical complexities of dredging operations, ship repairs, port ancillary crafts, and multi-country maritime staffing.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**General Manager – Crewing & Marine Personnel**

**Industry:**
Marine Dredging |
**Vessel Type:**
Trailing Suction Hopper Dredger (TSHD)

**Department:**
Marine Operations / Crewing |
**Reporting To:**
COO / Head – Marine Operations

**Experience:**
7-10 years in the marine industry, with relevant senior-level crewing management experience.

**1. Job Purpose**

To lead and manage the complete crewing and marine personnel function for the company's TSHD fleet, ensuring timely deployment of qualified personnel, statutory compliance, effective crew rotation, operational readiness, crew welfare, and cost optimization across all projects.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

* **Fleet Crew Management:**
  Plan and manage crew requirements, deployment, rotation, relief, and emergency replacements for all TSHDs and associated vessels.
* **Recruitment & Selection:**
  Lead recruitment of Masters, Chief Officers, Chief Engineers, marine officers, dredge operators, engine-room personnel, and ratings with relevant dredging experience.
* **TSHD Competency:**
  Ensure appropriate crew competency in trailing and suction dredging, draghead handling, hopper operations, dredge pumps, discharge systems, and vessel machinery.
* **Statutory Compliance:**
  Monitor crew certifications, CoCs/CoPs, STCW, medical fitness, CDCs, passports, visas, minimum safe manning, and other applicable statutory and client requirements.
* **Crew Rotation & Welfare:**
  Manage joining/sign-off schedules, leave planning, crew grievances, performance evaluations, retention, and succession planning.
* **Budget & Cost Control:**
  Prepare crewing budgets, monitor salaries, overtime, travel, recruitment, training, and other personnel costs.
* **Training & Performance:**
  Establish crew appraisal systems, competency assessments, training programmes, and development plans for senior onboard personnel.
* **Safety & Compliance:**
  Coordinate with QHSE and vessel management on crew-related audits, safety training, incidents, and corrective actions.
* **Coordination & Reporting:**
  Work closely with Marine Operations, Technical, HR, Finance, and Project teams to ensure uninterrupted vessel operations and submit periodic manpower, compliance, and cost reports to management.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate degree or diploma in Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies, or a related discipline preferred.
* 7-10 years of relevant marine industry experience, including substantial experience in senior crewing or marine personnel management.
* Proven experience managing crew for dredgers, preferably TSHDs, and handling multiple vessels or project locations.
* Sound knowledge of applicable DG Shipping requirements, STCW, MLC 2006, ISM Code, and international maritime regulations.
* Strong expertise in manpower planning, recruitment, crew documentation, budgeting, and team leadership.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely crew deployment and vessel readiness.
* Full compliance with applicable crew certification and manning requirements.
* Effective crew rotation and reduced operational disruptions.
* Recruitment efficiency and retention of experienced personnel.
* Adherence to approved crewing budgets.
* Timely completion of training, appraisals, and audit corrective actions.

**5. Desired Candidate Profile**

A strong marine crewing professional with proven leadership, commercial awareness, sound technical understanding of TSHD operations, excellent coordination and negotiation skills, and the ability to independently lead the complete crewing function for a multi-vessel dredging fleet.

**6. C.T.C**

18-24Lac./Annum (Relative to experience & Capability)

**Work Location:**
Head Office- Mumbai, with travel to project sites and vessels as required.

title: Food Beverage Controller
description:
**Designation**
**-**
Senior Manager - F&B Controls

**Location -**
Worli, Mumbai

**A. Food & Beverage Cost Control**

• Monitor food and beverage costs against approved budgets and established cost benchmarks.

• Track actual food cost, beverage cost, consumption, wastage, and cost variances.

• Analyse recipe costing, portion control, yield, and menu profitability in coordination with the culinary team.

• Identify cost leakages and recommend corrective measures to improve gross margins.

• Monitor food cost percentages across outlets, banquet events, and catering operations.

**B. Inventory & Stores Management**

• Oversee inventory planning, stock movement, consumption, and reconciliation.

• Ensure regular physical stock counts and reconciliation with system records.

• Monitor expiry, spoilage, breakage, wastage, and stock discrepancies.

• Establish controls for stock transfers, material requisitions, returns, and inter-location movements. • Ensure appropriate stock levels and adherence to FIFO/FEFO practices.

**C. Procurement & Vendor Control**

• Review purchase prices, vendor rates, and procurement practices to identify cost-saving opportunities.

• Monitor purchase price variances and compliance with approved vendor and procurement policies.

• Coordinate with procurement, stores, culinary, and operations teams to control material costs.

• Review receiving procedures, quality checks, and quantity discrepancies. D. Banqueting & Catering Costing

• Prepare and review food and beverage cost sheets for banquets, weddings, corporate events, and large scale catering assignments.

• Validate event-wise consumption against planned menus, guest counts, and production quantities.

• Analyse actual versus estimated event costs and identify deviations.

• Monitor contribution margins and profitability by event, venue, and business vertical.

• Establish post-event cost reconciliation and variance reporting processes.

**E. Budgeting, MIS & Financial Analysis**

• Prepare monthly F&B cost reports, inventory reports, and variance analysis.

• Track food cost percentage, beverage cost percentage, gross margins, wastage, and inventory holding levels.

• Develop dashboards highlighting cost trends, exceptions, and corrective actions.

• Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and cost-saving initiatives.

• Provide actionable insights to senior management on profitability and operational efficiency.

**F. Audit, Compliance & Process Improvement**

• Conduct periodic operational audits across kitchens, stores, outlets, and banquet locations.

• Ensure adherence to inventory, procurement, billing, consumption, and stock reconciliation SOPs. • Identify control gaps, irregularities, and potential pilferage.

• Implement standardised F&B control processes across all operating locations.

• Coordinate with internal audit and finance teams to ensure accurate reporting and compliance.

**Experience:-**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in F&B cost control, hospitality finance, inventory control, or food and beverage operations.
* Prior experience in hotels, premium restaurants, large-scale catering, banqueting, central kitchens, or multi-outlet F&B businesses.
* Experience in handling multi-location operations and high-volume food production will be preferred.

**Landscape & Garden Maintenance**

title: Assistant Vice President - Collateral Management
description:
**Job Title:**
Assistant Vice President
  
  
**Department**
: ISPL Collateral Management CIB – OTC & REPO Margining
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The Collateral Management Group compares the Net Present Value of the portfolio of trades between BNP Paribas and its counterparties on a daily (or as specified) basis and ensure that this exposure is sufficiently collateralized.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The process requires comparison of exposures with the value of the assets pledged, in accordance with the parameters specified in the legal agreement. Changes in exposure will generate changes in collateral balance. The collateral teams will call for or post additional collateral. This daily margin call process ensures that the Bank is covered in terms of excessive credit risk exposure. As a part of regulatory requirements of EMIR, collateral management is also required to perform portfolio reconciliation as a risk mitigation technique for dispute resolution and to be in line with regulatory requirements of EMIR. Process requires working with clients, Middle Office, P&L and risk team along with key stakeholders across the bank to report / resolve issues.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Performing daily margin call process front to back for specified clients.
* Margin Call issuance and chasing clients for unanswered margin calls for OTC and REPO business lines
* Investigating disputed calls and liaising with client, MO and legal on various aspects of disputed margin calls.
* Chasing clients on failed/missed payments.
* Investigating with settlements team on all bonds that have not settled in the market.
* Working on Substitution requests sent by clients/traders.
* Booking interest for all monthly clients.
* Investigating Interest discrepancies.
* Review control report to ensure effective break, fails and exception management
* Perform trade level reconciliation between BNPP and client portfolio as per EMIR Regulations.
* Investigating and resolving unmatched, entity mismatch and ageing trade breaks that contribute to disputes.
* Investigating and resolving trades breaking due to MTM discrepancy.
* Creating Dispute Notes and working with Margin Call team on trades breaking due to MTM discrepancy.
* Performing high level analysis on Booking / cash flows / FX / discounting / validation of Bid-offer prior to reaching out to Front Office / Valuations teams for further analysis.
* Ownership of Collateral Dispute which requires working with Risk / Front Office to review CSA level / trade level disputes and providing a clear status to allow next steps for resolution to be determined.
* Presenting findings to the management during meetings.
* Creating and maintaining KPIs and perform quality checks.
* Drive end-to-end process ownership by proactively identifying operational gaps and designing robust controls to mitigate risk. Act as the primary escalation point to resolve complex, aging breaks and high-level disputes, ensuring seamless operational continuity
* Act as an escalation point of contact for the team and manage day to day work allocation to ensure that the BAU is completed for the day.
* Perform control activities on aging breaks, disputes and intervene wherever required to resolve the breaks or course correct the investigation.
* Responsible for the continuous maintenance and optimization of process SOPs to ensure operational consistency. Lead the audit readiness process for IG and other regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of required documentation and evidence to auditors.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Training and mentoring the team members on the collateral mgmt process and instilling overall best practices for the team members
* Point of escalation for client queries, disputes, trade breaks and fails resolution.
* Work closely with other managers in Collateral Operations to perform effective capacity management.
* Working on developing and implements new controls / processes based on Business/ Risk / Industry evolution to better support the risk management needs of BNPP.
* Designing and testing new functionalities. Working on enhancements/automations that leads to efficiency gains in the process.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong Communication skills required for an effective liaison with counterparties and internal stakeholders to the reconciliation process. (Middle offices, marketers, traders, credit, compliance and legal)
* Knowledge of derivative products (Credit, Interest Rate, FX , Equities)
* Strong knowledge of Trade Life Cycle.
* Experience in Portfolio Reconciliation Operations, Collateral Management Operations or another Middle Office Operation functions within Investment Banking is favorable.
* Working experience on Trioptima, Acadia and POWER BI favorable
* Excel skills required.
* Experience of ISDA /GMRA documentation

**Specific Qualifications: (If required)**

* Minimum 8 years of experience along with Bachelor's Degree - in management, finance, related field or equivalent experience.

**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**

* Skill 1 – Strong knowledge of Trade Life Cycle
* Skill 2 – Knowledge of derivative products (Credit, Interest Rate, FX , Equities).
* Skill 3 - Experience in Portfolio Reconciliation Operations, Collateral Management Operations or another Middle Office Operation functions within Investment Banking is favorable.

**Technical Skills**

* Skill 1 – MS office
* Skill 2 – Application understanding.

Skill 3 – Email Management
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Skill 1 - Attention to detail / rigor
* Skill 2 - Organizational skills
* Skill 3 - Personal Impact / Ability to influence
* Skill 4 - Critical thinking

**Education Level:**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Shift**
: APAC/ EMEA/ NY
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work.
