title: Head – Retail (Express Business)
description:
**Head – Retail (Express Business)**

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Experience:**
18–25 years

**About the Company**

Our organization is India’s largest integrated logistics services provider and a global leader in less-than-container-load consolidation, headquartered in Mumbai. With more than three decades of logistics experience, we operate across 180 countries, provide door-to-door delivery in more than 50 markets, and maintain extensive express distribution coverage across India. Growth has been shaped by organic expansion, strategic mergers and acquisitions, and entry into multiple logistics verticals. Our integrated portfolio spans international supply chain, express distribution, CFS-ICD, contract logistics, air freight, and logistics parks. By creating synergies across group businesses, we deliver customized supply-chain solutions. We aim to stay ahead through dynamic leadership, innovation, courageous decision-making, change management, and agile execution in India and globally.

**About the Role**

The Head – Retail will own the pan-India channel and retail ecosystem for the Express Business, converting network scale into profitable, sustainable growth. This leader will shape national strategy, expand franchise and partner coverage in underpenetrated markets, and own the Channel and Retail P&L across zones. The role will lead a network of more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees through zonal leadership, while improving partner capability, retention, productivity, and returns. Success requires transforming retail experience through consistent outlets, technology-enabled visibility, customer-service improvements, activations, loyalty initiatives, and stronger governance. The leader will mentor zonal business heads and future leaders, establish audit and financial controls, and align Operations, Product, Finance, Marketing, HR, and L&D. Reporting to the National Head – Sales and Marketing, the role manages four to five direct reports and requires extensive travel across India.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the national channel and retail strategy, aligning network expansion, partner economics, customer experience, and P&L outcomes with Express Business growth priorities.
* Expand into underpenetrated markets through scalable franchise and partner models, using market data, investment discipline, and clear return thresholds to build sustainable coverage.
* Own Channel and Retail P&L performance across zones, shifting the operating model from volume-led expansion toward value-based partner engagement, productivity, contribution, and profitability.
* Govern a network of more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees through zonal leadership, strengthening capability, retention, grievance resolution, and long-term partner relationships.
* Establish data-backed channel-health metrics, CRM and retail analytics reviews, and performance cadences that improve partner productivity, outlet economics, visibility, and return on investment.
* Transform the retail experience through footprint expansion, brand consistency, technology-enabled service visibility, retail activation, loyalty programs, and coordinated customer engagement with Marketing.
* Build leadership depth by mentoring zonal business heads and next-line leaders, while partnering with HR and L&D on training for channel sales teams and franchise owners.
* Strengthen governance through franchise audits, financial controls, operational discipline, and cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, and industry stakeholders.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Deep expertise in logistics, express distribution, retail operations, franchise networks, and channel-partner ecosystems, with the judgment to balance scale, service quality, and profitable growth.
* Proven P&L ownership, financial acumen, negotiation, stakeholder management, and national-level commercial leadership across complex, distributed operating environments.
* Working familiarity with CRM, ERP, retail analytics, logistics software, inventory-management systems, and data-analysis tools used to improve visibility, decisions, execution, and governance.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience leading large-scale channel or franchise networks in logistics, express delivery, e-commerce, FMCG, or other distributed consumer-facing businesses will be advantageous.
* A postgraduate degree such as an MBA, exposure to national retail transformation, or experience with technology-enabled outlet models will strengthen candidacy.
* Demonstrated success in building partner capability, improving franchise profitability, and expanding coverage across underpenetrated geographies will be valued.

**What You'll Bring**

* You will bring 18–25 years of experience in channel leadership, franchise-network development, retail operations, logistics, express delivery, e-commerce, FMCG, or a closely related distributed business. At least five years should reflect national leadership responsibility, with ownership of large networks, multi-zone performance, and commercially material P&L outcomes.
* You will combine strategic thinking with execution discipline, translating market opportunities into scalable partner programs, stronger outlet economics, improved customer experience, and sustainable profitability. Your leadership will be grounded in analytical decision-making, problem-solving, negotiation, communication, and relationship management across partners, employees, and senior stakeholders.
* You will demonstrate customer focus, adaptability, resilience, integrity, and governance in a fast-moving environment. A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, or a related discipline is expected; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* You must be comfortable using data, CRM, ERP, retail analytics, logistics, inventory, and performance-management systems to create visibility and accountability. Extensive travel across India is essential for direct network engagement.

**Why Join Us**

* Shape the national retail and channel agenda for a large, integrated logistics platform, with direct ownership of partner ecosystem growth, customer experience transformation, and profitable Express Business outcomes.
* Influence a distributed ecosystem spanning more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees, while building the next generation of zonal and channel leadership.
* Work across international supply chain, express distribution, contract logistics, air freight, and logistics-park businesses to create synergies and deliver integrated customer solutions.
* Lead a high-impact transformation agenda centered on technology, governance, partner economics, operational efficiency, and sustainable national expansion.

**What We Offer**

* A senior national leadership mandate with ownership of Channel and Retail P&L, strategic expansion, partner governance, customer experience, and profitability across India.
* The opportunity to work with a broad logistics portfolio, cross-functional leadership teams, and a large partner and retail ecosystem undergoing technology-enabled transformation.
* A performance-oriented environment that values innovation, courageous decisions, agile execution, collaboration, integrity, and disciplined governance.

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About Maritime**
We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
  
  
**About The Role**
Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
  
  
The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
  
  
Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
  
  
Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
  
  
Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
  
  
Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
  
  
Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
  
  
Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
  
  
Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
  
  
Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
  
  
Measure and monitor the Key Account`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
  
  
While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
  
  
Pro-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
  
  
Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
  
  
Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
  
  
What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer-facing roles.
* Driven, goal-oriented, and results-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.
* Capable of performing efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
* Forward-thinking, innovative, and solution-oriented, with strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer engagement and relationship management abilities, with a proven capability to interact effectively at both operational and executive levels.
* Possesses strong knowledge of the maritime industry, offshore operations, and classification requirements.
* Experienced in ship and Mobile Offshore Unit (MOU) operations, enabling effective communication and engagement with a diverse customer base.
* Skilled in working closely with Area Managers, Approval Centre Managers, Production Managers, Business Development Managers, and Key Account Managers (KAMs) to achieve organizational goals.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* International exposure and experience working with multicultural teams and stakeholders are considered a strong advantage.
* Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, demonstrating leadership, ownership, and accountability.
* Willing and able to travel as required by the role.

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

title: Manager - Sourcing
description:
**About Us**
**Who we are:**
Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. For more than 100 years, Samsonite has leveraged its rich heritage to create unparalleled products that fulfill the travel lifestyle needs of conscious movers everywhere. With a portfolio of brands including Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann, and Lipault Paris, our products are sold in over 100 countries in North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America through our company-operated retail store, websites and a variety of retail partners.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Product Development & Commercialization: Manage product development from concept and design brief through sampling, prototyping, validation, pilot production and commercialization, ensuring approved samples, completed milestones and timely product launches.
* Vendor Development & Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, onboard and develop domestic and international suppliers based on their technical capabilities, capacity, quality, commercial competitiveness and ability to meet business requirements.
* Costing, Negotiation & Value Engineering: Prepare and finalize product and raw material costing, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, identify alternate sourcing opportunities and drive cost optimization through material changes and value engineering.
* BOM & Pricing Management: Prepare, finalize, and maintain accurate Bills of Material (BOMs), pricing records and cost documentation for finished goods, raw materials and components, ensuring data accuracy and availability for business decisions.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with Design, Marketing, Quality, Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain teams to finalize requirements, secure approvals, resolve development issues and ensure timely product launches.
* Supplier Quality, Performance & Compliance: Monitor supplier adherence to quality standards and company requirements, support audits and compliance reviews, resolve development and consumer quality issues, and drive corrective actions and periodic supplier performance evaluations.
* Market Intelligence & Continuous Improvement: Monitor supplier and material trends, identify alternate sources, develop supplier capacity, improve sourcing processes and support strategic sourcing initiatives and special projects.
* Project, MIS & Documentation Management: Maintain product development trackers, sourcing databases, supplier agreements, NDAs, costing records, MIS reports and supporting documentation to ensure effective project monitoring, reporting and record control.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Textile Engineering, or equivalent.
  
  
MBA/PGDM in Operations, Supply Chain, or Materials Management will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Experience Required**
12–15 years of experience in Product Development, Vendor Development, Sourcing, or Manufacturing within the luggage, backpacks, bags, footwear, consumer goods, plastics, or related manufacturing industries.
  
  
Experience in managing end-to-end New Product Development (NPD), vendor management, costing, BOM preparation, and cross-functional project execution.
  
  
Exposure to ERP systems (preferably LN ERP) is desirable.
  
  
**About The Team**
**Why you'll love working here:**

* Our employees matter. As a people-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based.
* Vibrant culture. We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day.
* Socially responsible. We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models.

**What We Value**
At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily.
  
  
Samsonite is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

title: Head of Business Operations

title: Head of Operations
description: The RoleWe're hiring a Head of Operations to run Adzzat day to day. Today our COO does it himself. Your job is to take it off his plate and run it better. Adzzat is the delivery layer behind AI data companies. They bring the project. We bring vetted engineers, finance experts and annotators from across India, and we run everything else: vetting, onboarding, quality, project management and payouts. Our promise to clients is simple: you get the output, we handle the ops. We're growing fast, and you're the person who keeps that promise as we do.What a week looks likeNo two weeks are the same. A typical one, compressed:Monday: A client sends a new project: 200 expert tasks in 10 days, in a skill we've never staffed. By Wednesday you've scoped it, tested the first 20 people and shipped a pilot batch.Tuesday: A batch comes back with too many rejections. By evening you know why. By morning the guidelines are fixed and the team is retrained. Wednesday: A prospect wants samples by Friday to decide on a pilot. They get them Thursday. Thursday: Your best reviewer is out mid-deadline. Nothing slips, because you never let one person become the bottleneck. Friday: Payout day. Hundreds of tasks across projects and pay tiers. Everyone is paid on time and the numbers match the invoice. In between: client calls, contributor escalations, and at least one problem nobody has seen before.You're measured on: On-time delivery First-pass acceptance (work the client accepts without rework) Days from kickoff to first accepted batch Payouts on time and accurate Retention of top contributors Founder hours spent in ops (target: close to zero)

title: Utm Supervisor
company: KINGS OCEAN MARINE SERVICES PVT LTD (a part of Kings Ocean Group)
description:
**Company Description**
KINGS OCEAN MARINE SERVICES PVT LTD, part of Kings Ocean Group, is a leading inspection and marine technical consultancy company registered in Mumbai, India. The organization delivers reliable services ranging from technical consultancy to project management for clients across the globe. Its multidisciplinary team includes experienced naval architects, marine, mechanical, electrical, and design engineers, as well as skilled technicians. The company supports owners and clients from initial design through modifications, vessel conversions, and project execution, ensuring requirements are fully met. Specialized divisions cover ultrasonic thickness gauging, rope access, remote inspection technology, remote thickness measurement, and third-party inspection services for both offshore and onshore operations.
  
**Role Description**
The UTM Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. This role oversees ultrasonic thickness measurement (UTM) operations, ensuring that inspections are planned, executed, and documented in accordance with company standards, client requirements, and relevant marine regulations. The UTM Supervisor coordinates inspection teams, allocates tasks, and provides technical guidance on measurement procedures, equipment usage, and safety protocols. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing work scopes, monitoring progress, validating measurements and reports, and liaising with clients, surveyors, and internal stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliverables. The role also involves maintaining inspection equipment, ensuring compliance with quality and safety systems, and supporting training and development of technicians to uphold high service standards.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in ultrasonic thickness measurement, marine inspections, and related NDT techniques.
* Solid understanding of ship structures, hull integrity, and marine engineering principles.
* Experience supervising field teams, coordinating on-site activities, and enforcing safety procedures.
* Proficiency in reading technical drawings, inspection reports, and classification or regulatory requirements.
* Effective communication skills for interacting with clients, surveyors, and internal teams, with clear report writing abilities.
* Ability to plan and prioritize multiple projects, manage timelines, and adapt to changing operational needs.
* Comfort working in offshore, onshore, and confined-space environments, following all safety and compliance standards.
* Relevant technical diploma or degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; UTM/NDT certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in marine inspection, ship repair, classification surveys, or similar domains is highly beneficial.
* Willingness to travel as required for project sites and to work flexible hours based on operational demands.

description:

business. The role brings delivery owners and technical leads into one line, so every finhub

title: Operations Manager - School
description:
**Operations Manager - School**

* **The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo isn’t just India’s largest tattoo brand - we’re building the world’s most admired tattoo company.

Our studio network and specialist tattoo school depend on reliable training operations to develop artists at scale.

We’re looking for an Operations Manager for Aliens Tattoo School who can run multiple course, batches, evaluations, student milestones, and facility needs into one dependable operating rhythm.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing order to moving parts, protecting the learner experience, and making performance visible.

You will work across Training and Development, Course Delivery, Course Development, mentors, School Sales, Admin and HR

If you take ownership, notice gaps before they become disruptions, and build processes people can actually follow, we’d love to meet you.

* **The Mandate**

Your mission is simple:

As T&D Operations Manager, you are entrusted with making every training day ready to run - with the right mentor, room, schedule, evaluation, student record, equipment, and stock in place.

You will run the batch calendar, monthly timetable, rosters, room plan and evaluations. You will own onboarding, operational records, certificates, concern tracking, feedback cycles, and Aliens Home referrals.

You will keep every learning space safe, clean, functional, and audit-ready; maintain stock; prevent shortages; control operating spend; and track repairs to closure.

You will build practical SOPs, current policies, disciplined trackers, and a monthly MIS covering course progress, attendance, student experience, and performance data.

* **What you’ll be doing**

You will publish the master calendar and monthly timetable, assign rooms and trained mentors, schedule evaluations, plan mentor studio hours and L&D Artist bookings, and ensure every class and shoot proceeds without an operations-led delay.

You will manage the student lifecycle from joining to completion: finish onboarding before day one, maintain records, flag fee status at defined milestones, issue certificates on time, offer Aliens Home to students who need accommodation, and record every choice.

You will log and own student concerns until closure, route teaching matters to Course Delivery, run feedback forms at fixed points, and report NPS, CSAT, attendance, progress, and dropout visibility. You will audit hygiene and facilities on schedule, maintain biomedical-waste records, track repairs, count stock, prevent session shortages, control operating spend, maintain the SOP and policy library, and publish a complete monthly T&D report with every variance explained.

* **What we’re looking for**

We are looking for a disciplined operator with experience in training, education, academy, studio, or multi-schedule operations. You should be comfortable coordinating several batches, people, rooms, evaluations, shoots, and deadlines at the same time without losing attention to detail.

You can build practical schedules and trackers, work confidently in Excel, manage stock and spend, write SOPs and policies in clear language, and turn raw operational data into useful monthly reports.

You remain calm with upset students or parents, communicate clearly across functions, follow issues through to closure, and escalate early when ownership sits elsewhere.

Most importantly, you act like an owner: you protect safety, learner experience, and operational continuity, and you do not wait for preventable problems to become emergencies.

* **What success looks like**

Success in this role is measured by reliable execution. You’ll know you’re succeeding when. Training operations - Classes run as scheduled, evaluations are completed within the agreed turnaround, mentor studio hours are delivered, and calendars and timetables are published on time.

Student lifecycle - Students are fully onboarded before day one, records stay current, certificates are issued within the set time, concerns close on time, student retention is on point, no dropouts, feedback cycles run consistently, and Aliens Home is offered and tracked for every eligible student.

Facilities and inventory - Every space is audited on rhythm, hygiene and facility audits pass first time, repairs close within the agreed timeline, biomedical-waste records remain current, no session is delayed by missing stock, and operating spend stays within budget.

Systems and reporting - The SOP library reaches full coverage, policies stay approved and current, and a live monthly MIS is published on time with every variance explained.

Safety - Zero hygiene-related safety incidents and no hygiene breach remains open beyond the same day.

title: ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER – OPERATIONS
description:
**Soho House Mumbai | Juhu, Mumbai**
**Department:**
Operations
  
  
**Reports to:**
General Manager
  
  
**Dotted-line reporting:**
Regional Director
  
  
**About Soho House Mumbai**
Soho House Mumbai is a private members' club bringing together a diverse community of creative people through hospitality, culture, food and drink, wellness and memorable experiences. With accommodation, restaurants, bars, member spaces, events, a cinema, gym and swimming pool, the House operates across multiple business areas, requiring a leader who understands the connection between operational excellence, commercial performance and member engagement.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for an energetic, commercially minded and people-focused Assistant General Manager to partner with the General Manager in driving the overall performance of Soho House Mumbai.
  
  
The candidate may come from a strong
**Food & Beverage or Rooms background**
, but must demonstrate the ability to lead beyond their specialist discipline, work collaboratively with diverse operational leaders and understand the business as a whole.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a hands-on hospitality leader who knows Mumbai's market, builds meaningful relationships across its diverse social and business communities, identifies opportunities for revenue growth and develops teams that consistently deliver exceptional experiences.
  
  
People management and development are fundamental to success in this role. We want a leader who brings energy, enthusiasm, accountability and a genuine drive to deliver measurable business results.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Leadership & Commercial Performance
* Partner with the General Manager to deliver the House's annual business plan, revenue objectives, EBITDA targets and operational priorities.
* Understand the financial performance of individual business areas and the wider operation, identifying opportunities to grow revenue, optimise costs and improve profitability.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly business performance, translating data and trends into actionable plans.
* Identify new opportunities across membership, food and beverage, accommodation, private hire, events and other revenue-generating areas.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity and emerging hospitality and lifestyle concepts across Mumbai.
* Ensure that operational initiatives are delivered within agreed budgets and timelines, with measurable outcomes.
* Operational Excellence
* Provide visible, hands-on leadership across front-of-house and back-of-house operations, ensuring consistent service standards and effective problem-solving.
* Work closely with the House Manager and other operational leaders to ensure seamless coordination across the House.
* Understand the guest and member journey across accommodation, food and beverage, member spaces, events, facilities and other services.
* Establish clear accountability, follow up on operational priorities and drive continuous improvement.
* Support leaders in maintaining service standards, operational readiness and effective communication between departments.
* Be comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, multifaceted environment while balancing immediate operational requirements with long-term business priorities.
* Membership, Relationships & Mumbai Market Connectivity
* Develop a strong understanding of Soho House's membership proposition and the needs of its diverse member community.
* Build authentic relationships across Mumbai's hospitality, creative, cultural, entertainment and business communities.
* Work with Membership, Member Relations, Marketing, PR, Private Hire and Events & Programming to strengthen engagement and identify commercial opportunities.
* Support initiatives that improve member satisfaction, loyalty, retention and the overall relevance of the House within Mumbai's lifestyle landscape.
* Bring market insight, social awareness and an entrepreneurial mindset to business development and relationship-building opportunities.
* People Leadership & Development
* Build, coach and develop a strong team of operational leaders, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and shared success.
* Work closely with People & Development, Recruitment and Learning & Development to strengthen talent pipelines, succession planning, leadership capability and employee engagement.
* Set clear expectations and performance objectives for direct reports, conducting regular reviews and following through on development plans.
* Identify high-potential talent and create opportunities for internal progression and cross-functional development.
* Drive employee retention by building an inclusive, supportive and high-performance working environment.
* Lead by example, demonstrating the Soho House values through everyday decisions, behaviours and interactions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work collaboratively with Finance, People & Development, Recruitment, Learning & Development, Membership, F&B, Rooms, Marketing, PR, Events & Programming, Housekeeping, Engineering, IT and Facilities.
* Build strong working relationships with support-office and regional teams to implement business priorities, global standards and operational initiatives.
* Share information effectively, resolve interdepartmental challenges and ensure that all teams work towards common business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, use technology effectively and introduce innovative ways of working.
* Health, Safety & Compliance
* Ensure adherence to company policies, food safety standards, allergy procedures, security protocols and health and safety requirements.
* Maintain readiness for internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of identified actions.
* Work with Engineering, Security, Facilities and relevant leaders to maintain a safe, compliant and welcoming environment.
* Ensure applicable local authority requirements and statutory obligations are met.

Direct Reports
  
  

* House Manager
* Engineering
* IT
* Private Hire Manager
* Member Relations
* Security

The role requires close collaboration with all other operational and support-function leaders across the House.
  
  
Position Profile
  
  
**Experience And Background**

* Strong management experience in a high-profile hotel, lifestyle hospitality business, premium restaurant group or private members' club.
* Candidates from either F&B or Rooms will be considered, provided they can demonstrate the ability to lead across multiple operational functions.
* Sound understanding of hospitality business operations, commercial performance, revenue optimisation, budgets and EBITDA.
* A strong understanding of Mumbai's hospitality landscape and an ability to build meaningful relationships across diverse industries and communities.
* Demonstrated experience in managing, engaging and developing teams.
* Experience working within complex, fast-paced operations with high service expectations.
* International hospitality experience or exposure to global service standards would be advantageous.

**Leadership attributes**

* Energetic, enthusiastic and proactive, with a strong bias for action and results.
* Commercially astute, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
* A hands-on leader who can influence, coach and collaborate with experienced department heads.
* Strong interpersonal, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented and dependable.
* Comfortable working across diverse cultures, teams and business functions.
* Passionate about hospitality, service, member engagement and people development.
* Proficient in relevant operational systems; experience with Opera, Micros or equivalent platforms is advantageous.

Measures of Success
  
  
Performance will be assessed against agreed business targets and leadership objectives, including:
  
  

* Service Excellence: Mystery shopper Service Scan scores and consistent delivery of Soho House standards.
* Financial Performance: Achievement of annual and quarterly EBITDA targets, revenue objectives and cost-control measures.
* Member Retention: Achievement of agreed membership retention targets and improvement in member experience.
* Team Retention: Achievement of staff retention targets, engagement and development objectives.
* Health & Safety: Successful completion of Health & Safety audits, compliance with standards and timely closure of corrective actions.
* Operational Performance: Effective execution of business improvement plans, operational priorities and cross-functional initiatives.
* People Development: Strength of succession planning, internal progression, leadership capability and team performance.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
A successful Assistant General Manager will be a trusted business partner to the General Manager and a credible leader to the wider operational team. They will connect commercial thinking with exceptional hospitality, develop leaders who take ownership of their departments, strengthen member and team retention, and ensure that the House continues to deliver outstanding experiences while achieving its financial objectives.

title: Store Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced
**Store Manager**
with strong exposure to the
**hospitality industry**
, particularly
**hotels, restaurants, banquet operations, resorts, and large-scale F&B establishments**
.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete store operations, including receiving, inspection, storage, inventory control, stock issuance, documentation, wastage control, and coordination with Purchase, Kitchen, F&B, Accounts, and other departments.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesStore Operations
  
  

* Manage day-to-day operations of the hotel/restaurant/banquet stores.
* Handle receiving, checking, storing, and issuing of food, beverages, non-food items, housekeeping supplies, kitchen consumables, and other materials.
* Ensure all incoming materials are checked against purchase orders, invoices, quantity, quality, and specifications.
* Maintain proper storage conditions for food, beverages, chemicals, crockery, cutlery, linen, and other materials.
* Ensure proper labeling, stacking, categorization, and organization of all stock.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable.
* Ensure temperature-controlled storage requirements are maintained for perishable items.
* Monitor expiry dates and prevent wastage or stock deterioration.

Inventory Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate inventory records for all store items.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and periodic inventory audits.
* Reconcile physical stock with system records and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels and initiate replenishment requirements.
* Track consumption patterns and identify slow-moving, fast-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory.
* Monitor food and beverage stock consumption and wastage.
* Maintain proper records of stock transfers between stores, kitchens, restaurants, and banquet operations.

Hospitality & F&B Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate closely with Executive Chef, Kitchen, F&B, Banquet, Restaurant, Housekeeping, Purchase, and Accounts teams.
* Ensure timely availability of materials required for daily hotel and restaurant operations.
* Coordinate with banquet and events teams for special functions, weddings, conferences, and large events.
* Ensure adequate stock availability before major events and banquet functions.
* Handle urgent material requirements during peak operations.

Purchase & Vendor Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate with the Purchase Department regarding stock requirements and replenishment.
* Assist in evaluating received materials against approved specifications.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers regarding shortages, damages, replacements, and quality issues.
* Maintain proper documentation for goods received and returned.
* Support management in identifying opportunities for cost control and efficient procurement.

Cost & Wastage Control
  
  

* Monitor stock consumption and identify unusual variances.
* Control wastage, damage, expiry, and unnecessary stock accumulation.
* Maintain proper records of breakage, wastage, returns, and adjustments.
* Support management in controlling food and operational costs.
* Ensure proper authorization for stock issues and transfers.

Documentation & Reporting
  
  

* Maintain GRN, stock issue, stock transfer, return, and adjustment records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory/MIS reports.
* Maintain stock registers and system records accurately.
* Provide inventory reports to management, Accounts, Purchase, and F&B teams.
* Assist during internal and external inventory audits.
* Ensure all store documentation is complete and properly maintained.

title: Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence
description:
**Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence**

* **The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're building the world's most admired tattoo company.

With 16+ premium studios, a team of 160+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders.

We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations.

We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners.

If you thrive in high-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you.

As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region.

* **The Mandate**

You will own quality across the entire studio network end to end — compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself — what gets checked, how often, through what method — and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on.

* **What you'll be doing**

Checking every studio against its own standard — how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run — through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported.

Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all — you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change.

Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it — real visits and unannounced ones — so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to.

Owning the physical readiness of every studio — hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on — and catching what's broken before a customer does.

Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted — and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it.

Building the entire audit system from nothing — the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask — designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day.

Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale — holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something.

* **What we're looking for**

You've done this before — run quality or audit work across multiple locations.

You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all.

Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past — the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later.

You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen.

You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone — a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior — you report what you found, not what's comfortable.

Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both — the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once.

Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline — what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before.

* **What success looks like**

every studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses.

The audit system runs as a system — not as you personally visiting every studio, but as a team you've built and trained, working to a standard you designed and can walk away from without it slipping.

* **Practical details**

Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline

Preferred Industry - Retail Only

A quality or process-audit certification — Six Sigma, ISO auditing or equivalent - This is optional, However this is an added advantage

This is a high-visibility role with meaningful impact, offering the opportunity to build a more efficient, governed, and AI-enabled operating model that helps our partner ecosystem grow with the business.
  
  
If you enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, building systems that remove friction, and helping teams scale through better operations rather than more manual work, this role is for you.

title: Prime Services Operations, Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
The Prime Services Operations Vice President is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the operational support of Prime Services borrowing and lending activities, including settlement processes, collateral management, recon, billing, and corporate action event processing. This role ensures accurate trade processing, proper collateralization, asset servicing, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance, while leading a global team and driving strategic improvements. The position also involves close collaboration with business partners to drive innovation in processes and systems to enhance efficiency, scalability, and risk management, ensuring operational solutions are closely aligned with State Street’s business objectives, industry practices, and evolving market needs.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Prime Services Operations Vice President you will lead –
  
  

* Trade & Transaction Management
* Oversee daily processing of Prime Services transactions across markets (borrowing and lending transactions, collateralization/margin calls, triparty transactions, cash movements/wires, billing, and corporate actions)
* Ensure timely and accurate trade capture, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation
* Partner with global custody teams on trade statuses and adjustments
* Manage trade lifecycle events, like cash dividends, and mandatory/voluntary corporate actions, monthly billing processes
* Collateral Management
* Initiate and support client(borrower) side financing/collateralization waterfall, as well as Lending agent side collateralization(bilateral/triparty) processes
* Manage initial collateral, collateral returns, margin calls, collateral disputes
* Assist in optimizing collateral usage across funding, risk, and trading desks
* Intraday and End of Day collateral sufficiency monitoring
* Risk & Control
* Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and corporate event risks
* Ensure strong internal controls and adherence to audit requirements
* Investigate and resolve cash/share internal/external breaks, fails, and counterparty discrepancies
* Provide viable solutions and KRI’s to reduce and/or eliminate risk to Prime Services, State Street, and its clients
* Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure all Prime Services operational processes comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, and industry standards
* Support reporting requirements and regulatory audits
* Participate and track internal and external audits throughout the year, ensuring all deliverables and action items are handled timely
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of evolving regulatory/market changes
* Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Front Office, Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Technology teams to understand requirements, delivering solutions that support business growth and risk mitigation
* Act as escalation point for operational issues working with teams to resolve and/or remove road blocks, and ensuring management transparency
* Maintain relationships with counterparties, custodians, and clearing agents
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners, ensuring optimal performance and value from third-party platforms and services
* Team Leadership
* Manage and coach operations staff and AVPs
* Drive performance, training, and development
* Promote a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
* Process Improvement & Projects
* Identify emerging technologies and process improvements to drive operational efficiency, trading profitability, risk reduction, and enhanced client experience with Prime Services products
* Participate in system implementations and strategic transformation programs
* Enhance scalability and efficiency of operations
* Partner with business leaders, risk, compliance, and technology teams to understand requirements, delivering solutions that support business growth and risk mitigation

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field is preferred
* 12+ years of experience in financial services operations, with focus on Prime Services and principal trading
* Strong understanding of Prime Services products and processes (e.g., trade lifecycle management/settlement/collateral, corporate actions, vendors)

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Leadership and team management
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Attention to detail and risk awareness
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Process improvement and project management

**Additional Details**

* Fast-paced environment
* High interaction with trading desks/client management, counterparties, and global custody teams
* Time-sensitive operations aligned with market hours

description:

**Job Description: Knowledge Operations Manager**
**Department:**
Customer Experience / AI Operations
  
  
**Experience:**
3–6 years
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, Kandivali
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Knowledge Operations Manager**
to lead a team of human operators responsible for researching, preparing, validating, and maintaining high-quality answers to customer queries.
  
  
The role will establish a structured knowledge operations process in which customer questions are converted into accurate, consistent, reusable answers, response templates, FAQs, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). These knowledge assets will enable customer-facing human agents to resolve queries efficiently and consistently.
  
  
The individual will manage the operator team, define quality standards, validate responses, identify gaps in available information, and ensure that approved answers remain up to date. The role will also contribute to building an AI-ready knowledge base that can support AI copilots, conversational agents, and automated customer support in the future.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Human Operator Management
* Recruit, onboard, train, and manage a team of knowledge research and response preparation operators.
* Allocate incoming queries and research tasks based on complexity, priority, and operator expertise.
* Establish clear workflows, turnaround times, productivity targets, and quality standards.
* Monitor operator performance and provide regular feedback, coaching, and training.
* Ensure operators follow defined research, validation, documentation, and escalation procedures.
* Answer Preparation and Knowledge Management
* Oversee the research and preparation of accurate, relevant, and customer-friendly answers to frequently asked and recurring customer queries.
* Convert unstructured information from websites, product documentation, internal teams, policies, and other approved sources into structured answers.
* Create and maintain FAQs, response templates, troubleshooting guides, decision trees, and SOPs.
* Ensure that answers are clear, concise, consistent, and aligned with approved company policies and brand communication guidelines.
* Categorise and tag answers by topic, customer intent, product, query type, and other relevant attributes.
* Establish a centralised, searchable repository of approved answers for use by customer-facing agents.
* Quality Assurance and Validation
* Define quality assurance criteria covering factual accuracy, completeness, relevance, clarity, tone, and source reliability.
* Review and approve answers before they are published or made available to customer-facing agents.
* Implement a review process for ambiguous, sensitive, complex, or high-risk queries.
* Maintain source references and ensure answers are supported by reliable, approved information.
* Identify recurring errors, inconsistencies, and knowledge gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Establish periodic reviews to retire outdated answers and update content when policies, products, or processes change.
* Query Analysis and Continuous Improvement
* Analyse customer queries to identify recurring questions, emerging topics, and unmet information needs.
* Identify queries that cannot be answered confidently using existing knowledge.
* Collaborate with relevant internal teams to obtain clarifications and resolve information gaps.
* Recommend new FAQs, response templates, and knowledge articles based on query volume and business impact.
* Improve the answer preparation process through standardisation, reusable templates, workflow optimisation, and appropriate AI-assisted tools.
* AI Readiness and Knowledge Enablement
* Structure approved answers so they can be consumed by AI-powered customer support tools and agent-assist platforms.
* Ensure knowledge assets are organised, searchable, traceable to their sources, and maintained through defined ownership and review processes.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to make approved knowledge available through relevant systems and integrations.
* Support the evaluation of AI-generated answers against human-validated reference answers.
* Analyse incorrect or incomplete AI responses and coordinate updates to the underlying knowledge, instructions, or response logic.
* Contribute to the gradual adoption of AI-assisted research, response drafting, quality checks, and knowledge maintenance.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, English, Information Management, or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in knowledge management, customer support operations, content operations, research operations, quality assurance, or a similar role.
* At least 1–2 years of experience managing a team or coordinating the work of multiple operators, researchers, or content specialists.
* Excellent written communication, research, editing, and information synthesis skills.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to distinguish verified information from assumptions.
* Experience creating FAQs, response templates, knowledge articles, process documentation, or SOPs.
* Ability to define operational workflows, monitor productivity, and enforce quality standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify recurring patterns in customer queries.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, documentation tools, knowledge management systems, and collaboration platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with customer support platforms, helpdesks, CRM systems, or knowledge management tools.
* Familiarity with conversational AI, chatbots, AI copilots, or generative AI applications.
* Understanding of prompt design, knowledge retrieval, and AI response evaluation.
* Experience working with structured content, taxonomies, metadata, and searchable knowledge repositories.
* Exposure to quality assurance frameworks, service-level agreements (SLAs), and operational performance dashboards.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Answer Accuracy: Percentage of answers meeting defined factual accuracy and validation standards.
* Quality Acceptance Rate: Percentage of submitted answers approved without major rework.
* Turnaround Time: Average time taken to research, prepare, review, and publish an answer.
* Knowledge Coverage: Percentage of priority customer query categories covered by approved answers.
* Operator Productivity: Number of validated answers produced per operator within the defined period.
* Knowledge Freshness: Percentage of knowledge assets reviewed and updated within the prescribed review cycle.
* Reusability: Percentage of approved answers reused by customer-facing agents rather than recreated from scratch.
* Knowledge Gap Resolution: Percentage of identified knowledge gaps resolved within agreed timelines.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will build a reliable knowledge operations function in which a trained team of human operators consistently produces accurate, validated, and reusable answers. Customer-facing agents will have access to a trusted source of information, reducing research effort, response preparation time, inconsistencies, and avoidable escalations.
  
  
Over time, the knowledge repository will also provide a validated foundation for AI-assisted support and automated customer interactions.

**About SunInfra**

SunInfra Energies Ltd is an integrated renewable energy platform serving commercial, industrial and institutional consumers. Our
**Develop, Build and Own**
model connects project development, EPC delivery and long-term asset ownership.

Our portfolio spans rooftop and utility-scale solar EPC, open-access solar parks, captive and group captive projects, battery energy storage integration, and operations and maintenance. We are building a clean energy platform that enables consumers to transition towards round-the-clock renewable energy through integrated generation, storage and energy management solutions.

**The opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced leader to take overall responsibility for project execution and operations across SunInfra’s portfolio.

Working directly with the Founder & CEO, you will lead teams, strengthen execution systems and drive accountability for delivery timelines, project profitability, quality, safety, complete project closure and operating asset performance.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Lead project delivery:**
  Oversee projects from award through engineering coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning and client handover.
* **Strengthen planning and execution:**
  Establish project schedules, budgets, resource plans and milestones. Conduct portfolio reviews and site inspections, resolve bottlenecks and implement recovery plans.
* **Own commercial performance:**
  Control execution costs, protect project margins and monitor forecast completion costs. Coordinate milestone certification, billing and collection follow-up with clients and Finance.
* **Manage contractors and suppliers:**
  Oversee scope, productivity, measurements, variations, claims, reconciliations and final settlements.
* **Ensure quality and safety:**
  Enforce quality standards, inspection processes and safe working practices. Ensure defects, equipment damage and execution risks are promptly reported, investigated and resolved.
* **Complete technical and commercial closure:**
  Ensure punch-list completion, performance testing, approvals and handover documentation. Prepare detailed project-wise techno-commercial closure reports, obtain relevant departmental sign-offs and client acknowledgement, and drive resolution of all outstanding matters.
* **Lead operations and asset performance:**
  Oversee O&M and AMC delivery, preventive maintenance, response timelines, plant performance, operating costs, warranties, spares and site security.
* **Build teams and systems:**
  Develop project managers, construction teams, site engineers, coordinators and O&M teams. Establish clear responsibilities, SOPs, dashboards and review routines.
* **Manage stakeholders:**
  Work closely with clients, consultants, contractors, utilities and internal departments to resolve escalations and maintain clear communication.



**Candidate profile — essential requirements**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil or a related engineering discipline.
* **10+ years of experience in EPC or infrastructure project execution and operations is mandatory**
  , including at least five years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and geographically dispersed teams against agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Strong understanding of engineering and construction interfaces, EPC contracts, cost control, commissioning and project economics.
* Proven ability to manage contractors, resolve client issues and achieve complete technical and commercial closure.
* Strong communication skills in English, sound commercial judgement and a disciplined, proactive approach.
* Comfortable with project scheduling tools, Excel, ERP systems and management reporting.
* Willingness to work from Thane and travel regularly across project sites and company offices.

**Preferred experience**

Experience in solar or renewable energy—including rooftop and ground-mounted projects, open-access parks, captive/group captive assets, BESS or O&M—is preferred. Experience building teams and systems within a growing EPC or infrastructure organisation will be valued.

**Why join SunInfra?**

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with the Founder & CEO, shape the execution and operations organisation, and contribute across an integrated renewable energy portfolio.

Email your CV and a brief summary of projects handled, team size, responsibilities and key achievements to hr@suninfra.co.in.

Application – Head – Projects & Operations

title: Drydock Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal-driven and thrive in a high-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
  
  
**Position Description:**
This position is responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and financial oversight of vessel drydocking and major repairs including unplanned and retrofits across a global fleet. The position serves as the primary technical link between the company, shipyards, and classification societies to ensure the dry-dock projects are delivered safely and on schedule.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**
  
  

* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL-005), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines.
* Project Planning & Preparation: Lead the pre-planning phase, including pre-docking inspections, developing detailed technical specifications (standard and non-standard), and coordinating with vessels and vessel managers to identify specific repair needs. Making sure Seaspan vessels are docked at the most suitable and economical shipyard, at the most appropriate time and in the most cost-effective manner. Liaising with the vessel to order spares and stores prior docking in a timely manner. Liaising with the procurement team and local agency to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of spares required for project execution.
* Shipyard & Vendor Management: Review shipyard quotations for accuracy & include missing items in the bid sheet, conduct cost/availability comparisons, and provide recommendations. Manage relationships with paint suppliers, subcontractors, and service providers.
* On-site Supervision: With the support of Vessel Managers, oversee all stages of drydock execution at the shipyard to ensure high-quality workmanship, adherence to timelines & budgets, and compliance with safety and environmental standards (QSHE). Assist Vessel manager in resolving operational issues to minimize downtime and delays
* Financial Control: Along with the Vessel Manager, manage the overall repair budget, monitor project expenses in real-time, and lead final invoice negotiations with the shipyard to identify cost-optimization opportunities. Variations in docking scope to be documented and approvals sought from relevant stakeholders. Ensure Maximum value from allocated Dry-dock budgets and costs saving potentials are harvested. Preparing 5-year CAPEX rolling budget forecast for the fleet with Vessel Managers. Analyze docking costs and invoices to identify cost optimization opportunities. Follow up with service vendors for any variation in repair cost.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all work meets the requirements of classification societies, flag states, and international maritime regulations.
* Process Improvement: Improve and maintain standardized drydock procedures, software, and databases to track historical costs and performance metrics in line with industry-wide best practices.
* Documentation & Reporting:

+ Maintain dry-dock records, inspection reports, and repair logs
+ Ensure document control and compliance with audit requirements

**Requirements:**

* Education: Degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Professional Experience:

+ Minimum 5–8 years of experience in ship management, superintendency, or shipyard project management.
+ Proven track record of managing large-scale drydocking projects and retrofits
+ Sailing experience as a Senior Engineer (e.g., 2nd Engineer or higher) is preferred.
+ Technical Skills:

  
  

+ Proficiency in drydock management software, ERP systems, and project management tools. Technologically driven, comfortable working in a digital environment, logical process development.
+ Leveraging data and system functionality to improve decision-making and operational performance.
+ Focus on standardization, continuous improvement, and workflow optimization across technical and operational activities.

**Core Competencies:**

* Project Management: Ability to manage complex, multi-million-dollar projects under tight deadlines.
* Negotiation: Assertive skills for handling shipyard contracts and final settlements.
* Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to coordinate with cross-functional teams, including fleet operations, marine assurance, procurement, and accounts.
* Mobility: Readiness for frequent international travel on short notice and ability to conduct physical vessel inspections.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Drydocking Planning Performance: Percentage deviation from planned costs and duration.
* Budget Alignment: Preparing competitive budget. Total project spend versus allocated budget.
* Vessel Turnaround Time: Minimizing downtime and ensuring on-time or before-time delivery from the yard.
* Safety & Quality: Number of health, safety, and environment (HSE) incidents or quality findings during the project.
* Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement: Demonstrates management commitment to continual improvement

Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Data Center Operations Cluster Manager, BOM - DCO
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Data Center Operations Manager is a senior leadership role for our compute operations teams within an AWS region. They will have managerial responsibility for safety, security, availability, scaling, costs and efficiency for their department. They lead the team that is installing, maintaining, and de-commissioning network and server equipment in a safe, secure and cost-effective manner across the region. The Data Center Operations Manager must manage across each function but also have the ability to dive deep into any given function as needed. They must have a strong background on people management with a team size of 60+ employees.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems. The candidate will have a strong understanding of network and compute architecture and have experience managing repair requests in a high volume environment, as well as managing response to high severity events. They will have a strong track record of developing talent, and managing performance of their team and organization. They will be creating, and tracking budgets; strategically planning through use of metrics; sponsoring, reporting and delivering large projects while proposing technical solutions to complicated problems. This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive continuous improvement and the ability to keep pace with our explosive growth while motivating others to meet the challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Managers and Engineers across multiple data centers, installing, maintaining and decommissioning network and server hardware.
  
  

* Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience.
* Strategic planning and forecasting; manage team and individual performance; delivering performance reviews, and address staffing needs
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
* Mentor, train and develop career progression for direct reports and members of the organization.
* Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective.
* Coordinate support of change management resources in partnership with electrical and mechanical operations teams.
* Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the region and with peers globally.
