title: Regional Logistics In charge (RLI)
description:
**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Supply Chain
 



 Positions : 2
 



 Location : Mumbai
 



**Role Purpose** 




 The Regional Logistics In charge is responsible for end\-to\-end regional logistics execution, ensuring seamless C\&F operations, inventory integrity, on\-time customer service, optimized secondary transportation costs, statutory compliance, and audit readiness across depots and distributors. The role plays a critical link between plants, depots, sales teams, and transporters, especially during peak beverage seasons.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. C\&F /CFA KPI Monitoring** 



* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of C\&F agents across the region to ensure compliance with company SOPs.
* Ensure inbound receipts, storage, dispatches, manpower deployment, and asset utilization are as per agreed SLAs.
* Drive productivity, cost control, and operational discipline at all C\&F locations.
* Review and finalize C\&F billing, validate claims, and ensure adherence to contractual terms.



  





**2\. Inventory Management \& Controls** 



* Maintain optimal inventory levels at C\&Fs and redistribution points aligned with sales forecasts and plant supply plans.
* Monitor stock ageing, slow/non\-moving inventory, damages, expiries, and obsolescence.
* Ensure 100% inventory accuracy through cycle counts and periodic physical stock audits.
* Investigate and close stock variances, shortages, and excesses with root cause analysis and corrective actions.



  





**3\. Order Management \& Customer Service** 



* Ensure order processing, allocation, and dispatch are executed within defined TATs.
* Coordinate with Sales, Planning, and C\&Fs to manage order prioritization during peak demand.
* Track order fill rate, OTIF (On\-Time\-In\-Full), delivery adherence, and resolve customer complaints.
* Drive service improvements through exception management and proactive communication.



  





**4\. Secondary Transportation \& Freight Negotiation** 



* Manage secondary freight operations from C\&F to distributors/retailers.
* Lead transporter onboarding, lane finalization, and rate negotiations to optimize cost\-to\-serve.
* Monitor freight adherence, vehicle placement, turnaround time, and delivery performance.
* Control freight costs through route optimization, load consolidation, and productivity improvements.



  





**5\. Compliance, Audits \& Governance** 



* Ensure compliance with statutory, taxation, food safety, and internal control requirements.
* Conduct regular audits of C\&Fs, transporters, and logistics processes.
* Close audit observations within timelines and implements preventive controls.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, safety norms, and risk management practices.



  





**6\. Supply Network Design \& Optimization** 



* Support regional supply network design including location, addition, consolidation, or rationalization of C\&Fs and redistribution points based on volume growth, service requirements, and cost\-to\-serve analysis.
* Evaluate depot\-to\-market reach, delivery lead times, and freight economics to improve network efficiency and responsiveness.
* Lead end\-to\-end onboarding of new C\&F agents, including site evaluation, commercial finalization, system readiness, and SOP deployment.
* Assess infrastructure adequacy (warehouse space, handling equipment, manpower, IT systems, safety norms) before onboarding.
* Ensure seamless transition during C\&F changeovers, including inventory handover, transporter alignment, and customer communication.
* Train C\&F teams on company processes, compliance requirements, inventory controls, and service standards.
* Periodically evaluate C\&F performance and capability; recommend continuation, expansion, or replacement based on SLA adherence and audit outcomes.



  





**7\. Performance Management \& Reporting** 



* Track and publish regional logistics KPIs including:
* Inventory accuracy \& DOH
* OTIF / service level
* Secondary freight cost per case
* C\&F productivity \& compliance
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve service, cost, and control.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 



* Graduate in Commerce / Engineering / Logistics / Supply Chain
* MBA / PG Diploma in Supply Chain (preferred)



**Experience** 



* 8–15 years of experience in logistics / distribution operations within FMCG or beverage companies
* Strong exposure to C\&F operations, secondary logistics, inventory controls, and audits
* Prior experience handling high\-volume, seasonal distribution environments is critical



  





**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of FMCG / Beverage distribution dynamics
* Hands\-on experience with WMS / ERP (SAP preferred)
* Data\-driven, detail\-oriented, and operationally strong
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple locations and pressure situations during peak season

 prajjwal.mukhopadhyay@parleagro.com

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 verQ is an HR marketplace that connects startups and established companies with verified HR professionals across Recruitment, Payroll, Compliance, HR Operations, and Training. Organizations can post their requirements and receive matches with vetted experts within 48 hours, enabling faster and more reliable hiring decisions. verQ operates on a transparent flat\-fee model, rather than charging a percentage of CTC, providing cost predictability for clients. There is no exclusive mandate or retainer; clients pay only when a hire joins, supported by a 60\-day free replacement guarantee. This model allows verQ to offer flexible, high\-trust HR solutions for growing businesses.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Ecommerce Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for strategising, managing and growing a beauty brand's online presence and digital sales channels. This role oversees day\-to\-day e\-commerce operations, including product listings, pricing, promotions, and catalog optimization to drive traffic and conversion. The Ecommerce Manager collaborates with marketing and sales teams to plan campaigns, track performance, and refine strategies based on data insights. Daily tasks include monitoring analytics dashboards, managing customer journeys and funnels, coordinating with internal stakeholders for content and offers, and ensuring a seamless end\-to\-end online experience. The role also involves identifying new opportunities for revenue growth, improving processes, and maintaining alignment with verQ’s brand and business goals.
 



  




**What You'll Do** 
**Business \& Growth Strategy** 
* Work directly with the founders on strategic growth initiatives across D2C, marketplaces, and quick commerce.
* Identify revenue opportunities and build plans to improve overall business performance.
* Drive projects across multiple teams to ensure timely execution.
* Monitor category trends, competition, pricing, and customer behaviour to recommend business actions.


**Marketplace \& Quick Commerce Management** 
* Own relationships with platforms including Amazon, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart, Myntra, and others.
* Drive business planning, growth initiatives, promotional calendars, and platform partnerships.
* Ensure smooth onboarding of new products and launches across all platforms.
* Oversee catalog health, content quality, pricing, inventory, and merchandising.


**Business Operations** 
* Track daily sales, revenue, profitability, and key business metrics.
* Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and weekly/monthly business reviews.
* Analyse SKU\-level performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Monitor inventory planning, stock availability, replenishment, and forecasting.
* Understand and monitor P\&L across channels.


**Cross Functional Coordination** 
* Coordinate with marketing, supply chain, finance, operations, design, and performance teams.
* Ensure launches happen smoothly across every platform.
* Manage external marketplace account managers and agencies.
* Drive projects end\-to\-end with complete ownership.


**We're Looking For Someone Who** 
* Has
 
**3–6\+ years** 

 of experience in D2C, FMCG, consumer brands, or beauty.
* Has managed Amazon, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Is comfortable working with data, Excel, reports, and business dashboards.
* Understands P\&L, margins, inventory planning, forecasting, and business metrics.
* Can independently manage multiple stakeholders.
* Loves solving problems and taking ownership.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Thinks like an entrepreneur, not just an employee.


**Bonus Points If You** 
* Have scaled a D2C or beauty brand.
* Have experience in quick commerce.
* Understand marketplace advertising and performance marketing.
* Have worked closely with founders or leadership teams

title: Procurement Lead
description:
**About Lohono Stays:**




 Lohono Stays by Isprava offers discerning travelers luxury homestays across some of the most iconic holiday destinations in India and Southeast Asia, including Goa, Phuket, Alibaug, Bali, and beyond. With a curated portfolio of 350\+ exclusive homes, we deliver not just beautiful spaces but immersive local hospitality—personalized service, locally inspired meals, and unforgettable vacation experiences.
 



 Backed by marquee investors like the Godrej and Piramal family offices, Lohono Stays has become the preferred choice for industrialists, celebrities, and global travelers seeking elegant getaways.
 



  





**Isprava** 
 , our Parent company, is India’s leading luxury home developer, creating bespoke villas that blend heritage with contemporary sophistication.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





**Team \& People Management** 



* Manage, mentor, corporate, warehouse and rider teams across Mumbai and Goa, ensuring adequate coverage and timely deliveries.
* Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular reviews, build a culture of accountability.
* Identify and resolve day\-to\-day issues within the team — from workload and scheduling conflicts to performance gaps — before they escalate.



  





**Vendor Management** 



* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage vendors across all procurement categories (F\&B supplies, linen, guest amenities, maintenance, housekeeping supplies, etc.).
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, and service\-level agreements to ensure quality and cost\-efficiency.
* Build and maintain a vendor scorecard system tracking quality, pricing, and responsiveness.
* Maintain a healthy vendor pipeline/backup options to avoid dependency on a single source.



  





**Process Integrity \& Compliance** 



* Ensure procurement is conducted with full honesty and transparency — competitive quotes, documented approvals, and clear conflict\-of\-interest policies.
* Maintain proper documentation for purchase orders, invoices, and contracts.
* Put in place checks and approval workflows that prevent misuse, kickbacks, or unauthorised purchases.
* Ensure compliance with company policy and relevant local regulations.



**Quality Assurance** 



* Design and run quality audit and testing protocols for incoming goods (linen, amenities, F\&B supplies, maintenance materials, etc.) before they reach properties.
* Conduct periodic vendor site audits to verify hygiene, storage, and quality standards.
* Set up a sampling/inspection process and escalation path for any quality deviations.



  





**Inventory \& Warehouse Management** 



* Oversee stock levels, reordering thresholds, and wastage control at the warehouse.
* Ensure proper warehouse organisation, storage standards, and safety practices.
* Coordinate with the rider team to ensure timely, accurate deliveries to properties, tracking delivery SLAs.



  





**Data, Analysis \& Reporting** 



* Track procurement spend, cost savings, vendor performance, and inventory metrics.
* Build regular dashboards/reports for management covering budget vs. actuals, category\-wise spend, and quality metrics.



  





**Cross\-functional Coordination** 



* Work with operations teams across locations (Goa, Alibaug, Lonavala, Coonoor, Srinagar, Mussoorie) to forecast procurement needs.
* Partner with finance on budgeting, invoicing, and payment cycles.
* Liaise with corporate team members in Mumbai and Goa to align on priorities.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* Strong vendor negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Proven people management and team leadership abilities.
* Analytical skills — comfortable working with spend data, dashboards, and reports (Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with procurement/ERP tools like Zoho, Tally, or SAP Ariba is a plus).
* Strong sense of ethics and integrity in handling procurement decisions.
* Working knowledge of quality control/audit processes.
* Logistics and inventory management understanding.
* Problem\-solving skills with a methodical, structured approach.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-location teams and vendors simultaneously.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and self\-driven.

title: Assistant Manager - WM SCS Equity Option Derivatives
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Controller (Assistant Manager)
   

  

**Department:** 
 Wealth Management – Operations (Equity Option Derivatives)
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The Wealth Management (WM) – Derivatives Operations team is responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle management of Equity Derivatives. This includes processing complex trade types such as OTC Equity, Bonds, Index, Listed, and Exotic Options, as well as Swaps. The function is critical in ensuring trade accuracy, regulatory compliance, and seamless settlement processes to support the bank’s trading activities and client requirements.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The Controller is responsible for the accurate processing and lifecycle management of derivative instruments. The role focuses on maintaining the integrity of bank and client positions, ensuring strict adherence to the operational permanent control framework, and managing the reconciliation of cash and securities. The Controller acts as a key liaison between dealers, counterparties, and the Front Office to resolve discrepancies and mitigate operational risk.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**
* Execute the accurate and timely processing of OTC Equity, Bond, Index, Listed, and Exotic Options and Swap trades, ensuring continuity during public holidays.
* Maintain and update trade data in the Olympic system to ensure both bank and client positions are accurately reflected.
* Verify and authorize cash settlement instructions to Nostro banks, ensuring timely settlement and managing all related cash outflows.
* Liaise actively with dealers, counterparties, and the Front Office to identify and resolve trade discrepancies promptly.
* Review, sign, and manage transaction supplements, counterparty confirmations, and manual client advice; proactively monitor and follow up on non\-receipt of confirmations.
* Investigate and resolve Nostro and securities reconciliation breaks, including the pursuit of necessary interest claims.
* Strictly adhere to internal procedures, control measures, and regulatory requirements. Monitor and report error trades to management and ensure the formal receipt of incident reports.
* Ensure all spread charges remain within the monetary limits stipulated in the “Disclosure of Sales Related Information” and obtain formal management approval for any special waivers.
* Review daily control reports, monitor late or failed trades, and provide regular updates to Management to mitigate operational impact.
* Serve as a point of contact for queries from the Front Office, Advisory Desks, and counterparties to ensure smooth functional operations.
* Systematically update and maintain the database worksheets for all option trades.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Contribute to the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day\-to\-day business activities.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements and support ad hoc projects as required by management.
* Identify and contribute to workflow improvements to enhance operational efficiency and mitigate risk.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Minimum 7–8 years of experience in Derivatives Operations or a similar control\-oriented role.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Management, or a related field.
* Prior experience in Equity Derivatives or OTC markets is highly preferred.


**Technical Skills**
* In\-depth knowledge of Equity, Bond, and Derivative products (Options/Swaps).
* Proficiency in trade lifecycle management and settlement processes.
* Strong understanding of reconciliation, Nostro management, and control frameworks.


**Behavioral Skills**
* High level of meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for stakeholder management.
* Proactive mindset with a focus on risk mitigation and operational excellence.


**Education Level** 
 : Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai

The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. title: Interior Contracting Purchase Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Interex Arch Designs Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9002 certified interior contracting firm operating across thirteen states in India, with strong presence in the domestic and commercial markets for over a decade. The company focuses on delivering comprehensive post\-design interior solutions under one roof, emphasizing spaces that reflect each client’s unique ideology and brand. Interex specializes in turnkey projects for commercial complexes, financial institutions, hotels and restaurants, call centers, retail stores, and corporate offices. A multidisciplinary team manages services such as gypsum work, partitions, carpentry, plumbing, electrical work, air conditioning, painting, polishing, and civil work. The firm is known for exceptional workmanship, competitive pricing, adherence to deadlines, and long\-standing relationships with high\-profile clients including Future Group, Reliance, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Mahindra Retail, and others.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Interior Contracting Purchase Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai. The role involves managing end\-to\-end procurement for interior contracting projects, including sourcing materials, negotiating with vendors, and ensuring timely delivery to project sites. The Purchase Manager will prepare and process purchase orders, maintain accurate inventory and procurement records, and align purchases with project budgets and quality standards. The role requires close coordination with project managers, site supervisors, designers, and subcontractors to understand material specifications and project timelines. The Purchase Manager will regularly evaluate suppliers, track market rates, optimize costs, and support compliance with company policies and ISO procedures.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Proficiency in procurement and vendor management, including sourcing, negotiation, and purchase order processing.
* Strong knowledge of interior contracting materials and services such as carpentry items, gypsum and partition materials, electrical and plumbing fixtures, paints, polishes, and HVAC\-related supplies.
* Ability to manage inventory, monitor stock levels, and coordinate logistics to ensure timely delivery of materials to multiple project sites.
* Experience in budget control, cost optimization, and basic commercial understanding of contracts, quotations, and invoices.
* Competence in using MS Office and relevant ERP or procurement software for documentation, reporting, and record keeping.
* Effective communication and coordination skills to work with project teams, site staff, vendors, and management.
* Strong attention to detail, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* Prior experience in interior contracting, construction, or fit\-out industry in a purchase or procurement role is highly desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Supply Chain Management, Commerce, Business Administration, Civil/Interior/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Understanding of ISO or similar quality management systems and adherence to company policies and ethical procurement practices.

**Position Summary**
 The Global Command Center Operations Manager is responsible for leading the 24x7 Global Command Center responsible for monitoring, event correlation, incident response, escalation coordination, operational communications, and service reliability across critical infrastructure, applications, networks, job scheduling, and telephony services. This role provides operational leadership for geographically distributed teams and ensures that Command Center functions consistently meet availability, resiliency, compliance, and service management expectations.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, metrics\-driven operations leader with strong ITIL/ITSM discipline, deep infrastructure operations awareness, and the ability to translate technical events into clear executive\-level business impact. This leader will drive process maturity, automation, alert quality, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across global operations while maintaining a high\-accountability and service\-focused team culture.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
 Operational Leadership and Service Reliability
   

  

* Lead day\-to\-day and shift\-based 24x7 Global Command Center operations across monitoring, triage, escalation, incident communications, and operational coordination.
* Oversee functional coverage for server operations monitoring, network operations monitoring, application operations monitoring, lab operations monitoring, Helix/Control\-M job scheduling, Windows and Linux L2 support, and Genesys/IP telephony operations.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, uptime expectations, alert response targets, escalation procedures, and operational performance metrics.
* Drive proactive monitoring, event correlation, alert tuning, runbook quality, and automation to reduce noise, improve response times, and minimize manual intervention.
* Maintain operational readiness for high\-severity events, business\-impacting incidents, planned maintenance windows, and critical change activity.


 Incident, Problem, and Change Management
   

  

* Lead Command Center participation in major incidents by coordinating bridge engagement, ensuring role clarity, maintaining focus on service restoration, and escalating to appropriate technical and leadership teams.
* Partner with Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, infrastructure, application, security, and vendor teams to support fast restoration and durable corrective actions.
* Review incident trends, recurring alerts, failed jobs, chronic infrastructure events, and escalation patterns to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support post\-incident reviews, root cause analysis, known error documentation, corrective/preventive action tracking, and lessons\-learned adoption.
* Ensure Command Center teams follow approved change, incident, problem, access, and communication processes.


 Governance, Compliance, and Audit Readiness
   

  

* Create, maintain, and enforce SOPs, technical runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, operational checklists, and process documentation.
* Ensure operational evidence is complete, accurate, timely, and defensible for internal reviews, SOX audits, control testing, and regulatory inquiries.
* Partner with security, risk, compliance, and technology owners to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, access protocols, and data protection expectations.
* Establish governance routines to review operational metrics, control gaps, aged actions, process exceptions, and continuous improvement progress.


 Team Leadership and Talent Development
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of team leads, engineers, analysts, and operations specialists across multiple shifts and domains.
* Own staffing plans, shift coverage, onboarding, training, performance expectations, development plans, succession planning, and quality accountability.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, operational discipline, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to monitor team engagement, morale, readiness, skill gaps, escalation behaviors, and adherence to operational standards.


 Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs including availability, SLA adherence, alert volume, alert aging, MTTA/MTTR, escalation effectiveness, incident recurrence, job failure trends, change\-related incidents, and runbook compliance.
* Prepare concise executive\-level updates on operational health, incident trends, risk areas, improvement plans, staffing readiness, and service reliability.
* Use data to identify systemic issues, automation opportunities, process bottlenecks, and training needs.
* Partner with tool owners and engineering teams to improve dashboards, observability, event correlation, workflow automation, and operational intelligence.


 Vendor and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Manage vendor engagement related to operations tools, monitoring platforms, job scheduling, infrastructure services, telecom platforms, and support escalations.
* Hold vendors and internal service teams accountable for service delivery, timely escalation, issue ownership, and contractual/service commitments.
* Serve as an operational bridge between senior leadership, infrastructure teams, application teams, security, service management, vendors, and site leadership.
* Support budget planning, resource planning, capacity needs, tool rationalization, and operational investment recommendations.


**Skill Requirements/Preferences**
 Required Skills and Experience
   

  

* 12\+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure operations, technology operations, command center, NOC/SOC/AOC, service management, or related enterprise technology functions.
* 8\+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers, team leads, engineers, analysts, or shift\-based operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing global or multi\-site operations with cross\-functional responsibility for service reliability, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and executive communication.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, major incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and service level management.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, alerting, ITSM, and job scheduling platforms such as ServiceNow, Helix, Control\-M, SolarWinds, Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, AppDynamics, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server operations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, network fundamentals, firewalls, VPNs, SD\-WAN, DNS/DHCP, telephony/VoIP, and application operations monitoring.
* Experience creating operational dashboards, performance reporting, service health reviews, incident trend analysis, and continuous improvement plans.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, access control, SOX, control evidence, policy adherence, and operational governance processes.
* Strong vendor management, escalation management, service accountability, and stakeholder communication capabilities.


**Preferred Technical Skills**
* Experience with hybrid cloud environments including Azure, Oracle Cloud, AWS, VMware vSphere, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience improving event management through alert rationalization, event correlation, automation, AIOps, or runbook orchestration.
* Familiarity with resiliency practices including disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity planning, lifecycle management, backup/recovery, high availability, and operational risk reduction.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation concepts using PowerShell, Python, Bash, API integrations, workflow automation, or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts.
* Experience leading transformation efforts that modernize command center operations, reduce toil, improve service health visibility, or improve incident response maturity.


 SOME OF THE SOFT SKILLS / ABILITIES REQUIRED FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE INCLUDE
   

  

* Calm, composed leadership during high\-pressure, business\-impacting incidents.
* Clear, concise, and audience\-appropriate communication for executives, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to command and control incident bridges while maintaining accountability, urgency, and respectful collaboration.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision\-making when managing competing business, technical, and operational demands.
* Ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, service health, and actionable leadership updates.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build trust, develop team leads, provide feedback, and reinforce standard work.
* High ownership and follow\-through across open actions, recurring issues, audit items, staffing needs, and operational risks.
* Process discipline with the ability to standardize work, reduce ambiguity, document expectations, and drive consistent execution.
* Strong analytical capability with a focus on metrics, trend analysis, root cause thinking, and measurable improvement.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority and create alignment across geographically distributed stakeholders.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, global, shift\-based environment where priorities may change quickly.


**Additional Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL Managing Professional, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Linux, Cisco, VMware, ServiceNow, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience leading a global command center, NOC, SOC, AOC, infrastructure operations center, managed services operations, or enterprise service reliability function.
* Experience building or maturing operating models, RACI matrices, escalation frameworks, QA programs, knowledge management practices, or operational control points.
* Experience with financial services, payments, ATM, retail banking, regulated infrastructure, or other high\-availability customer\-impacting technology environments.
* Experience supporting business continuity, disaster recovery exercises, command center readiness testing, crisis management, or operational resilience programs.
* Experience managing cross\-cultural teams, offshore/onshore delivery models, and vendor\-supported services.


**Education Requirements**

* Master’s degree in Information Systems, Technology Management, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
* Relevant professional certifications may be considered in combination with demonstrated leadership and enterprise technology operations experience.


 WORK ENVIRONMENT AND EXPECTATIONS
   

  

* Full\-time role based in Mumbai, India with expectation to work from the office five days per week unless otherwise approved by leadership.

****Who We Are Looking For****
 We are seeking an experienced Officer‑level professional for our Equity Swaps Corporate Actions team, responsible for overseeing and executing day‑to‑day BAU processing for Equity Swaps in line with the operating model, internal SLAs, and control frameworks.
   

  

 The role sits within State Street Markets Operations’ Financing Solutions business, supporting the Prime Services Equity Swaps product. The Officer will act as a key point of escalation and subject matter expert, partnering closely with Trading, Swap Operations, Stock Loan, Custody, and Risk teams to manage mandatory and voluntary events, restrictions, and lifecycle processing in a controlled, audit‑ready environment. Corporate actions on equity swaps represent a high‑risk, high‑complexity operational area where errors can directly impact P\&L, client outcomes, and regulatory posture. As an Officer, this role plays a critical part in safeguarding economic neutrality, ensuring accurate processing outcomes, and reinforcing a strong control and escalation framework across synthetic and hedge books.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets which is transforming our operating model that provides support to sales and trading desks across all regions EMEA, APAC and North America 24/6\. Since synthetic market access is growing globally, Prime Services are expanding their product offering to include Equity Swaps. Clients take advantage of a range of financing solutions, from memo\-pledge and self\-financing to self\-borrow and repledge. Our Secured financing solution offers accessibility to cash investment and financing outlets for a wide range of institutional participants. State Street is one of the largest agent’s lenders in the world, with over 40 years of experience and more than 250clients across multiple global markets. Our depth of lendable assets and strong market position provides more trading opportunities When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSGM business unit. Join us to make your mark in the capital markets industry.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For****
 As Equity Swaps Corporate Actions (Prime Services)\-Manager, you will:
   

  

* Oversee and perform processing of mandatory and voluntary corporate actions and dividend events impacting Equity Swaps portfolios.
* Manage and review event lifecycle activities including event capture, entitlement calculation, election processing, and settlement of cash and stock outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for complex or time‑sensitive voluntary corporate action elections, providing guidance and decision support as required.
* Ensure accurate booking and alignment of corporate action adjustments across swap and custody accounts.
* Review, investigate, and resolve breaks related to positions, entitlements, or cash flows, determining root cause and appropriate remediation.
* Oversee execution of daily, event‑based, and periodic controls, ensuring adherence to documented procedures and control standards.
* Escalate material issues, control gaps, or processing risks in line with governance and escalation frameworks.
* Provide support and guidance to Senior Associates on complex processing, investigations, and control execution.
* Liaise with internal teams including Swap Operations, Trading, Stock Loan, and Custody to resolve issues and manage event impacts.
* Support responses to internal and external queries related to swap‑linked corporate actions and income events.


****What We Value****
* These skills will help you succeed in this role
* Strong technical understanding of corporate actions and asset servicing within an Equity Swaps or Prime Services environment.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment in managing risk, prioritizing issues, and determining when escalation is required.
* Strong reconciliation, investigative, and problem‑solving skills.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure, especially around critical market deadlines.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time‑management skills.


****What You Will Bring To The Role****
* Strong front‑to‑back understanding of Equity Swap Operations processes, lifecycle events, and interactions between synthetic and physical positions.
* Hands‑on experience supporting front‑office exception management, middle‑office systems, and downstream settlement / payment processes.
* Familiarity with systems such as NUVO, TRAIANA, DUCO, or similar platforms is an added advantage.

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 GCOR Trade Surveillance team monitors firm’s trading activity from a market abuse/market manipulation perspective. Global trade surveillance activities are designed to adhere to financial services laws, rules and regulations to determine whether key controls are operating as intended and are effective in terms of mitigating compliance risk (e.g. compliance policy, standard or procedure). Continuous surveillance of business activities is performed through automated systems (SMARTS, Actimize etc.) and filters. Surveillance is also performed through patterns and trends analysis, and manual reviews.
   

  

 This team in GCOR Trade surveillance will work very closely with the APAC Regional Trade Suverillance teams to conduct surevillance efforts on fixed income and equities
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Individuals will be part of the Trade Surveillance group supporting one of the global regions AMRS, EMEA and APR. Individual will be responsible for monitoring trading activities across multiple asset classes for market abuse and manipulation. The individuals will also be responsible for investigating potential compliance/control room issues with multiple levels of management for appropriate disposition
   

  

**Responsibilities\***

 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for US marketplaces, including top\-line revenue, contribution margins, and platform\-specific fees.

**2\. Amazon \& Walmart Channel Mastery**

**3\. High\-Performance Advertising (PPC)**

 Direct and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display ads to maintain a target ACOS/TACOS.

 Implement aggressive keyword\-bidding strategies to capture market share from competitors in the premium fragrance and essential oil categories.
* **DSP \& External Traffic:** 

 Explore and manage Amazon DSP or external traffic drivers (Social to Amazon) to boost ranking and BSR.



**4\. Cross\-Border Logistics \& Inventory Planning** 



* **Demand Forecasting:** 

 Coordinate with the Mumbai and Silvassa teams to forecast US demand, ensuring stock is manufactured and shipped in time to avoid stockouts.
* **FBA/WFS Management:** 

 Manage shipments from India to US 3PLs or Amazon/Walmart fulfilment centers.
* **Efficiency:** 

 Optimize "Inventory Age" and minimize storage fees through strategic liquidation or promotional pulses.



**5\. AI\-Driven Operations** 



* **Automation:** 

 Implement AI tools for automated keyword research, sentiment analysis of customer reviews, and competitive price monitoring.
* **Content Scaling:** 

 Use LLMs to rapidly iterate on ad copy, A/B test listing titles, and automate routine reporting tasks.
* **Sentiment Analysis:** 

 Leverage AI to decode "Voice of Customer" data from reviews to inform the R\&D team in India for future product iterations.

* **Marketplace Core:** 

 Amazon Seller Central and Ads (Expert), Walmart Seller Center, eBay.

 Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Viral Launch.

 Amazon Advertising Console, Pacvue, or Perpetua.
* **AI Stack:** 

 ChatGPT/Claude (for SEO \& Copy), Midjourney (for creative ideation), and Excel/Google Sheets (Advanced formulas \& Pivot Tables).
* **Operations:** 

 Experience with ERPs and cross\-border shipping documentation (ShipStation, etc.).



**Core Strengths** 



* **The "Global\-Local" Mindset:** 

 Ability to translate Indian manufacturing excellence into a brand voice that resonates with US luxury buyers.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 

 You don’t make guesses; you make data\-backed decisions based on click\-through rates, conversion rates, and session data.
* **Agility:** 

 The US marketplace landscape changes weekly (algorithm updates, fee changes); you must be able to pivot strategy instantly.



**The Ideal Fit** 



* You have a proven track record of managing a $1M\+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) portfolio on Amazon US.

 If you are ready to take a heritage Indian brand to the global stage, send your resume and a summary of your biggest marketplace "win" to
 
**hr@incredibleindriya.com** 

 .

title: Head of Environmental Services (UK&I) GCC
description:

 The UK\&I GCC Head of Environmental Services (E\&E) is expected to demonstrate effective and visible leadership, focusing on employee engagement, retention, and capability development. The role will build high\-performing teams delivering
 **Landscape \& Urban Design, Cultural Heritage \& Archaeology, and Acoustics services** 
 to UK clients, supporting infrastructure planning and environmental projects.
   

  

 This position involves close collaboration with UK\&I Environmental Services and other Earth \& Environment teams within the E\&E Business Unit in UK \& GCC. The Head of Environmental Services will provide strategic guidance on attracting talent, improving team utilization, embedding consistent practices, and ensuring high\-quality delivery. The role is growth\-oriented, supporting our ambition to expand GCC Environmental Services through new service lines, capability building, and delivering high\-value services that meet evolving UK market needs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Leadership \& Team Management**
* Lead and represent the India\-based Environmental Services team (Landscape, Heritage, Archaeology, Acoustics) as the primary point of contact, collaborating with WSP UK E\&E teams.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment, and onboarding to meet growth targets.
* Oversee local compliance with health, safety, welfare, risk management, and environmental legislation.
* Foster a “one team” UK–GCC culture, encouraging open communication and collaboration.


**Technical Excellence**

* Oversee production of high\-quality outputs such as masterplans, heritage conservation strategies, archaeological assessments, and acoustic studies.

**Success in this Role Means**
* Strong, trusted UK–GCC relationships in environmental services.

* New capabilities built and embedded across disciplines.
* High\-quality delivery aligned to UK standards.
* Clear, scalable operating model between UK and GCC.
* Growing, motivated Environmental Services E\&E team.

title: Manager - Customer Technical Service, India
description:
**Roquette** 
 is a family\-owned global leader in plant\-based ingredients and a leading provider of pharmaceutical excipients.
   

  

**Want to help us make a difference?**
 Using plant\-based resources, we collaborate with our customers and partners to imagine and offer ingredients to better feed people and treat patients.
   

  

 Each of our ingredients responds to unique and essential needs, and they enable healthier lifestyles.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Team Leader – Food Application Scientist** 
 to lead our India Application (CTS) Laboratory and drive technical innovation across Savory, Baking, Dairy, Beverage, Confectionery, and Plant\-Based applications. This role combines strong people leadership with hands\-on application development, customer engagement, and cross\-functional collaboration to support business growth and innovation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a seasoned food scientist with deep technical expertise, strong commercial acumen, and proven experience leading high\-performing teams in an international food ingredients environment.
   

  

 This position will be located in
 **Mumbai.**
**Our Team**
 Drawing insights from customer interactions, our CTS team develops, formulates, and evaluates our customers' products in the labs.
   

  

 As the markets we serve at Roquette are Global, the CTS teams are globally based to better serve our customers around 4 areas (Europe, Americas, Greater Asia \& China).
   

  

 The CTS team builds strong partnerships with our Global R\&D, as well as our commercial and marketing teams, to enhance customer service and support.
   

  

**Their mission?**
 To support the NBI’s business growth for Greater Asia region focusing on India with application work in the Dairy, Beverage and Confectionery Area. In addition to that, to support the technical development role India for local customers and channel partners.
   

  

**Your Experience And Talents Will Make The Difference To**
**Team Leadership \& Application Excellence**
* Lead and develop the India Food Application (CTS) team, fostering a high\-performance and collaborative culture.
* Ensure timely and effective technical support for customer projects involving both new product development and existing ingredient portfolios.
* Prioritize application projects in partnership with Commercial and Marketing teams to support strategic business objectives.
* Coach and mentor team members, supporting their technical and professional development.
* Promote a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and scientific excellence.


**Customer \& Technical Support**
* Provide expert application support to customers across Dairy, Beverage, Confectionery, Savory, Baking and Plant\-Based Nutrition segments.
* Visit customers regularly to support product development, technical discussions, troubleshooting, training programs, and innovation workshops.
* Collaborate with channel partners on customer visits, product concepts, technical training, promotional campaigns, and business opportunity development.
* Deliver technical presentations, seminars, and application training for internal and external stakeholders.
* Together with Marketing team, coordinate, plan and execute promotional events like trade shows, customer seminars and webinars.


**Product Development \& Innovation**
* Provide strategic technical leadership in identifying, evaluating, and translating new ingredient technologies into commercially viable food applications for the Indian market. Develop innovation roadmaps and recommend product development strategies based on market insights, customer needs, competitive analysis, and technical feasibility.
* Lead the development and evaluation of innovative food and beverage applications, including:
+ Savory – sauces, dressing, meat, non\-meat
+ Baking – snacks, cereals, cakes etc
+ Dairy products
+ Plant\-based alternatives
+ Specialized nutrition
+ Ready\-to\-drink beverages
+ Ready\-to\-mix powders
+ Yogurt
+ Paneer
+ Confectionery applications

* Design, execute, and evaluate laboratory and pilot\-scale trials using a scientific approach.
* Conduct shelf\-life studies, analytical testing, and performance evaluations of application prototypes.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of laboratory activities, trial results, reports, and technical presentations while supporting innovation and intellectual property initiatives.


**Laboratory Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure laboratory operations comply with company safety, food safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve laboratory SOPs, processes, and best practices.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and support efficient day\-to\-day laboratory operations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance laboratory efficiency and effectiveness.


**Collaboration \& Global Connectivity**
* Partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Quality, R\&D, and Global Food CTS teams to deliver customer\-focused solutions.
* Collaborate with global CTS teams to share technical knowledge, best practices, and support cross\-regional projects.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and market trends through participation in technical forums and industry events.


**Additional Key Responsibilities – Laboratory Setup \& Infrastructure Management**
* Lead the planning, setup, expansion, and continuous enhancement of food application laboratories in line with business and innovation requirements.
* Define laboratory infrastructure requirements, including utilities, workflow design, food safety, hygiene, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate, recommend, and procure laboratory and pilot\-scale equipment based on application needs, technical specifications, budget, and long\-term business objectives.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Procurement, EHS, and Quality teams during laboratory design, commissioning, equipment installation, qualification, and validation.
* Develop equipment qualification, calibration, preventive maintenance, and lifecycle management plans to ensure reliable laboratory operations.
* Ensure laboratory facilities comply with food safety, regulatory, and company standards while driving continuous improvement in laboratory capabilities.


**What We Will Love About You**
* Strong business and commercial acumen with a customer\-centric mindset.
* Deep understanding of the Indian food ingredients and food applications market.
* Excellent technical knowledge of Savory, Baking, Dairy and Beverage applications.
* Strong influencing, stakeholder management, and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Outstanding presentation, communication, and technical training skills.
* Proven leadership capability with experience mentoring, coaching, and developing technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with experience working in multicultural and cross\-functional teams.
* Passion for innovation and delivering customer\-focused solutions.


 And also …
   

  

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of experience in Food Application, Product Development, or Technical Service within the food ingredients industry.
* At least 10 years of hands\-on experience in Savory, Baking Dairy and Beverage applications.
* Experience in Plant\-Based Nutrition and Specialized Nutrition is highly desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of people management experience, leading technical or application teams.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects within a multinational or international organization.
* Demonstrated customer engagement, technical problem\-solving, and innovation capabilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across cultures.


**Why Join Us?**
 This is an opportunity to lead a high\-impact technical team, shape customer innovation, and contribute to the development of next\-generation food solutions while collaborating with global experts in a dynamic international environment.
   

  

**If you identify yourself in this position, please apply by uploading your resume and let's start the journey together!**
 Roquette is proud to be a global company where you can find personal and professional growth through multiple diverse experiences.
   

  

 Roquette strives to create a dynamic workforce while remaining firmly committed to equal opportunity by complying with EEO laws.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, Roquette understands that to be successful we must always be inclusive in our approach.
   

  

 To find out more about our products, values and sustainable development ambitions visit us at www.roquette.com and at www.sustainability.roquette.com

title: Independent Director
description:
More choice can disguise duplication, poor differentiation and trapped working capital. The Director will challenge the architecture of categories, opening price points, premium ladders, private labels and seasonal ranges. Management should demonstrate which customer missions each range serves, how products earn space online and in stores, and when a slow\-moving item will be marked down, returned, repurposed or exited.
 



  





 Board reporting must connect assortment breadth with availability, margin, inventory age, fulfilment complexity and customer satisfaction. Revenue growth that depends on proliferating low\-productivity stock\-keeping units should be recognised early.
 



  





 Items used for cooking, storage and household organisation can create safety, durability and disclosure obligations. The Director will examine supplier qualification, material declarations, product testing, labelling, complaint investigation, batch traceability and recall readiness. Private\-label ambition must be matched by clear ownership of specification and quality—not delegated informally to the supplier.
 



  





 When an adverse signal appears, the Board needs a decision process that protects customers before legal certainty is complete. The appointee will ask whether marketplace sellers, imported ranges and exclusive products are governed to comparable standards.
 



  





 The Director will help the Board look beyond gross billing to realised margin after discount, funding, payment cost, fulfilment, returns, damage, loyalty benefits and clearance. Supplier rebates and promotional support should be recognised only when the underlying conditions are evidenced. Channel teams must not shift inventory or cost between stores, digital operations and marketplaces to make one route appear successful.
 



  





 The Board will expect the appointee to probe price integrity, personalised offers, dark patterns, misleading scarcity messages and the fairness of refund or exchange practices.
 



  





 An omnichannel promise depends on accurate location\-level stock, dependable reservation and a rational fulfilment decision. The Director will oversee management’s response to phantom inventory, cancelled orders, split shipments, store\-pick failures, shrinkage and reverse\-logistics leakage. Investment proposals for automation, distribution capacity or new stores should be tested against demand density and the full cost to serve.
 



  





 The appointee will insist on decision\-ready store economics: mature versus ramp\-up performance, occupancy burden, local catchment, cannibalisation, labour productivity, omnichannel contribution and exit costs. Lease commitments need downside cases and explicit approval limits. A flagship’s strategic value may be real, but it must be articulated and reviewed rather than used indefinitely to excuse poor economics.
 



  





 Loyalty and personalisation can improve relevance, but they also create privacy, consent and security duties. The Director will question what data is collected, why it is retained, how models shape offers, and whether customers can exercise meaningful choice. Technology partners, payment providers, delivery networks and marketplace channels should be subject to risk\-based oversight and incident responsibilities that are understood before failure.
 



  





**The Board contribution beyond oversight** 




  





 The new Director will participate in annual strategy, capital\-allocation and leadership reviews. They should help management balance store expansion, digital capability, supply\-chain resilience, private\-label development and brand investment. The Board wants independent thinking on customer proposition and disciplined experimentation: pilots need hypotheses, decision dates and stopping rules.
 



  





 The appointee may serve on audit, risk, stakeholder or nomination and remuneration committees. They will support succession planning for merchandising, operations, technology and supply\-chain leadership; review incentives for unintended behaviours; and seek direct assurance where management information does not reconcile with customer or employee experience.
 



  





**The person sought** 




  





 The mandate suits a former chief executive, chief operating officer, commercial leader, supply\-chain leader, finance leader or digital\-retail executive who has governed a multi\-category consumer business.
 



  





 Experience with sourcing, private labels, inventory, store economics, e\-commerce or consumer protection is strongly relevant. The candidate must be comfortable moving from a customer complaint to its systemic operational and financial implications.
 



  





 Independence, curiosity and willingness to visit operations are essential. Applicants must hold active IICA Independent Directors Databank registration and disclose current interests involving suppliers, marketplaces, landlords, logistics providers, payment companies or competing retailers.

description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
   

  

**Job Summary**
* The Manager, Business Operations will manage day\-to\-day broking back\-office operations across trading support, clearing \& settlement, risk operations, depository (DP), reconciliations, and client service. The role is hands\-on and execution\-focused, ensuring timely settlements, accurate reconciliations, strong controls, and regulatory compliance with SEBI, Exchanges, Depositories, and Clearing Corporations. You’ll work closely with Technology, Compliance, Finance, and front\-office teams to drive operational stability and incremental automation.


****Core Responsibilities \& Duties****
****1\) Trade Support, Clearing \& Settlement****
* Manage daily clearing and settlement activities with NSE Clearing / BSE Clearing ensuring timely fund flows and demat deliveries.
* Ensure accurate processing of pay\-in/pay\-out, settlement obligations, shortages, auction handling, and exception resolution.
* Track settlement timelines and ensure adherence to exchange/clearing corporation cut\-offs.


****2\) Margins, Collateral \& Risk Operations (Operational Execution)****
* Support accurate computation/collection of margins, MTM, and exposure; monitor margin shortfalls and coordinate timely actions.
* Maintain daily controls around risk checks, limit breaches, and operational risk events; escalate issues with clear root\-cause and fix plan.


****3\) Reconciliations \& Controls****
* Own daily/periodic reconciliations including exchange, client ledger, bank, depository, and settlement\-related reconciliations.
* Ensure breaks are investigated, evidenced, resolved within defined TATs, and reported through appropriate governance.
* Maintain strong maker\-checker controls, audit trails, and documentation aligned to internal policies and regulatory expectations.


****4\) Client Lifecycle \& Service Operations****
* Oversee operational processing for client onboarding, activation, and modifications, ensuring compliance with SEBI KYC, PMLA, FATCA/CRS requirements.
* Manage operational aspects of investor grievance handling in line with SEBI timelines, SCORES, and exchange mandates; ensure accurate responses and closure evidence.


****5\) Regulatory Reporting \& Audit Support****
* Prepare/review operational inputs for regulatory filings such as EOD reports, margin reporting, capital adequacy support packs, and audit responses.
* Support internal/external audits and regulatory inspections by providing accurate data, reconciliations, SOPs, and evidence packs.
* Ensure SOPs and process notes are current and reflect regulatory circulars and operational changes.


****6\) Technology \& Process Improvement****
* Work with Technology/Product teams on OMS/RMS/BO operational issues, UAT support, and production incident triage.
* Identify automation opportunities in reconciliations, statements, payout workflows, and settlement tracking; help define requirements and validate outcomes.
* Track operational SLAs, recurring issues, and drive closure through structured problem management.


****7\) Key Interfaces****
* Internal: Compliance, Finance, Technology, Product, Risk, Client Service
* External: Exchanges, Clearing Corporations, Depositories, Banks, Technology partners


****Mandatory Qualifications, Certifications \& Experience****
* Education: Graduate in Commerce / Finance / Business Administration/Engineering. MBA or equivalent preferred.
* Recommended Certifications:
* Mandatory NISM Series VII \- Securities Operations and Risk Management
* Good to have: NISM Series\-VIII: Equity Derivatives; NISM Series\-VI: Depository Operation; NISM\-Series\-XXIV: AML and CFT Provisions
* Experience: Minimum 4\+ years in stock broking operations, clearing, or depository functions,
* Domain Knowledge: Deep, functional knowledge of NCL \& ICCL settlement processes, reconciliation, risk operations, collateral management, reporting, and back\-office accounting software


****Preferred Skills \& Competencies****
* Expert\-level domain knowledge of broking back\-office operations and regulatory requirements
* Deep familiarity with SEBI Master Circulars, Exchange operational rules, Depository Operating Instructions, and PMLA requirements
* Proven ability to scale high\-volume broking operations with operational resilience
* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work under strict deadlines
* Proficiency in risk management and internal controls
* Strong stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Experience working within large broking or financial institutions is a strong plus


**Note**
 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

description:

The role translates enterprise, regional, and local priorities into high\-value outcomes for employees and business stakeholders while maintaining clear accountability for service delivery, people, budget, vendors, risk, projects, and sustainability. The Site Lead also anticipates emerging needs, builds evidence\-based business cases, and influences decisions that strengthen operational resilience and workplace effectiveness.

* Team Leadership and Capability: Build and lead an inclusive, high\-performing One BlackRock team comprising employees and outsourced partners, with clear goals, strong succession, disciplined performance management, and continuous capability development.
* Financial, Risk, and Compliance Ownership: Own annual planning, budget performance, forecasting, controls, and mitigation of operational, financial, regulatory, health and safety, business continuity, security, and reputational risks.
* Vendor and Commercial Performance: Govern strategic supplier relationships, contracts, scopes of work, service levels, key performance indicators, and business reviews to deliver quality, value, innovation, and timely remediation.
* Projects and Change Delivery: Sponsor and oversee local projects with the India Hub Lead and regional and global functions, ensuring robust governance, stakeholder readiness, delivery to scope, schedule, budget, and intended benefits.
* Sustainability and Continuous Improvement: Reduce the site’s environmental impact, advance enterprise sustainability commitments, and use data, feedback, and external insight to identify scalable improvements and build compelling business cases.


**Success Measures**
* Service delivery consistently meets or exceeds agreed SLAs, KPIs, employee experience targets, and stakeholder expectations.
* Operating and project expenditure is delivered within approved plans, supported by accurate forecasts, transparent trade\-offs, and demonstrated value.
* Material risks, audit findings, incidents, and vendor underperformance are identified early, escalated appropriately, and remediated within agreed timelines.
* Projects achieve agreed scope, schedule, budget, adoption, and benefits, while sustainability initiatives show measurable improvement against site targets.


**Core Capabilities**
* Strategic and commercial leadership, including strong financial acumen and sound judgment across competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead diverse teams, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver outcomes through a matrix organization.
* Strong command of workplace operations, supplier governance, projects, leases, travel, health and safety, business continuity, and corporate security.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, supported by high emotional intelligence, organization, and disciplined execution.
* Proficiency with integrated workplace management systems, data analysis, and financial modelling tools to support evidence\-based decisions.


**Experience And Qualification**
* Minimum 10 \-18 years of relevant industry experience, including at least two years with independent accountability for a complex site or comparable operation.
* Proven experience in client service, budget ownership, supplier management, risk and compliance, and cross\-functional project delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required; facilities management, hospitality, real estate, or business education preferred.
* Facilities Management Professional certification, or an equivalent recognized credential, preferred.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

title: Assistant Manager- Client servicing | Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
 BYLD Group is committed to making a difference to people and their organizations through its decades of excellence in business solutions, diverse corporate exposure, and skilled workforce. Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.
   

  

 Founded in the year 1998, BYLD is the largest group in the South Asian region, offering technology\-enabled HR and business productivity solutions. We have served 5,00,000\+ individuals, worked with more than 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 60% of the Business World top 1000 companies.
   

  

 Please read about us – www.byldgroup.com
   

  

**Designation \-** 
 Assistant Manager \- Client Servicing
   

  

**Experience \-** 
 5\-6\+ Years
   

  

**Location \-** 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Client Servicing professional will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day relationships with clients, ensuring smooth manpower deployment and operations, and coordinating with internal recruitment, HR, payroll and compliance teams to deliver agreed staffing services effectively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage day\-to\-day communication and relationship with assigned clients.
* Understand client manpower requirements and coordinate with recruitment teams for timely deployment.
* Ensure joining, onboarding, documentation and induction of deployed manpower.
* Monitor attendance, absenteeism, attrition and manpower productivity.
* Coordinate with clients for attendance validation, overtime, incentives and other payroll inputs.
* Ensure timely submission and resolution of payroll\-related queries.
* Coordinate with HR/compliance teams for PF, ESIC, UAN, KYC, labour\-law and statutory compliance.
* Handle employee grievances and coordinate with the concerned teams for quick resolution.
* Track replacements, new manpower requirements and employee exits.
* Conduct regular client visits and review meetings.
* Prepare and share MIS reports covering manpower deployment, attendance, attrition, vacancies and operational performance.
* Follow up on client approvals, work orders/POs, invoices and payment\-related issues wherever required.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend corrective actions to improve service quality.
* Maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders and identify opportunities for business expansion.
* Ensure adherence to agreed SLA/KPI and service\-level commitments.
* Escalate critical operational issues to senior management with a proposed action plan.
* Manage and collect client payments.
* Agreement renewal \& negotiations


**Key Skills\-**
* Excellent client communication and relationship\-management skills
* Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities
* Good understanding of staffing/manpower operations
* Knowledge of payroll and statutory compliance
* MIS and Excel proficiency
* Problem\-solving and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage multiple clients and priorities
* Willingness to travel for client visits


**Why Join BYLD**
**Perks \& Benefits:**
* Learn directly from industry experts with 20\+ years of experience
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Gain experience in world class management practices
* Insurance Benefits (Medical and Accidental) for all employees
* Multi\-level Rewards programs for all employees


**Follow Us**
 – https://www.linkedin.com/company/byld\-group/
   

  

 – https://www.facebook.com/BYLDGroup/
   

  

 – https://twitter.com/BYLDGroup

title: Problem Manager
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Problem Manager
   

  


**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
   

  





 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa\-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high\-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
   

  





**About the Role** 




 Agfa is looking for an experienced
 **Problem Manager** 
 to join its Global ICS (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end Problem Management process across a complex ecosystem of internal IT teams, managed service providers, and strategic technology partners. Your primary objective will be to identify, analyze, and eliminate the root causes of recurring incidents, thereby improving service stability and enhancing the overall user experience.
 



 As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will facilitate root cause investigations, and ensure that sustainable corrective actions are implemented. You will play a critical role in reducing operational risk, improving service performance, and driving continuous improvement across Agfa's global IT landscape.
 



**About You (Skills Required)** 




 You are a proactive and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex operational challenges and driving service improvements. You excel at working with diverse stakeholders, influencing teams without direct authority, and coordinating efforts across multiple service providers.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong analytical and root cause investigation capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* A structured and process\-oriented approach to service management.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence and service stability.



**What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Lead and continuously improve the global Problem Management process.
* Coordinate problem investigations across internal teams, service providers, and technology partners.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities for recurring and major incidents.
* Ensure the identification, tracking, and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Facilitate collaboration between technical teams to resolve complex and cross\-functional problems.
* Provide regular status updates and reporting to business stakeholders and leadership.
* Manage escalations related to problem investigations and resolution activities.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and identify opportunities for continuous service improvement.
* Perform trend analysis, reporting, and metrics tracking to proactively identify improvement opportunities.
* Act as backup for the Incident Manager when required.



**What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven track record in Problem Management roles.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes and best practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher certification is preferred.
* Experience working in SIAM (Service Integration and Management) and multi\-supplier environments.
* Understanding of service integration, governance, and operational reporting.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional technical teams in large\-scale IT environments.
* Strong analytical skills with proven experience conducting Root Cause Analysis and driving permanent resolutions.
* Excellent stakeholder, communication, and vendor management capabilities.
* High degree of flexibility and willingness to support critical problem investigations and major incident follow\-up activities outside standard business hours when required in a global environment.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a major digital transformation initiative.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization focused on operational excellence and service quality.
* Collaborate with international teams, strategic technology partners, and business stakeholders worldwide.
* Play a key role in improving service stability and preventing recurring business\-impacting issues across Agfa's global IT environment.



 If you are passionate about root cause analysis, continuous improvement, and driving sustainable service excellence in a complex global IT landscape, we invite you to join Agfa and help shape the future of our IT services.
