title: Assistant Department Manager - Piping Engineering - OGC
description:
**Description**
 BMI OGC is excited to be opening a position for ADM (Piping Engineering). This position has a career progression that leads to DM and eventually Engineering Manager.
   

  

 At Burns \& McDonnell India we are committed to making a positive impact on the oil, gas \& chemical industry as our world strives towards a low\-carbon future. We are changemakers and problem solvers with more than 100 years of experience.
   

  

 We offer front\-end engineering, engineering/project management, and a proven track record of project execution excellence utilizing a variety of delivery methods. This includes systems capabilities, a portfolio of subject matter expertise and technical competencies. We offer a range of methods and digital solutions enabling an efficient engineering process.
   

  

 Our multidiscipline teams transcend existing plant design practices, develop new solutions and solve our clients’ challenges to enable technical feasibility and sound business decisions.
   

  

**WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?**
 The Assistant Department Manager (ADM) reports to the Department Manager (DM) \- Piping and is responsible for the managerial direction and leadership of the department. This includes supporting and executing business strategy, innovation, automation, developing high\-performance teams, and promoting the Burns \& McDonnell culture, values and mission. The ADM will support the DM in leading the department in a dynamic and profitable manner based on Burns \& McDonnell's core values of client satisfaction, commitment, dedication, integrity, safety and overall outstanding service.
   

  

 The OGC Global Practice executes engineering, procurement and construction projects in industries of Refining, Midstream \& Logistics, Petrochemical and Chemicals. OGC Piping Engineering is a dynamic group that has grown to \~50 people driven by technical excellence and focused on delivering advance engineering \& design services – this includes Piping Material Engineering, Stress analysis, Client 3D model reviews, and Isometrics.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Leadership and Management:
* Provide assistance to the Department Manager (DM) in discharging all the DM responsibilities
* Allocate resources effectively to project teams, address staff challenges, including hiring and onboarding new members
* Maintain the team's skill matrix, identify training needs, organize training and keep track of software changes
* Effectively deploy the BMI quality system, utilize the BMI database of previous projects and apply good engineering practices related to the piping department work, including adherence to applicable codes and standards.
* Monitor the progress of quality objectives, gather quality\-related feedback from all sources and address them.
* Update work instructions and engineering standards; prepare technical bulletins that establish annual goals, initiatives and competitive quality benchmarks for the team
* Conduct performance reviews, obtain 360\-degree feedback and take responsibility for the career development of team members
* Provide mentorship, identify the emerging ‘knowledge leaders’ of the department, guide their professional development and leverage their expertise tofulfill department development objectives.
* Identify and nurture high\-potential employees to build a leadership pipeline
* Promote inter\-disciplinary, inter\-GP and inter\-office collaboration and operate as the communication link between team members and senior management
* Interpret company policies for the team, which include aligning the efforts of team members with the overall business strategy, translating the organization's goals into specific actions
* Build relationships with leading cadre in BMI and other BMcD offices, collaborate with section managers, other ADMs, DMs, project managers, project engineers and the talent acquisition team
* Disseminate safety awareness (especially safety in design), promote constructability awareness, drive innovation, automation and process optimization efforts
* Initiate positive organizational changes within the team, embrace changes advocated by the organization’s leadership, foster a positive team culture and promote the culture of servant leadership
* Work with the DM to lead the Piping department through various phases of strategic change, introduce new methodologies, innovations, automation and new business approaches
* Business development and client management: Represent the organization to external agencies and in industry forums, engage in networking through professional societies/seminars and author papers for professional journals
* Project Responsibilities:
* Lead projects in unique situations, while balancing primary responsibilities as the ADM
* Guide and monitor the work of lead engineers and project teams against plans, focusing on quality, budget and schedule KPIs
* Review and approve project execution plans, RACI matrix, QC review matrix, workhour estimation, etc., oversee activities like scheduling, project progress monitoring, change management, risk management, resource planning, cost estimating and more
* Interpret project scope/contract on projects
* Review and approve standard discipline deliverables and documents such as critical line list, stress packages, standard supports, engineered supports and more
* Provide oversight to constructability reviews, modularization strategies, installation sequences and access/maintenance philosophy, proposing location and type of pipe supports, vendor documents review, resolving site queries and RFIsOversee engineering activities for brownfield projects, including tie\-in design, field verification and coordination with as\-built documentation and laser scan


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or chemical engineering
* A minimum of 15 years of experience in Piping
* A minimum of 3 years as Lead Engineer on OGC projects
* Experience in Petrochemicals, Chemicals, Refining and/or midstream and logistics projects
* Authoritative knowledge of design, selection, fabrication and operation of piping domain and all kinds of advanced analysis, deliverables and technical review
* Extensive knowledge in procurement contract processes, including bidding and techno\-commercial evaluation
* Extensive understanding of contemporary digitalization developments, emerging trends in design and engineering practices and market developments in the energy sector
* Ability to listen effectively, behave compassionately and display an appropriate level of assertiveness
* Maintain regular, appropriate and concise communication
* Excellent negotiation, influencing and decision\-making skills and very good systems thinking competence
* Global collaboration skills and cultural adaptability to effectively lead international teams


**Why Join Us?**
 At Burns \& McDonnell India, you’ll be empowered to build not just projects, but your career. Our expansive service offerings mean stability, job security and incredible potential for growth. We take on the world’s toughest challenges and use our skills, experience, and courage to solve them.
   

  

**A Caring Place Where Careers Grow**
 Our entrepreneurial spirit sits at the foundation of who we are as an organization and constantly drives us forward toward innovation, strategic growth, and service excellence. We believe in putting forth our ﬁnest effort, including on behalf of our employee\-owners. Our beneﬁts package includes comprehensive beneﬁts that demonstrate our commitment to the well\-being of the individuals who contribute to our clients’ success every day.
   

  

**Work From Home (as per policy)**
 The ability to work from home is available as per company policy, providing flexibility and work\-life balance where applicable. Hybrid models may apply depending on role and department.
   

  

**Flextime and Day Flextime Program**
 Flextime allows employees to choose their own start and end times within a set range. Employees have an option to choose staggered working hours — with an option to work for six hours at the office and two hours remotely — depending on their schedule.
   

  

**Bus Service**
 We provide a dedicated company bus service for a comfortable, timely, and cost\-effective commute for all employees.
   

  

* Multiple pickup points
* Saves on travel costs
* Provides on\-time arrival
* Stress\-free daily travel


**On\-Site Fitness Facility**
 Each on\-site ﬁtness facility provides employees with convenient access to exercise equipment and classes that support physical well\-being and a healthy lifestyle.
   

  

**Employee Engagement Activity**
 From vibrant cultural celebrations like events that honor diversity and inclusion, we foster a workplace where everyone feels part of a thriving, collaborative culture. The events not only reflect our values but also build lasting memories, boost morale, and strengthen workplace bonds.
   

  

**And many more...**

title: Head – Project
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**NMDPL:** 
 Navbharat Mega Developers Pvt. Ltd. (NMDPL) is a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) formed through a joint venture between the Government of Maharashtra and the Adani Group. It leads the Dharavi Redevelopment Project, aiming to transform one of Asia’s largest informal settlements into a modern urban hub with sustainable housing, infrastructure, and economic opportunities.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The role is responsible for overseeing and managing all civil construction activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, safety regulations, and quality standards. This role involves leading a team of engineers and contractors, conducting site inspections, and coordinating with various stakeholders to achieve project objectives efficiently and effectively.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Lead Project Construction**
**Technical Management**
 Provide technical guidance and advice to design staff, supervisors, inspectors, and contractors regarding civil construction practices.
   

  

 Analyze civil engineering issues and formulate effective solutions to ensure compliance with project requirements.
   

  

 Conduct structural analysis and design for buildings across various sectors, ensuring technical quality and compliance with project objectives, safety, and quality standards.
   

  

 Prepare and check detailed structural calculations and review drawings in line with project quality procedures.
   

  

 Develop and review detailed plans, specifications, and cost estimates for civil construction projects.
   

  

**Project Documentation**
 Review project documents, including tenders, specifications, bills of quantities (BOQs), material submittals, and shop drawings for compliance with design intent.
   

  

 Draft and issue site/engineer’s instructions related to civil construction works as required.
   

  

 Review and provide feedback on contractors’ Operation and Maintenance manuals to ensure comprehensive project documentation.
   

  

**Inspection And Compliance**

description:
**About Angel One:** 




  





 For nearly three decades, Angel One has been making investing and wealth creation more accessible and engaging for Indians. Today, 3\.7\+ crore customers trust Angel One across investing, trading, wealth creation, and credit.
 



  





 We are one of the best fintech platforms, building simple, intelligent and seamless financial experiences for millions of users across the country. From investing and trading to wealth creation and credit, everything we build is focused on making financial journeys easier, faster, more accessible and engaging.
 



  





 We believe strong fundamentals matter—in investing, in technology and in the way we build our teams. Trust, simplicity, speed and long\-term thinking shape how we work and what we build.
 



  





 Here, people work on real problems at real scale. Millions of users interact with our platform every day, and every team plays a role in shaping that experience.
 



  





 We move fast, take ownership and keep learning along the way. No matter the role, people here are encouraged to share ideas, challenge the usual and build things that create real impact.
 



  





 If you're excited to solve meaningful problems, build at scale, and shape the future of financial services, you'll fit right in.
 



  





 Be part of our team that’s scaling sustainably, thinking big, and building for the billion!
 



  





**Job Title:** 
 Lead – US Stocks
 








**Location:** 
 Mumbai / Bengaluru
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced business leader to build, scale, and own our US Stocks business. This is a strategic leadership role with end\-to\-end responsibility for defining the vision, driving growth, and delivering business outcomes for one of our key investment offerings.
 



 As the Business Owner, you will be responsible for the complete lifecycle of the business—from strategy and go\-to\-market to product innovation, pricing, customer acquisition, partnerships, and commercial performance. You will work closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to establish a market\-leading platform for investing in global equities.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who has built and scaled digital businesses, products, or investment platforms and thrives in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 









**Business Ownership \& Strategy** 



* Own the end\-to\-end P\&L and growth of the US Stocks business.
* Define the long\-term business vision, strategic roadmap, and annual operating plan.
* Identify new growth opportunities, revenue streams, and business models to accelerate scale.
* Drive sustainable growth while balancing customer experience, profitability, and regulatory requirements.



  





**Go\-to\-Market \& Business Growth** 



* Develop and execute the go\-to\-market (GTM) strategy for customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.
* Identify target customer cohorts and define tailored acquisition, engagement, and cross\-sell strategies.
* Build scalable growth engines across digital channels, partnerships, referrals, and ecosystem integrations.
* Drive adoption of the US Stocks offering through data\-driven experimentation and continuous optimization.



  





**Product \& Customer Experience** 



* Own the product vision and roadmap for the US Stocks business.
* Identify customer pain points and market opportunities to launch differentiated products and features.
* Prioritize initiatives that improve onboarding, trading experience, customer engagement, and long\-term retention.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Design, Operations, Compliance, and Risk teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.



  





**Commercial Strategy** 



* Define pricing, brokerage, subscription, and monetization strategies that enhance customer value while improving business profitability.
* Evaluate commercial levers, promotional campaigns, and pricing experiments using data and market insights.



  





**Business Analytics \& Performance** 



* Own business performance metrics and establish a robust operating cadence.
* Lead funnel analysis across acquisition, onboarding, activation, funding, trading, and retention to improve conversion and customer lifetime value.
* Leverage customer cohort analysis and behavioral insights to identify opportunities for growth and optimization.
* Present business performance, strategic recommendations, and investment priorities to senior leadership.



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitive Positioning** 



* Continuously benchmark the US Stocks offering against domestic and global competitors.
* Track industry trends, customer behavior, regulatory developments, and emerging investment products.
* Recommend strategic initiatives to strengthen competitive positioning and create differentiated customer value.



  





**Leadership \& Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Lead cross\-functional teams to execute strategic priorities with speed and excellence.
* Partner with Marketing, Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Customer Support to successfully launch and scale initiatives.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on customer obsession, innovation, accountability, and execution.



  





**Who you are:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in business leadership, general management, strategy, product management, category management, or P\&L ownership within fintech, wealth management, capital markets, broking, asset management, or digital financial services.
* Proven track record of building, launching, and scaling high\-growth businesses, digital platforms, or investment products.
* Demonstrated experience owning business strategy, GTM execution, customer growth, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong understanding of investment products, capital markets, and customer behavior in wealth management.
* Experience driving pricing strategy, business analytics, funnel optimization, customer segmentation, and profitability initiatives.
* Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking with the ability to translate insights into business outcomes.
* Strong executive stakeholder management and the ability to influence across senior leadership teams.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action, ownership, and delivering measurable business impact.



  





**At Angel One, our thriving culture is rooted in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).** 









*As an Equal opportunity employer, we wholeheartedly welcome people from all backgrounds irrespective of caste, religion, gender, marital status, sexuality, disability, class or age to be part of our team.* 




*We believe that everyone's unique experiences and viewpoints make us stronger together.* 




*Come and be a part of \#OneSpace\*, where your individuality is celebrated and embraced.*

title: Lead – Technical Solutions & Projects
description:
**About Inaara NeoFoods** 




 Inaara NeoFoods is building India’s first farm\-to\-formulation platform for plant derived functional nutrients for everyday food by partnering with F\&B companies (domestic as well as exports) to develop scalable, clean\-label and commercially viable food solutions. Inaara operates at the intersection of agriculture, advanced processing, applied food science and computational nutrition.
 




  





 The founding team has deep expertise across agriculture, food systems, supply chains, technology and consumer businesses. Having built and scaled successful ventures in the agri\-food ecosystem, the founders bring a unique combination of entrepreneurial vision, operational excellence and industry relationships, positioning Inaara to build a globally relevant nutrition platform from India.
 







**Role: Lead – Technical Solutions \& Projects** 




 Inaara NeoFoods is creating a category\-defining business at the intersection of food, agriculture, nutrition and technology. The opportunity involves collaborating with global experts to pioneer next\-generation, nutrient\-rich food formulations from ground\-up.
 







 We are seeking a first\-principles problem solver who is deeply driven by purpose and comfortable navigating a fast\-evolving, dynamic environment. If you are inspired by the prospect of shaping the global future of nutrition from India, you will thrive here. We value curiosity, ownership, resilience and a long\-term vision over hierarchy and established playbooks.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Reporting to the
 **Head of Applications/R\&D** 
 and working in close strategic partnership with the Commercial
 
 team, the
 **Lead – Technical Solutions \& Projects** 
 operates across two pillars:
 






1. **Technical Core (In the Lab):** 
 A hands\-on food application scientist who anchors rapid customer prototype development at the bench, runs functional and textural characterization, leverages lab technicians, and validates pilot\-to\-plant scale\-up parameters.
2. **Customer Interface \& Project Management (Market Solutions):** 
 A customer\-facing technical consultant who translates client briefs into application roadmaps, owns projects end\-to\-end, drive timelines, demonstrates scientific and cost\-in\-use advantages to external R\&D teams to enable Sales.



  





**Location** 





 Mumbai, India
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Master’s or PhD in Food Technology, Food Science, or related field
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on formulation and application development experience
* Dual capability in bench\-top prototyping and experience managing technical projects
* Hands\-on familiarity with functional and textural characterization (texture analysis, colour, rheology)
* Experience running outsourced analytical programs through NABL\-accredited labs
* Familiarity with industrial food processing equipment and scale\-up workflows.
* Knowledge of FSSAI regulations, global food standards, labelling and nutrient\-claim requirements



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**(a) Technical Core:** 
 Bench Formulation, Prototyping \& Scale\-Up
 







* **Hands\-on Bench Prototyping** 
 : Formulate finished food prototypes across priority formats (bakery, extruded snacks, functional beverages, ready\-to\-mix powders, and plant\-based matrices)
* **Functional \& Sensory Characterization:** 
 Conduct functional, rheological, and textural characterization (viscosity, emulsion stability, texture profiling, water activity) to optimize sensory benchmarks.
* **Trial Iterations** 
 : Execute rapid reformulation cycles to troubleshoot technical issues and shortening turnaround times.
* **Pilot \& Plant Scale\-Up:** 
 Transition approved bench formulations into pilot and commercial\-scale factory trials, partnering with manufacturers to validate process parameters and line runnability.
* **Data \& Regulatory Compliance:** 
 Codify trial and formulations data, ensuring every prototype complies with FSSAI standards, export regulations, and nutritional \& clean\-label targets.



  





**(b) Technical \& Commercial Interface:** 
 Market Solutions \& Project Delivery
 







* **End\-to\-End Project Management:** 
 Own customer innovation projects across the development lifecycle \- orchestrating timelines, trial milestones, cross\-functional dependencies and risk resolution from initial brief to plant sign\-off.
* **Brief Translation \& Solution Scoping:** 
 Act as the lead technical interface for B2B client briefs; deconstruct brand targets, nutritional benchmarks, and sensory parameters into, time\-bound application sprints.
* **Client Engagement \& Co\-Development:** 
 Lead technical workshops, customer tasting sessions, and co\-creation workshops with brand teams. Articulate the functional advantages with scientific clarity.
* **Cost\-in\-Use \& Value Engineering:** 
 Model client formulation systems to demonstrate dosage efficiency, functional parity/superiority, and cost\-in\-use benefits within the customer's target cost envelope.
* **Technical Qualification \& Win\-Rate:** 
 Maximize client trial success rates by securing technical validation, sensory clearance, and factory trial approvals, delivering complete application dossiers.
* **Proactive Application Concepts:** 
 Monitor market shifts in functional foods to build proactive "push" concept kits and demonstration prototypes that enable the commercial team to unlock new clients.



  





  





**Remuneration** 



* Market Competitive
* Fixed \+ Variable

title: Software Engineering - Executive Director - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.


 Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

title: Data Center Server Operations Manager, Global Server Operations
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in computing infrastructure, network architecture, operating systems (Linux), or hardware.
* 10 years of experience managing technical teams in charge of installing, configuring, testing, troubleshooting, or maintaining hardware servers and its components.
* Experience in site\-level data center operational leadership including building and managing leadership teams and developing managers.
* Ability to work non\-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift\-based schedules as required.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience leading high\-stakes operations within 24/7 environments, including the successful management of remote teams and distributed workforces.
* Experience working in data center environments, including building and operating infrastructure, and network and compute architecture and lifecycle, and Linux/Unix system administration.
* Experience with initiating and executing strategic initiatives in a global environment.
* Experience in improving Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) initiatives and implementing a safety culture at the site level.
* Demonstrated strong performance and experience with data gathering, analysis and presentation skills.


**About The Job**
 Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state\-of\-the\-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As a Hardware Operations Manager, you will manage a team of Data Center Technicians. You will oversee the quality installation of server hardware and components and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.
   

  

 Your team will install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). They will also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. They may lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead a team of Data Center Technicians, driving operational excellence across the full lifecycle of server and network hardware. You will set clear team priorities and promote a performance culture through consistent coaching and development. You will oversee facility activities, ensuring that the installation, configuration, and decommissioning of assets align with long\-term infrastructure goals. You will manage network deployments and develop contingency plans to mitigate risks. You will maintain security and operational standards, using data trends to identify process improvements and proactively ensure maximum system uptime. You will advocate for workplace safety by overseeing Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) initiatives and compliance programs. You will ensure the data center remains a secure, efficient, and reliable environment.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of people. Set and communicate team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.
* Work together to identify and resolve problems, create solutions for our global computing and network architecture.
* Partner with internal teams to meet goals and with stakeholders to manage facility activities and implement short\- and long\-term strategies.
* Maintain, monitor, and execute security and operational procedures; track and analyze trends to identify opportunities for improvement ensuring alignment with organizational policies.
* Support the implementation of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) and other compliance programs, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure safety incidents are investigated, resolved, and reported.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Vice President Supply Chain
description:
To oversees the efficient flow of goods, information, and finances from raw material procurement to final product delivery while coordinating with suppliers, manufacturing plant and distributors to meet customer demands
 



  Supply Chain Manager: Oversee the entire supply chain, develop strategies to optimize efficiency, manage budgets, and coordinate with various stakeholders.
 



  Procurement Specialist: Should have understanding and experience of sourcing and purchase raw materials, negotiate with suppliers, manage contracts, and ensure cost\-effective procurement. Build strategic suppliers for packing material. Understand the various activities and implications of imports and fulfilment of advance licenses.
 



  Logistics Coordinator: Manage transportation, warehousing, and distribution of goods, ensure timely delivery, and optimize logistics costs.
 



  Inventory Management: Monitor inventory levels, forecast demand, manage stock replenishment, and minimize excess inventory of raw material, packing material and Finished Products.
 



  Demand Planner: Predict future product demand, create demand forecasts, and align supply chain activities with market needs. Identify minimum quantities of raw material and packing material to be kept so that economies of purchase and continuity of production can be maintained while balancing the working capital. Do ABC analysis of stocks.
 



  Product Launches \& Collaboration: Partner with business teams (R\&D, Production, Quality etc.) to support global product launches (in\-house and CMOs). Ensure timely delivery of final outputs within defined budgets and timelines.
 



  CMO: Build supplier base and Oversee procurement of CMO products at cost effective prices with continued high\-quality product supplies. Ensure quality compliance of CMO\-manufactured products through effective coordination with CMO partners, Quality Assurance, and cross\-functional teams.
 



  Cross functional activities – Plant and manufacturing coordination: Ensure seamless collaboration between Supply Chain, Production, and Quality functions to achieve timely dispatch of products while maintaining compliance and service levels. Understand the plant capacities and ensure the plant is running at optimum capacities.
 



  Risk Management: Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities in the supply chain such as supply shortages, supplier disruptions, regulatory changes and geopolitical issues. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to address challenges and business continuity.
 



  Technology and Innovation: Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies and innovations in supply chain management software, data analyst and automation.
 



  





**Competencies** 




  Hands\-on knowledge and exposure related to procurement, logistics, commercial of related materials in pharmaceutical formulations industry.
 



  Awareness on domestic/International pharma regulatory guidelines on Supply chain management.
 



  Knowledge and understanding of industry 4\.0 and its applicability in pharmaceutical industry.

title: Assistant Manager Trade Mid Office
description:

 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. **Business Descriptor**
 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Global Trade Solutions comprises over 4,500 people across more than 60 countries, helping suppliers and buyers with their export and import finance needs. Trade is where HSBC began in 1865, when we financed commerce between Europe, North America and Asia.

Furthermore, customer’s queries on the vetted format to be responded within TAT and obtain clarification from higher authorities, Legal, Risk or Business as maybe applicable to meet customer expectation.

* Liaising with internal and external stakeholders as per the job requirement.

* Scrutinize the nostro accounts on a daily basis on receiving inputs from FCD to check thoroughly all the entries originated for guarantees transactions and resolve the differences on a timely basis by liaising with appropriate parties viz., RMs, clients, etc.
* Balance all related Suspense accounts and ensure that proper actions are undertaken to recover commission for items \> 90 days.
* Review the SOX reports and other System generated reports on a daily basis to ensure that no Balance Sheet differences has occurred on account of the guarantees transacted on the previous day.
* Commission recovery is managed in a timely manner to ensure that there are no revenue leakages and following up with Risk stewards in case of pending documentation.
* Managing the trade relationships of select clients and generating revenues in line with targets.
* Scrutinizing all the Guarantee documents submitted for processing which include fresh issuance, extension, extend or pay, commission recovery and cancellation.

 Bachelor of Commerce with 2\-3 years of experience in Credit Administration, Banking Operations preferably in Guarantee/Trade Operations.

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

title: Global Stewardship Team, Vice President, Investment Management
description:
**Company Profile**
 Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals.
   

  

 At Morgan Stanley India, we support the Firm's global businesses, with critical presence across Institutional Securities, Wealth Management and Investment management, as well as in the Firm's infrastructure functions of Technology, Operations, Finance, Risk Management, Legal and Corporate \& Enterprise Services. Morgan Stanley has been rooted in India since 1993, with campuses in both Mumbai and Bengaluru. We empower our multi\-faceted and talented teams to advance their careers and make a global impact on the business. For those who show passion and grit in their work, there's ample opportunity to move across the businesses.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunities employer. We work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximise their full potential. Our skilled and creative workforce is comprised of individuals drawn from a broad cross section of the global communities in which we operate and who reflect a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives and experiences. Our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion is evident through our constant focus on recruiting, developing and advancing individuals based on their skills and talents.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This senior leadership role combines end\-to\-end oversight of MSIM's global proxy voting operations with responsibility for helping to build a scalable in\-house proxy research capability.
   

  

 The role will lead operational delivery, controls, data quality, vendor and platform management, and continuous improvement across the voting lifecycle, while partnering closely with stewardship, investment, legal, compliance, risk, operations and technology teams.
   

  

 The role requires a hands\-on individual who can manage day\-to\-day delivery, lead, coach and develop team members, exercise sound judgement on complex issues and help design the people, processes, data and technology capabilities required for the future.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Global Proxy Voting Operations
* Lead the end\-to\-end global proxy voting operating model, ensuring timely, accurate and controlled ballot receipt, meeting and agenda processing, vote instruction, transmission, confirmation, reconciliation, record\-keeping and reporting.
* Direct day\-to\-day delivery across the proxy operations team, including peak\-season capacity planning, workload allocation, quality assurance, issue resolution, training and performance support.
* Act as the senior escalation point for operational exceptions, including missing or rejected ballots, record\-date and position breaks, split\-vote requirements, share\-blocking and power\-of\-attorney markets, late instructions and platform outages.
* Partner with portfolio managers, stewardship colleagues, legal, compliance and risk teams to manage conflicts, sensitive or complex votes and market\-specific requirements, ensuring decisions and escalations are appropriately documented.
* Own the operational control framework, including procedures, service\-level standards, key risk and performance indicators, reconciliations, exception reporting, audit trails, business continuity and support for internal or external reviews.
* Manage relationships with custodians, sub\-custodians, voting agents and data providers; oversee service reviews, platform configurations, testing, issue remediation, contractual obligations and vendor performance.
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives, translating business requirements into scalable workflows and partnering with technology and data teams through design, testing, implementation and post\-launch review.
* In\-House Proxy Research \& Capability Build\-Out
* Co\-develop and execute the multi\-year strategy to increase MSIM's proprietary proxy research capability and reduce reliance on third\-party research, in line with agreed milestones, governance and risk controls.
* Help define the target research operating model, including market coverage, analyst responsibilities, research standards, policy mapping, quality\-review processes, decision documentation and knowledge management.
* Develop factual, policy\-based analytical frameworks and research outputs that support independent voting decisions and consistent application of MSIM's proxy voting policies across markets.
* Assess, select and integrate relevant governance data, issuer disclosures, voting history, analytics and technology tools, including appropriately controlled use of automation, natural\-language processing and generative AI.
* Maintain a robust voting history and rationale repository to support institutional memory, consistency, management information, client reporting and future analytics.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Essential Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in proxy voting operations, investment stewardship, corporate governance, securities operations or a closely related function within an asset manager, pension fund, custodian, voting service provider or proxy advisory firm.
* Demonstrated experience leading a complex operational function or material change programme, with accountability for delivery, controls, risk management and senior stakeholder engagement.
* Deep understanding of the institutional proxy voting lifecycle, global custody chain, market practices and leading voting platforms such as ProxyExchange, ProxyEdge or equivalent systems.
* Strong knowledge of operational controls, data governance, data quality, exception management and the translation of complex business requirements into scalable processes and technology solutions.
* Sound understanding of corporate governance and the ability to interpret and apply voting policies across different markets, ownership structures and agenda types.
* Proven people leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, make decisions under tight deadlines and explain complex issues clearly.
* Undergraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Law, Business, Accounting or a related discipline from a recognised institution.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Direct experience of governance and proxy voting in India and broader Asia\-Pacific markets, together with exposure to the US, UK or Continental Europe.
* Experience building an in\-house research capability, transitioning between voting or research providers, or implementing a new stewardship operating model.
* Familiarity with governance and market\-data platforms, research databases, workflow tools and analytics or visualisation technologies.
* Knowledge of proxy solicitation, activist campaigns, contested director elections, mergers and acquisitions, executive compensation or shareholder proposals.
* Relevant postgraduate or professional qualification, such as an MBA, CFA, CA, CS.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.

description:
**Business Function**
 Technology and Operations (T\&O) enables and empowers the Bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality and control, technology, people capability and innovation.
   

  

 The Regulatory Governance role provides end\-to\-end oversight of the Regulatory Review Group (RRG) governance framework for T\&O. The role is accountable for translating regulatory expectations into actionable requirements, driving implementation and regulatory reporting governance, and providing transparent management reporting on risks, dependencies, timelines and closure readiness.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-end regulatory governance: Take end\-to\-end ownership of regulatory requirements applicable to T\&O, from interpretation, impact assessment and implementation planning through submission, evidence validation and sustainable closure.
* RRG governance: Drive the Regulatory Review Group governance process for T\&O, including agenda setting, status consolidation, decision tracking, action follow\-up and escalation with accountable units.
* Regulatory circular interpretation: Analyse and interpret regulatory circulars, directions, advisories, correspondence, supervisory observations and commitments. Translate regulatory expectations into clear, actionable requirements for Technology and Operations stakeholders.
* Impact assessment: Lead and challenge impact assessments across processes, systems, products, controls, people, data and third\-party arrangements, ensuring all affected areas and dependencies are identified.
* Regulatory reporting oversight: Oversee governance of regulatory reporting obligations applicable to T\&O, with focus on completeness, accuracy, timeliness, data lineage, control effectiveness and adherence to regulatory expectations.
* Implementation governance: Maintain a robust implementation plan covering accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, target dates, submission requirements, closure evidence and residual risks.
* RAG and escalation: Apply clear Red\-Amber\-Green status based on delivery progress, timeline risk and unresolved dependencies. Escalate emerging delays, compliance concerns and decisions required through appropriate governance forums.
* Executive communication: Prepare concise, executive\-ready papers, dashboards and presentations that clearly articulate regulatory risks, overdue actions, implementation bottlenecks, decisions required and matters requiring escalation.
* Senior stakeholder engagement: Engage and influence senior stakeholders across Technology, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Finance, Internal Audit and business units to align interpretation, ownership, implementation approach and closure expectations.
* Stakeholder challenge: Constructively challenge incomplete assessments, weak remediation plans, unsupported status updates and inadequate closure evidence, while enabling timely resolution.
* Audit readiness: Maintain an auditable repository of regulatory communications, assessments, approvals, submissions, implementation evidence, governance decisions and minutes.
* Continuous improvement: Identify recurring weaknesses and drive improvements in regulatory governance, reporting controls, tracking discipline, documentation quality and sustainability of implementation across T\&O.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Law, Risk Management, Technology or a related discipline.
* Typically 12\-15 years of relevant experience in banking operations, regulatory reporting, regulatory governance, compliance, operational risk, audit or control functions.
* Strong working knowledge of the Indian banking regulatory environment, including RBI circulars and regulatory expectations relevant to Technology and Operations.
* Proven experience in interpreting regulatory communications and translating requirements into practical implementation plans, controls and accountable actions.
* Demonstrated experience managing regulatory reporting, regulatory submissions, regulatory commitments or supervisory observations within a banking environment.
* Proven ability to drive end\-to\-end governance, including impact assessment, implementation tracking, evidence validation, escalation and closure sign\-off.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage senior management, facilitate governance forums, prepare executive\-ready papers and simplify complex regulatory matters.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive outcomes across functions, including constructively challenging stakeholders and influencing without direct authority.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability to identify control implications, delivery risks, data or process gaps and potential compliance exposure.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver with precision within time\-sensitive regulatory timelines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word for governance trackers, analysis, executive reporting and documentation.


**Core Competencies**
* End\-to\-end ownership and disciplined follow\-through
* Regulatory interpretation and circular understanding
* Regulatory reporting and submission governance
* Executive communication and management reporting
* Senior stakeholder engagement, influencing and constructive challenge
* Impact assessment and control\-oriented thinking
* Risk\-based judgement, decision\-making and timely escalation
* Attention to detail, documentation quality and audit readiness
* Ability to operate independently in a complex, cross\-functional environment


**Work Relationships**
 Partner with Technology, Operations, Business and support units, Compliance, Legal, Risk Management, Finance, Internal Audit and other relevant stakeholders to coordinate regulatory interpretation, impact assessment, implementation, reporting and evidence\-based closure.

title: Agency Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Care Health Insurance is a specialized health insurer offering a broad range of products, including retail health insurance, top\-up coverage, personal accident, maternity, international travel, and critical illness plans. The company also serves corporate clients with group health and group personal accident insurance, as well as micro insurance products for rural markets and comprehensive wellness services. Guided by a consumer\-centric philosophy, Care Health Insurance invests heavily in technology to enhance customer service, drive product innovation, and deliver value\-for\-money solutions. The organization’s performance and service excellence have been recognized through awards such as ‘Smart Insurer’ and ‘Sales Champion’ at the ET Now Insurance Summit \& Awards 2025\. Professionals joining Care Health Insurance can expect a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment focused on quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Agency Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for leading and developing a network of insurance agents to achieve business targets. The role involves recruiting, training, and mentoring agency partners, setting performance goals, and monitoring sales activities to drive sustainable growth in health insurance products. The Agency Manager will plan and execute sales strategies, ensure compliance with regulatory and company guidelines, and maintain strong relationships with agents and customers. Daily activities include reviewing sales pipelines, conducting field visits, organizing team meetings, and preparing performance reports for leadership. The role also requires collaboration with internal departments to support agents with product knowledge, marketing materials, and service\-related resolutions.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales and business development abilities, including experience in managing agency channels or field sales teams.
* Skills in team leadership, performance management, and coaching to support agent productivity and professional growth.
* Proficiency in planning, organizing, and executing sales strategies, with solid analytical skills for tracking targets and performance metrics.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills to engage agents, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Understanding of insurance products and market dynamics; prior experience in health or general insurance is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, marketing, or a related field; relevant professional certifications in insurance are an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, travel locally for field visits, and adapt to a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* High ethical standards, customer\-focused mindset, and familiarity with regulatory requirements and compliance practices.

title: 【子会社採用】株式会社The Kids/屋内遊園施設の運営マネージャー
description:
会社概要
   

  

 弊社は「生きるに、遊びを。」をミッションに、「衣、食、住」に並ぶ価値として「遊」を社会に実装し、Well\-Beingな社会の実現を目指しています。
   

  

 物質的な豊かさが満たされつつある現代では、心の充実や体験価値への関心が高まっています。私たちは、「遊び」や「体験」が人々の幸福感を育む重要な要素であると捉え、誰もが豊かに生きる機会を創出していきます。
   

  

 2026年、私たちはさらなる「遊」の価値拡大を目指し、全国約70店舗の室内キッズパークを展開する「株式会社The Kids」を100%子会社としてグループに迎え入れました。アソビューが培ってきたデジタル・DXの知見と、The Kidsが持つリアル店舗の運営ノウハウを融合させ、今まさに新たな価値を創出していくダイナミックな成長のタイミングです。
   

  

 事業概要
   

  

* 生活者向けサービス（マーケットプレイス事業）
+ アソビュー！：休日の便利でお得な遊び予約サイト
+ アソビュー！ギフト：大切な人に思い出を贈る。体験ギフト販売サイト
+ アソビュー！ふるさと納税：体験型返礼品特化型のふるさと納税サイト
+ アソビュー！海外：海外旅行の予約が可能なサイト

* 体験事業者・レジャー施設向けサービス（SaaS事業）
+ ウラカタチケット：レジャー・観光・文化施設様向けDXソリューション
+ ウラカタ予約：アクティビティ・体験教室様向けDXソリューション

* 地方自治体・観光支援事業
+ 中央省庁・自治体向け地域活性化ソリューション：遊びのチカラで、ニッポンを元気に。

* 店舗型事業（LBE事業）
+ 株式会社TheKids：全国約70店舗の室内キッズパーク「The Kids」を展開・運営


 仕事内容
   

  

 【子どもたちの笑顔を支える♪】店舗運営やスタッフ管理をお任せ！複数店舗を担うエリアマネージャーとして、お客様対応、イベント企画、店舗づくりを行っていただきます。
   

  

* 空間のプロデュース：開店・閉店準備、子どもたちが安全に楽しめるための衛生管理・安全チェック。
* 笑顔のお出迎え：受付業務（タブレット端末での簡単レジ操作）や、保護者の方々との良好なコミュニケーション。
* チームの環境づくり：アルバイトスタッフ（主婦層中心）のシフト管理や育成。
* 店舗のブラッシュアップ
* 日々の気づきを活かしたオペレーションの改善提案、
* 販促・イベントの企画立案。


 複数店舗の売上・予算管理、店舗ごとの課題分析と改善施策の企画・実行、エリア全体のサービス品質向上に向けた取り組みなど、担当エリア全体の売上拡大や人材育成を担うエリアマネージャーとして、複数店舗の運営戦略に携わっていただきます！
   

  

 求人の魅力ポイント
   

  

 ■自分のアイデアがパークの魅力になる
   

  

 マニュアル通りの運営だけでなく、店舗づくりに自分の発想を活かせる裁量があります。
   

  

 現場をより良くしていく楽しさをダイレクトに実感できる環境です。
   

  

 入社後の流れ
   

  

 店舗でのOJTを通じて、運営ノウハウをイチから学べます。
   

  

 先輩社員がしっかりサポートするので、未経験の方も安心して成長できる環境です。
   

  

 配属先の編成
   

  

 各店舗には、10名前後のアルバイトスタッフ（主婦層中心）が在籍中です。
   

  

 平日は1～2名、土日祝は2～4名体制で運営しており、協力しながらお客様をお迎えしています。
   

  

 社員スタッフにはシフト管理や育成などをお任せし、働きやすい環境づくりとサービス向上をリードしていただきます。
   

  

 応募要件
   

  

 必須要件
   

  

* 高卒以上


 歓迎要件
   

  

* 接客・販売・サービス業の経験をお持ちの方（業界不問）
* 飲食店や小売店、アパレルなどでの店長・マネジメント経験
* 複数店舗を統括するSV（スーパーバイザー）経験や、スタッフの育成・◎シフト管理などの経験


 こんな方にピッタリです
   

  

* 子ども達の笑顔に幸せや働きがいを感じる方
* お客様、スタッフの方々と良好なコミュニケーションを築ける方
* チームをまとめ、みんなでアイデアを出し合っていきたい方
* 将来的にキャリアアップしたい方

title: New Product Development Manager
description:
**Location:** 
 Vikhroli West, Mumbai (with regular travel to our Nasik plant)
 



  




 About SCANDALous Foods
 
 SCANDALous Foods (ADITOF Pvt. Ltd.) is a one\-stop shop for India's most\-loved mithais — reengineered into
 **6\-month shelf life, single\-serve 95g cups** 
 built for the HORECA ecosystem: hotels, restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, and Qcom players. We own the
 **post\-meal impulse mithai** 
 moment.
 



 Today we ship
 **3 lakh cups a month across 6 cities** 
 , manufactured out of our Nasik facility. Tomorrow — a lot more, in a lot more formats.
 



  




 The Role
 
 You are the person who takes a "wouldn't it be cool if…" and turns it into a
 **shelf\-stable, HORECA\-ready, mass\-produced SKU** 
 — on brief, on cost, on time.
 



 You'll own our innovation funnel end\-to\-end: from spotting the next category, to lab benchwork with our consulting chefs and food technologists, to pilot batches, to full\-blown scale\-up in Nasik. If a product ships from SCANDALous, your fingerprints are on it.
 



 This is not a "recipe writer" role. This is a
 **product\-market\-manufacturing** 
 role.
 



  




 What you'll own
 * **Category foresight:** 
 Predict the next 3–5 categories SCANDALous should play in — mithai, frozen, ambient, indulgence formats — before the market catches on
* **Concept → prototype:** 
 Brief and coordinate with consulting chefs, food technologists, flavour houses, and ingredient suppliers to build 20\+ prototypes a year
* **Product engineering:** 
 Nail down
 **texture, shelf life, mouthfeel, taste, aromatics** 
 across ambient and frozen formats — not by feel, but by spec
* **Pilot to plant:** 
 Take a bench\-top winner and scale it to Nasik — process definition, machinery selection, yield, costing, QC parameters, and SOPs
* **Packaging \& format:** 
 Stay ahead on packaging innovation, machinery, and formats — cups, pouches, tubs, frozen packs, single\-serve, sharing — with a bias for HORECA \& Qcom fit
* **Trend engine:** 
 Live inside the latest — global culinary trends, food service menus, HORECA insights, quick commerce data, packaging tech, ingredient breakthroughs
* **Cost \& commercial:** 
 Own product cost sheets and margin gates — no product moves to launch without hitting them
* **Cross\-functional glue:** 
 Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Founder, Sales, Ops, QC, and Marketing to make sure launches actually land



  




 You are
 * **Technically trained** 
 — B.Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc in
 **Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Tech, or equivalent or a chef with years of technical experience.**
* 3–5 yrs in NPD in
 **FMCG food, frozen foods, dairy, bakery, desserts, or QSR** 
 — with real SKUs launched under your name
* Deep, working understanding of
 **frozen food behaviour** 
 , ice\-crystal control, freeze\-thaw, staling, moisture migration, water activity, emulsions, shelf\-life extension, natural preservation, and clean\-label formulation
* Have taken products from
 **10\-batch pilot to 10,000\-unit production runs** 
 — and know exactly where scale\-up breaks
* Fluent in the language of
 **consulting chefs AND food technologists** 
 — and can translate between them
* Obsessed with
 **eating, tasting, and dissecting** 
 food — Michelin to street to supermarket shelf
* Sharp on
 **packaging machinery, filling lines, sealing tech, cold chain, and ambient logistics**
* Have a strong POV on where Indian food formats are going — and receipts to back it



  




 Bonus points
 * Have launched a shelf\-stable Indian sweets / desserts / dairy SKU
* Have worked with a food manufacturing co, cloud kitchen, QSR chain, or Qcom\-first brand
* Have hands\-on experience with frozen desserts, mousses, or single\-serve indulgence formats
* Understand FSSAI, nutritional labelling, and export\-grade compliance


- 

 What we don't want
 * A pure R\&D scientist who doesn't want to see a shop floor
* A chef who can't read a shelf\-life study
* Someone who needs a 40\-person team to ship one SKU
* "Reference recipe" copy\-paste innovators



  




 Why this role, why now
 * You'll build
 **the innovation engine** 
 of a category\-defining brand — from a clean slate
* You'll answer to the Founder directly — no innovation\-committee theatre
* You'll ship. Fast. To real HORECA customers who reorder.
* You'll get to place bets on the
 **next big Indian format** 
 — and see it in 3 lakh\+ cups a month, in 6\+ cities, growing weekly



 If you've spent years watching your best product ideas die in someone else's PowerPoint — this is your exit.
 



  




 Apply
 
 Send your CV \+ a one\-pager on
 **the last product you launched (what, how, scale, learning)** 
 to:
 



**jobs@scandalousfoods.in** 
**Subject: NPD Manager – \[Your Name]** 




 Bonus: tell us
 **one Indian food category you think is about to explode in the next 24 months, and why.** 
 That'll open the door faster than a CV.

title: Vice President, Chief Product Office (CPO) - Business Management
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
**Shift timings: 5\.30 pm \- 3\.30 am IST (applicable for India)**
 The Vice President, CPO Business Management plays a critical role in the day‑to‑day business management, operational reporting, and strategic communication of the Product organization. This role sits at the intersection of content, business management, and execution, supporting the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) for the CPO.
   

  

 The role is responsible for driving operational rigor and transparency across the CPO through business management reporting, headcount and capacity tracking, risk and control support, OKRs, operating model documentation, and monthly business review (MBR) commentary, while continuing to own and govern Product content and narrative.
   

  

 The individual will bring strong execution discipline, analytical insight, and structured thinking to help Product leadership navigate complex priorities, trade‑offs, and operating challenges with clarity and pace.
   

  

 This role partners closely with the Product CAO and Product leadership to ensure that Product strategy, performance, and risks are clearly articulated, consistently governed, and effectively communicated.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong strategic judgment, executive communication expertise, and operational discipline, with the ability to lead content at scale in a complex, fast‑paced environment.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 As Product continues to scale in size, complexity, and strategic importance, there is a growing need for strong business management capabilities alongside content and narrative leadership.
   

  

**This Role Ensures That**
* Product leadership has clear, reliable insights into performance, capacity, risks, and priorities
* Strategic decisions are supported by consistent reporting and analysis
* Product operates with discipline, transparency, and accountability
* Messaging to senior stakeholders reflects both strategy and operational reality


 This position is foundational to sustaining operational excellence and execution maturity across the Product organization.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
**Product Business Management \& Reporting**
* Own and facilitate business management reporting for the Product organization, including dashboards, scorecards, and executive‑level summaries
* Produce monthly business review (MBR) materials and commentary, translating data into clear insights, risks, and actions for leadership
* Support OKR definition, tracking, and reporting, ensuring alignment between strategy, execution, and outcomes
* Develop and maintain operating model documentation, including roles, responsibilities, governance forums, and decision rights


**Headcount, Capacity \& Resource Management**
* Partner with Finance, HR, and the Product CAO to support:
+ Headcount tracking and reporting
+ Capacity and utilization analysis
+ Workforce planning inputs and hiring approvals

* Maintain transparent views into resource allocation and constraints across Product


**Product related Strategic Narrative and data gathering**
* Review Product content and narrative, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with strategic and operational priorities. Write commentaries, where necessary.
* Translate Product strategy, performance, and risks into clear, compelling executive‑level commentaries
* Coordinate across teams for content creation for senior forums, leadership updates, and cross‑functional communications
* Act as a liaison between the Product Office and partner teams to ensure messaging accuracy and consistency


**Employee Engagement, Talent \& Culture Enablement**
* Partner with the Talent, Learning \& Culture (TLC) Council and related workstreams to support employee engagement, learning, and culture initiatives within the Product organization.
* Coordinate Product participation in enterprise and BU‑level engagement programs, ensuring alignment with Product priorities and capacity.
* Track and report on engagement‑related metrics, actions, and outcomes, including follow‑through on survey results, action plans, and leadership commitments.
* Support leadership with materials, reporting, and updates for TLC Council forums, engagement reviews, and related governance meetings.
* Write commentaries for quarterly internal newsletters and internal social media posts


**Risk, Controls \& Governance Support**
* Support Product leadership in risk identification, issue tracking, and control remediation, including coordination with Operational Risk, Compliance, and Audit
* Assist with documentation and tracking of control actions, governance decisions, and remediation plans
* Help embed consistent governance and operating discipline across Product initiatives


**Execution \& Cross‑Functional Coordination**
* Manage and support strategic, tactical, and ad‑hoc initiatives on behalf of Product leadership
* Act as a trusted partner to the Product CAO helping drive follow‑through on commitments, decisions, and action items
* Coordinate with Marketing, Sales Support, Finance, HR, Risk, and other CAO functions to ensure aligned execution


**Operational Excellence \& Enablement**
* Drive continuous improvement in business management processes, leveraging tools, templates, and automation where appropriate
* Leverage AI tools (including Copilot) to improve reporting efficiency, insight generation, and content quality
* Mentor junior team members and help build a strong bench of business management and content talent
* Support ad hoc strategic initiatives and projects as needed


**What We Value**
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
   

  

* Demonstrated experience in business management, CAO, chief of staff, or strategy support roles
* Strong ability to translate data into executive‑ready insights and narratives
* Experience with headcount, financial, and workforce data, and comfort working across Finance and HR partners
* Proven ability to operate in a matrixed, fast‑paced, and highly regulated environment
* Strong execution rigor with an ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities
* Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills; familiarity with AI‑enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot)
* High emotional intelligence, sound business judgment, and discretion when supporting senior leaders
* Ability to act as a trusted advisor, balancing challenge with partnership


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Overall, 15\+ years of work experience.
* 8\+ years of relevant business/product experience; prior experience in CAO, business management, strategy, consulting, or transformation roles strongly preferred
* Experience supporting senior leaders within Product, Investment Services, or adjacent financial services functions a plus
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint


**Minimum Salary**
 zł282,000 Annual
   

  

 The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.
   

  

 Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self\-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non\-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.

description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager\- Operational Conduct Risk Officer, GLOBAL BANKING
   

  

 Department: Conduct and Control Office, Global Banking
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
